Insights dashboard in Desk One question, many views One query, several charts A number the owner checks daily Number chart on the first row A one-off question for one user Report Builder or a saved list filter — not a dashboard A printed document (invoice, gate pass) Print Format (Lesson 08), not Insights Data that must be frozen at month end A report exported to file — a live dashboard moves

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Dashboards nobody opens. A dashboard buried three clicks deep is decoration. Put the one number that matters where people look.
  • One query per chart. Build the query once, chart it many ways. Ten copies of the same logic drift apart.
  • No filter on a multi-company dashboard. Every chart shows all companies mixed together. Add the company filter.
  • A chart for every question. Five charts that answer one question hide the answer. One chart, one question.
  • Sharing the workbook with everyone. Workbooks carry their own permissions — share with the roles that may see the data, not the whole site.
  • Trusting a chart without checking the query. A wrong filter makes a confident-looking wrong number. Read the query first.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 19 — Website & Portal — the public side of Frappe: web pages, Web Forms, and the customer portal.

docs.title: What it is
docs.text:
Frappe has two faces: Desk (the internal app, logged-in users, roles) and the Website (public pages anyone can open). The portal is the middle ground — logged-in customers who see only their own documents. Three building blocks:

Block For Web Page A static public page (About, Terms, a landing page) Web Form A public form that creates a document — no Desk access for the submitter Portal Logged-in customers seeing their own orders, invoices, tickets

Website Settings (a Single DocType) holds the site-wide chrome: home page, brand, top navigation, footer. Pages in your app's www/ folder map directly to routes — www/about.html is /about — with an optional same-named .py file whose get_context() supplies the data.

docs.title: Minimal working example — a "Request a Quote" Web Form
docs.text:
Desk → search Web Form → New:

Field Value Title Request a Quote DocType CRM Lead Route request-quote

Click Get Fields to pull the fields from CRM Lead, keep name, company, email, phone and requirements, make email and requirements mandatory, then Publish. Click See on Website — the form is live at /request-quote. Every submission creates a CRM Lead with source "Web Form" (the CRM app also has its own form builder under Settings → Forms, for Lead/Deal capture).

Options to know: Login Required off means guests can submit — keep it off for a public form, on for anything internal. Allow Multiple lets one person submit more than once. Allow Edit lets them edit their submission later. A guest-facing form with no rate limiting is a spam target — keep it simple, and check submissions daily at first.

docs.title: Minimal working example — a customer portal page
docs.text:
ERPNext already ships portal views for Sales Orders, Invoices and tickets. To add your own page, put it in your app's www/ folder — my_app/www/my-orders.html is /my-orders — with a controller my_app/www/my-orders.py:

# my_app/www/my-orders.py
import frappe


def get_context(context):
    if frappe.session.user == "Guest":
        frappe.throw(_("Please log in first"), frappe.PermissionError)
    # Contact has no direct customer field — the link lives in its
    # Dynamic Link child table (links), so resolve it in two steps.
    contact = frappe.db.get_value("Contact",
        {"user": frappe.session.user}, "name")
    customer = frappe.db.get_value("Dynamic Link",
        {"parenttype": "Contact", "parent": contact,
         "link_doctype": "Customer"}, "link_name") if contact else None
    if not customer:
        frappe.throw(_("No customer linked to your account"),
                     frappe.PermissionError)
    context.orders = frappe.get_list("Sales Order",
        filters={"customer": customer, "docstatus": 1},
        fields=["name", "transaction_date", "grand_total", "status"],
        order_by="transaction_date desc")
    return context

The context function is the access control: bounce Guest, resolve the Customer from the logged-in user's Contact, and scope the query to that customer. Add the page to the portal menu with portal_menu_items in hooks.py, gated by role.

docs.title: When to use — and when not to
docs.text: Situation Use A static public page (About, Terms) Web Page DocType, or www/ HTML Data entry by external users Web Form Customers seeing their own documents Portal (built-in views, or a www/ page) A custom app with sidebar and toolbar Custom portal page in www/ A full public website with blog and shop Frappe Website + Webshop — or a dedicated CMS, if the site is the product Internal work Desk — never expose Desk screens to the public web

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Portal access without testing permissions. Log in as a real portal user and check they see only their own documents — a portal login that can see another customer's invoices is a data leak.
  • Guest Web Form with no checks. Public forms get spam. Keep the fields minimal, require an email, and review submissions daily.
  • Web Form fieldnames that do not match the DocType. The form writes by fieldname — a renamed field silently drops the value.
  • Putting internal logic on a public page. A www/ page runs with the visitor's permissions. Never show data the visitor may not see, and never trust a parameter from the URL.
  • Forgetting Website Settings. A site with no home page, no brand and no navigation looks unfinished, however good the forms are.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 20 — Upgrades — moving a live site from v14 to v15 to v16 without breaking it: the lesson-length version, with the full guide as the deep reference.

docs.title: What it is
docs.text: An upgrade moves a live site from one major version to the next — v14 → v15 → v16. It is a project, not a command: the code changes, the schema changes, and every custom app, Server Script, Workflow and print format is a thing that can break. This lesson is the short version — the rules, the order, and what to test. The full tables, commands and checklists live in the deep reference: Upgrade guide — v14 → v15 → v16.

docs.title: The rules
docs.text:
1. One major version at a time. v14 → v15, verify, then v15 → v16. Never skip v15 — v16 patches assume the v15 schema is already in place.
  2. Staging first, always. The full upgrade runs on a copy of production data.
  3. A backup that was never restored is not a backup. Test the restore on staging first.
  4. Every custom app needs a branch for the target version — or it is removed first.

docs.title: Minimal working example — the upgrade, end to end
docs.text:
# 1. Know what you are upgrading from
grep __version__ apps/frappe/frappe/__init__.py apps/erpnext/erpnext/__init__.py
bench version

# 2. Backup — and prove it restores on staging
bench --site <site> backup --with-files --compress
bench --site staging restore <backup.sql> \
  --with-public-files <public.tar> --with-private-files <private.tar>

# 3. Runtime floor for the target (v16: Python 3.14+, Node 24+, MariaDB 10.6+)
# 4. Switch branches together, in dependency order, then migrate
cd ~/frappe-bench
bench switch-to-branch version-16 frappe erpnext hrms
bench --site <site> migrate

On Frappe Cloud there are no bench commands — the version is switched in the site dashboard — but the rules are the same.

docs.title: Breaking changes — the ones that bite most
docs.text:
Change Action has_permission hooks Must return an explicit True — None now denies access (v16) DB commit inside document hooks Not allowed — the framework commits frappe.sendmail(now=True) No longer commits (v16) PDF Chrome renderer — wkhtmltopdf deprecated, removed in v17 /app URL /desk — fix bookmarks and hardcoded links Legacy ERPNext CRM Scheduled for removal in v17 — move to Frappe CRM now Server Scripts Disabled by default on v15+ — re-enable with bench set-config -g server_script_enabled 1

The full v14→v15 and v15→v16 tables, the upgrade scan (/frappe-upgrade-check in frappe_core_skills), patch handling (never_skip_patches, bench migrate --skip-failing), and the complete checklists are in the upgrade guide.

docs.title: What to test after the upgrade
docs.text: On staging, by hand, not by hope: Desk loads and /desk works; for every DocType the upgrade touched — create, save, submit, cancel, print, one list-view filter; run the app tests (bench --site <test_site> run-tests --app <app>); re-check every whitelisted method, Workflow and scheduled job; open the client's real invoice on the Chrome renderer; check Email Queue draining and one integration end to end. Only when staging passes does production get a date — and the rollback plan is agreed beforehand: if migrate fails and cannot be fixed in two hours, restore the pre-upgrade backup onto the old code.

docs.title: When to use — and when not to
docs.text: Situation Use A version is out of support, or a feature needs the new one Plan the upgrade — staging first "Just run bench update on Friday" Never on production without staging A patch release (v16.60 → v16.61) bench update on staging, quick smoke test, then live A custom app with no branch for the target Remove it first, or port it — do not migrate around it The client asks "can we skip v15?" No. One major at a time.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Upgrading straight on production. The staging copy exists so the failure happens there.
  • A backup never restored. The restore test is the backup.
  • Skipping a failed patch. A skipped patch is a debt entry, not a success — fix the data, re-run migrate.
  • Hand-editing the database to fake a patch as done. The next migrate trusts that lie.
  • Forgetting the apps. HRMS, Frappe CRM, Helpdesk and Payments are separate apps — each needs its own version branch.
  • No rollback plan. If you cannot restore in under an hour on staging, you are not ready for production.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 21 — Ops — keeping a production site alive: backups, monitoring, multi-site benches, and Frappe Cloud vs self-hosted.

docs.title: What it is
docs.text: Ops is keeping a production site alive: backed up, monitored, and recoverable. Nobody notices good ops — until the day the disk fills, the scheduler stops, or a site will not come back. This lesson is the weekly routine and the decisions (multi-site, Cloud vs self-hosted) that make the bad day survivable.

docs.title: Minimal working example — the weekly ops routine
docs.text:
Run these every week, on every production site. Thirty minutes, same order:

# 1. Backup — database + files, compressed
bench --site mysite.local backup --with-files --compress

# 2. Prove the backup restores (on a spare site, monthly at least)
bench --site spare.local restore <backup.sql> \
  --with-public-files <public.tar> --with-private-files <private.tar>

# 3. Are the workers and scheduler alive?
bench doctor

# 4. Disk space — a full disk stops the database
df -h

Then in Desk: Error Log — read every new error, don't just count them (one error repeated 200 times is one bug, fix it); Email Queue — draining, not stuck; Background Jobs — the scheduler ran last night's jobs. On v16, offsite backups are a separate app (frappe/offsite_backups) — install it, do not assume backups leave the server by themselves. Keep backup files off the server: a backup on the same disk as the database is a copy, not a backup.

docs.title: Multi-site benches
docs.text:
One bench can host many sites — they share the apps, each has its own database and files:

bench new-site client2.local
bench --site client2.local install-app erpnext
bench --site client2.local install-app my_app

Use it for: one bench per client group, a staging site next to production, a training site with sample data. Never share a database between sites, and never test on the production site — a test site costs nothing, a test on production costs a business day.

docs.title: Frappe Cloud vs self-hosted
docs.text:
Frappe Cloud Self-hosted Who runs the server Frappe — updates, backups, monitoring included You — OS, bench, backups, monitoring Bench commands No shell — version and settings in the site dashboard Full shell: bench, console, custom scripts Control Limited (no custom bench commands, no server access) Full — any app, any integration, any schedule Scaling Pick a plan, Frappe scales it You size and scale the server Cost shape Per site, per month Server + your time

Pick Cloud when the client wants ERP without an IT person, and the standard apps are enough. Pick self-hosted when you need shell access, custom bench work, private integrations, or data that must stay on the client's own server. Either way, the ops routine above still applies — Cloud automates the backup, it does not remove the need to check that the backup exists and restores.

docs.title: When to use — and when not to
docs.text: Situation Use A site is live The weekly routine, every week, no exceptions A second client on the same bench A second site, not a second bench A test or training environment A separate site on the same bench "The backup exists" The restore test — a backup never restored is not a backup An error in the log Read it and fix the cause — do not clear the log A client with no IT staff Frappe Cloud, with you checking the routine

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• No restore test. The backup file exists, the restore fails. Found out on the worst day.
  • Backups on the same disk. The disk dies, the backup dies with it.
  • Scheduler silently stopped. No emails, no notifications, no auto-reposts — and nobody notices for a week. bench doctor is the check.
  • Testing on production. A test import on the live site is a live import. Use the test site.
  • Ignoring the Error Log. Errors compound. One unread error is a bug report nobody filed.
  • One bench, one site, forever. A second site on the same bench is free — staging, training, and the next client all live there.

docs.title: Next
docs.text:
You have finished the Framework path — all 21 topics, from your first bench to a production site you can keep alive.

  • Review the map: Learn: Frappe Framework — Noob to Pro
  • Use it on real modules: Learn: ERPNext Modules — all 14 modules, from Accounting to cross-module flows
  • Do real work with it: Guides — upgrade, go-live, and the common mistakes to avoid
  • Stay current: Research: what changed 2024–2026 and the apps catalog — the hub grows with the ecosystem

The path is finished. The learning is not — the next production site is where these lessons earn their keep.

docs.title: Frappe & ERPNext — What Changed in the Last 2 Years (Nov 2024 – Nov 2026)
docs.text:
The big changes of the last two years only — Framework/ERPNext v15 and v16 era, Studio, Flow, Insights, CRM/Helpdesk/Raven and the major features. Each item is short: what came, when, and one How we can use it line for NexTash work. Everything is verified from official sources (Frappe Blog, Frappe Forum, GitHub releases, Frappe docs, Frappe Times) with a source link per item.

Background (one line): before Nov 2024 — v13 (Apr 2021) brought the modern Desk UI, v14 (Aug 2022) split the monolith into separate apps (HR, Healthcare, Education…), v15 (Oct 2023) brought the Espresso design system and no-code Form/Workflow Builders, and Frappe Cloud has hosted sites since 2020. Detail starts below, at November 2024.

docs.title: Support status (as of 26 November 2026)
docs.text: • v14 — end of life 31 Jan 2026. v15 — supported until end 2027. v16 — supported until end 2029. (Secondary summaries citing https://frappe.io/support-versions — verify there before quoting to a client.)

docs.title: v15 era — the version in force when the window opens
docs.text:
• v15 (Oct 2023, still current in Nov 2024): Espresso UI, no-code Form Builder and Workflow Builder, Stock Reservation against Sales Orders, Serial & Batch Bundle, editable invoices after submission, 2.5x faster financial reports. Still patched monthly — latest v15.127.0, 25 Nov 2026. Source: https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-and-erpnext-v15-release/111702
  • How we can use it: v15 is the safe upgrade target for clients afraid of v16's new UI — sell the v14→v15 move with Form Builder demos ("build a DocType in the meeting") and Stock Reservation for manufacturing/trading clients fighting v14 stock complaints.

docs.title: November 2024 — Insights v3
docs.text:
• Frappe Insights v3 released (Nov 2024): complete makeover — TypeScript frontend, ibis-framework backend, 20+ connectors, basic data warehousing. Source: https://frappe.io/times/october-2024 (announced), https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-insights-tools-guide/140202/4 (released in November)
  • How we can use it: sell an Insights dashboard package as the phase-2 sale after every go-live — sales, stock and finance dashboards on live data, self-service for managers, no more Excel exports.

docs.title: January 2025 — Raven v2
docs.text:
• Raven v2 (10 Jan 2025): workspaces (many groups per site), AI bots, ERPNext integrations — document previews, alerts and actions inside chat. Source: https://frappe.io/product/raven/at-frappe
  • How we can use it: offer Raven to clients drowning in WhatsApp groups for internal coordination — channels plus document alerts (invoice approvals, stock alerts) inside the ERP.

docs.title: April 2025 — Studio open-sourced
docs.text:
• Frappe Studio open-sourced (3 Apr 2025, Frappe Build, Bengaluru): drag-and-drop app builder, visual layouts, data sources, fast CRUD tools. Repo: https://github.com/frappe/studio. Source: https://frappe.io/blog/product-updates/product-updates-for-april-2025
  • How we can use it: Studio is the fastest new service line — build a client's custom app visually in days (sample-tracking, gate-pass, visitor register) and bill it fixed-price. Train one NexTash analyst on it so small apps stop consuming developer time.

docs.title: September 2025 — Frappeverse India 2025
docs.text:
• Frappeverse India 2025 (11–12 Sep 2025, Nehru Centre, Mumbai). Source: https://events.frappe.io
  • How we can use it: use each Frappeverse as a lead-generation and client-touch point — turn its announcements into a short client newsletter ("what's new in ERPNext") to stay in touch with the installed base.

docs.title: November 2025 — v16 beta
docs.text:
• Framework/ERPNext v16 beta (15 Nov 2025): first major release in two years; final planned for 6 Dec 2025 at Frappeverse Egypt. Source: https://discuss.frappe.io/t/erpnext-hrms-frappe-framework-v16-release-dates/156349
  • How we can use it: use the beta window to test our own custom apps and top clients' sites on staging — catching breakage early is a billable "v16 readiness check" service.

docs.title: January 2026 — v16 final
docs.text:
• Framework/ERPNext/Frappe HR v16 (12 Jan 2026): new Desktop UI (desktop icons, persistent sidebar), up to ~2x faster ("Caffeine"), List View up to 50 columns, scrollable child tables, Chrome-based PDF converter (replacing wkhtmltopdf), role-based field masking, UUID document naming. ERPNext: configurable Financial Report Templates (incl. IFRS), consolidated Trial Balance, forecast → MPS → MRP planning chain, batch-level stock reservations, inward subcontracting. Sources: https://frappe.io/blog/engineering/announcing-version-16, https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-erpnext-and-frappe-hr-version-16-release/159053
  • How we can use it: use the Desktop UI and 50-column List View as the demo hook for v16 upgrade pitches — clients see the difference in five minutes. Pitch the forecast → MPS → MRP chain to textile, food and spare-parts manufacturers who still plan in Excel. The raised runtime floor makes this a planned infrastructure upgrade (staging first), not a one-click update — sell it as a project.

docs.title: January 2026 — Raven becomes official
docs.text:
• Raven becomes an official Frappe app (Jan 2026) — the team that built it joined Frappe. Source: https://frappe.io/product/raven/at-frappe
  • How we can use it: now that Raven is official, propose it confidently as the team-chat layer on implementations — no more "community app" objection from clients.

docs.title: July 2026 — Raven v3
docs.text:
• Raven v3 (13 Jul 2026 per Frappe's timeline): faster app, proper PWA on mobile, redesign, Espresso rebuild, SQLite full-text search, notifications page, reminders, scheduled messages, read receipts. Note: a Frappeverse recap says beta 21 Aug / full release 1 Sep 2026 — dates conflict, see notes at the end. Source: https://frappe.io/product/raven/at-frappe
  • How we can use it: v3's PWA and search make Raven viable for factory-floor teams — propose it as part of the implementation for clients whose staff work off phones, not desks.

docs.title: August 2026 — Frappeverse Mumbai 2026
docs.text:
• Frappeverse Mumbai 2026 (21–22 Aug 2026, 1,500+ people): announcements — Frappe Suite, Frappe Cloud V2 preview, Raven V3, ERPNext v16 keynote. Sources: https://events.frappe.io/events/frappeverse-mumbai-2026, https://frappe.io/times/july-2026
  • How we can use it: same as every Frappeverse — leads plus a client newsletter from the announcements. The Cloud V2 preview is the talking point for hosting-migration conversations.

docs.title: October 2026 — v16.50, the polished v16
docs.text:
• Framework/ERPNext/HR v16.50 (7 Oct 2026): navigation fixed (clean desktop, per-module dock, curated sidebar), new print format designer (canvas + live preview), consolidated DocType Settings, revamped global search, step-based Data Import wizard, faster Kanban, List View layouts, bulk editing in child tables. No breaking changes — just update the three apps. Source: https://frappe.io/blog/product-updates/announcing-framework-erpnext-and-hrms-v1650
  • How we can use it: recommend v16.50 (not early v16) for every new rollout — the navigation fix removes the main objection clients raised. Use the Data Import wizard to shorten go-live (import customers/suppliers with addresses in one file) and build the client's invoice format live in the demo with the new print designer.

docs.title: November 2026 — Insights v3.50 removes v2
docs.text:
• Frappe Insights v3.50 (17 Nov 2026): removes Insights v2 entirely — v2 dashboards must be migrated via the "Migrate from v2" page in v3.13–v3.15.1 first (v3.15.1 released 20 Oct 2026). Source: https://docs.frappe.io/insights/articles/migrate-from-v2-to-v3
  • How we can use it: before any v3.50 upgrade, sell the v2-to-v3 dashboard migration as a scoped task — clients on v2 dashboards cannot skip it.

docs.title: November 2026 — v16.60: AI moves into the core
docs.text:
• Framework/ERPNext/HR v16.60 (17 Nov 2026): Studio merged into Framework (build apps without code, works with AI agents), Frappe Flow alpha (Frappe's AI harness in Desk — LLMs analyse data / fill forms, permission-aware, your own AI keys), Insights dashboards embedded in Desk, improved mobile UX, new child-table importer, better report printing. Monthly releases begin (16.70 in Dec 2026). ERPNext: Tally-style Day Book, 10 new print formats, redesigned Customer/Supplier forms with Overview dashboards, Projects revamp phase 1. Sources: https://frappe.io/blog/product-updates/announcing-framework-erpnext-and-frappe-hr-v1660, https://discuss.frappe.io/t/announcing-v16-60-for-frappe-framework-erpnext-and-frappe-hr/165819
  • How we can use it: offer Studio-built mini-apps as a new service line and Flow as a pilot to one friendly client on a test site ("ask your ERP" on their own data). The monthly cadence supports a recurring "upgrade + what's new" retainer — apply each 16.6x release and send the client a one-page summary.

docs.title: November 2026 — CRM & Helpdesk renumbered to v16.x
docs.text:
• Frappe CRM and Helpdesk switched versioning (Nov 2026): from continuous v1.x to the Framework scheme — v15.x targets Frappe v15, v16.x targets v16 (CRM v16.0.2, 5 Nov 2026; Helpdesk v16.2.1). CRM at Frappeverse 2026: ~2.5K paid sites, ~3.5K GitHub stars; new web Forms for lead capture, Lead/Deal enrichment, Sales Hierarchy, drag-and-drop Workflow Automations. Sources: https://github.com/frappe/crm/releases, https://www.ithub.directory/crm-customer-platforms/frappe-crm (secondary for the renumbering)
  • How we can use it: implement Frappe CRM (not ERPNext's legacy CRM module, scheduled for removal in v17) on every new sales project, and Helpdesk for any client whose support runs on a shared inbox — unlimited agents, no per-seat fee.

docs.title: November 2026 — Frappe Cloud 2.0 public beta
docs.text:
• Frappe Cloud 2.0 public beta (24 Nov 2026): rebuild from the foundation — Virtual Machines with full root/SSH, one-click apps, Object Storage, LLMs, firewalls and VPN. Architecture: Pilot (manages sites, usable today as a Bench replacement), Atlas (infrastructure), Central (customer-facing cloud). Target: Jan 2027. Bench officially archived. Source: https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-cloud-2-0-is-in-public-beta/165969
  • How we can use it: move hosting-migration clients to Cloud 2.0 VMs when it goes live — isolated VMs instead of shared multi-tenancy directly answers downtime complaints. Offer "Bench to Cloud 2.0" migration as a service; Pilot is a pitch for clients self-hosting on a VPS today.

docs.title: November 2026 — the monthly train: v16.61.0 and friends
docs.text:
• Framework v16.61.0 (24 Nov 2026): custom form button styles, maintenance mode allows reads by default, Letter Head Preview, Studio "Show on Desktop", Flow public agents, AI assistant views images, Print Format role restrictions, bulk Add/Remove Roles, GitPython 3.2.1 security update. Source: https://github.com/frappe/frappe/releases/tag/v16.61.0
  • ERPNext v16.61.0 & v15.127.0, CRM v16.4.0, Helpdesk v16.2.2 (25 Nov 2026): 278 bug fixes, Stock valuation breakdown page and auto-repost setting, Manufacturing "Return Components" on draft Job Cards, permission hardening across POS/company defaults/Payment Entry; CRM gets an Insights dashboard on its dashboard page. Sources: https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/releases/tag/v16.61.0, https://github.com/frappe/crm/releases/tag/v16.4.0, https://github.com/frappe/helpdesk/releases/tag/v16.2.2
  • How we can use it: keep clients on the monthly train under an AMC — each month's patch (like v16.61.0's permission hardening) is a reason to touch the client, report what changed, and bill the retainer. Full details: 2026-11-25, 2026-11-26.

docs.title: November 2026 — Builder gets AI ("Bob")
docs.text:
• Frappe Builder (Nov 2026): AI assistant "Bob" in the editor (slash commands, editor plugins, AI credits on Frappe Cloud); licence changed to MIT from v1.31.0 (earlier AGPL-3.0); latest v1.37.5, 6 Nov 2026. Source: secondary directories (iThub/exploreai) — verify on https://github.com/frappe/builder/releases before quoting.
  • How we can use it: use Builder to deliver client marketing pages and customer portals without a separate website project — a fixed-price add-on to any implementation (frappe.io itself is built with it).

docs.title: Dates & figures to double-check
docs.text:
1. Raven v3 date: frappe.io timeline says 13 Jul 2026; Frappeverse recap says beta 21 Aug / full release 1 Sep 2026.
  2. CRM/Helpdesk renumbering: v16.0.2 (5 Nov 2026) and the v15.x/v16.x scheme are from a secondary directory (iThub), not a Frappe announcement — verify on https://github.com/frappe/crm/releases.
  3. v16.60 "2,500+ bugs fixed": appears in secondary summaries; the Frappe v16.60 blog was not checked line-by-line.
  4. Support dates (v14 EOL 31 Jan 2026; v15 to end 2027; v16 to end 2029): verified only via secondary summaries citing https://frappe.io/support-versions.
  5. Insights v3 exact tag date (Nov 2024) and Builder v1.37.5 / "Bob" details: from secondary sources; verify on https://github.com/frappe/insights/releases and https://github.com/frappe/builder/releases.

docs.text:

docs.title: ERPNext Excel — Excel as a low-code layer
docs.text:

docs.title: Frappe Manager — local Docker-based Frappe development
docs.text:

docs.title: Integrations — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text: Part of the Apps Catalog — 11 apps in this category. Each app is short: what it does, why it helps, one How we can use it line for NexTash work, and the GitHub link + install command. Test on staging first.

docs.title: Frappe WhatsApp Suite — WhatsApp Business API + chat UI + chatbot (3 apps)
docs.text:
• What/why: three free apps that work together — WhatsApp Business Cloud API (direct via Meta, no middleman), a chat UI inside Desk, and a chatbot with keyword triggers and AI fallback.
  • How we can use it: make it our standard WhatsApp offer — order updates, invoice alerts and support chats from inside ERPNext, no paid middleman. Demo the in-Desk chat UI to trading/distribution clients; it replaces the shared phone their sales team passes around.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/shridarpatil/frappe_whatsapp · https://github.com/shridarpatil/whatsapp_chat · https://github.com/shridarpatil/frappe_whatsapp_chatbot — bench get-app each repo (all three on Frappe Cloud Marketplace)

docs.title: WABA Integration — WhatsApp Business Cloud API (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: the official Frappe WhatsApp route — the conservative choice when a client wants Frappe-maintained code.
  • How we can use it: propose it when a client insists on official code; use the community suite above when they also want the chat UI and chatbot.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/waba_integration — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/waba_integration

docs.title: Payment Core — provider-neutral payment layer (Aerele)
docs.text:
• What/why: shared foundation for payment integrations — references, transaction lifecycle, settlement, payment pages, idempotency — so checkout/webhook code is not rewritten per gateway.
  • How we can use it: adopt it as the foundation for every payment integration we build — payment work becomes repeatable instead of custom per client.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/aerele/payment-core — bench get-app https://github.com/aerele/payment-core --branch develop (Frappe/ERPNext v16, free MIT)

docs.title: Stripe Payment — Stripe gateway on Payment Core (Aerele)
docs.text:
• What/why: hosted checkout, 3D Secure, subscriptions, signed webhooks — the modern Stripe route for Frappe/ERPNext.
  • How we can use it: offer it to clients taking international payments/subscriptions through Stripe. Note: Stripe is not available locally in Pakistan, so this fits exporters and Gulf/UK/US-facing businesses, not local PKR collection.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/aerele/stripe-payment — bench get-app https://github.com/aerele/stripe-payment --branch develop (requires Payment Core, free MIT)

docs.title: Razorpay Integration — Razorpay payments (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: the standard gateway for Indian clients — UPI/cards through Razorpay, wired into ERPNext Payment Requests.
  • How we can use it: offer it to Indian clients (or Pakistani exporters selling into India) taking online payments.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/razorpay_integration — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/razorpay_integration

docs.title: Multi Payment Gateway — payment-choice page for the Webshop
docs.text:
• What/why: lists every enabled gateway (Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Braintree, Paytm, GoCardless, Cashfree, PayU, COD, bank transfer) at Webshop checkout instead of forcing one.
  • How we can use it: add it to every Webshop build where the client wants to offer more than one payment option — a small add-on that removes a real checkout objection.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Kalvyai-erpnext/ki_erp_multi_payment — bench get-app https://github.com/Kalvyai-erpnext/ki_erp_multi_payment --branch version-16 (ERPNext 16 only, free MIT)

docs.title: ERPNext Shipping — Packlink / LetMeShip / SendCloud shipping
docs.text:
• What/why: turns delivery notes into booked shipments with labels and rates instead of a separate shipping portal.
  • How we can use it: offer it to e-commerce/retail clients who book shipments in a separate portal today — it closes the loop between selling and dispatch.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/erpnext-shipping — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/erpnext-shipping

docs.title: Twilio Integration — SMS/voice/WhatsApp via Twilio (official Frappe)
docs.text:

  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/twilio-integration — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/twilio-integration

docs.title: MSG91 Integration — MSG91 SMS gateway
docs.text:
• What/why: direct gateway app for MSG91, a widely used SMS provider in India.
  • How we can use it: offer it to Indian clients already on MSG91 — SMS alerts on their existing provider and rates.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/dhwani-ris/frappe_msg91_integration — bench get-app https://github.com/dhwani-ris/frappe_msg91_integration

docs.title: Frappe Microsoft 365 — Outlook / Teams / OneDrive sync
docs.text:
• What/why: two-way Outlook calendar sync, Teams meetings from Frappe Events, transcripts/recordings, Outlook mail over OAuth, Microsoft sign-in.
  • How we can use it: offer it to corporate clients who live in Outlook/Teams — calendar and mail sync removes the "ERP is a separate island" objection.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Bizmap-Technologies-Pvt-Ltd/frappe_microsoft365 — bench get-app https://github.com/Bizmap-Technologies-Pvt-Ltd/frappe_microsoft365 (Frappe v15/v16)

docs.title: ALYF Banking — bank integration & reconciliation (EBICS)
docs.text:

docs.title: POSNext — modern offline POS for ERPNext (Vue 3)
docs.text:
• What/why: fast billing, multiple payments, discounts, offline mode, touchscreen UI, split payments, coupons/gift cards, shift cash reconciliation — the most credible built-in POS replacement.

docs.title: Frappe Research Hub
docs.text:
Frappe Framework aur ERPNext Noob se Pro tak seekhein — pehle bench setup se production ERP tak. Guides, research, nayi apps, aur real-world use cases, sab aik jagah.

Muhammad Irfaan ki taraf se — Full-Stack Developer & ERP Specialist, NexTash, Lahore. ERP systems bana rahe hain jin par businesses asal mein rely karte hain.

docs.title: Yeh hub kaise organised hai
docs.text:

docs.title: Contributing
docs.text:
Yeh hub public hai taake koi bhi is se seekh sake. Changes sirf fork + pull request se, merge se pehle reviewed.

  • Entries chhoti rakhein: kya, kab, kaise use karna hai, source link.
  • Har claim ke liye source chahiye: official docs, Frappe Blog/Forum, GitHub release, ya aik tested example.
  • Kabhi woh version promise na karein jo aap ne test nahi kiya.
  • Aik file mein aik topic, pehle beginner.

docs.title: Guides
docs.text:
NexTash ke asal projects se li gayi opinionated guides. Mukhtasar, concrete, koi theory nahi — sirf woh jiska koi use case ho.

  • Upgrade guide — v14 → v15 → v16 ke liye tayyari check
  • Go-live checklist — data import, permissions, training, cutover
  • Aam ghaltiyan — field layout, hooks, permissions, performance
  • Apps chunna — kab app install karni hai aur kab khud banana hai
  • Practice project — masala factory banayein, shuru se end tak

docs.title: Apps Chunna — Kab Install Karna Hai aur Kab Khud Banana Hai
docs.text: Har app jo aap install karte hain, woh ek dependency hai jo aap ko har upgrade par saath le kar chalni hogi. Aik app jo aaj do din bacha le aur agle upgrade par toot jaye, woh do hafte kha jati hai. Yeh guide woh decision process hai jo NexTash kisi bhi bench get-app se pehle use karta hai — client project par ho ya apni sites par.

docs.title: 5 sawal — kuch bhi install karne se pehle pooch lein
docs.text:
Koi app install nahi hogi jab tak paanchon ke jawab, likh kar, project note par na hon:

  1. Kya yeh kisi real project ka real masla hal karti hai? "Lagta hai useful hai" nahi — aik named client, aik named takleef, is mahine. Aik app jo "baad ke liye" install ki gayi ho, woh aik dependency hai jis ka koi owner nahi.
  2. Kya yeh maintained hai? Repo check karein: pichle 6 mahine mein aik release, open issues ke jawab mil rahe hon, stars sirf aik rough signal hain. Aik repo jis mein aik saal se koi commit na ho, woh aik marti hui app hai — aap us ke maintainer ban jayenge.
  3. Kya yeh aap ke Frappe / ERPNext version se match karti hai? Us ke paas aap ke version ke liye branch honi chahiye — version-14, version-15, version-16 — ya README mein likha ho. "v15 par chalti hai" ka matlab "v16 par chalti hai" nahi hai.
  4. Kya is se bahar nikalne ka rasta hai? Kya aap data export kar ke cleanly uninstall kar sakte hain? Agar is ko hatane ka matlab data khona ya database ko haath se edit karna hai, to data aap ka nahi hai — app ka hai.
  5. Jab yeh toot jaye to is ka owner kaun hai? Aik named shakhs, "team" nahi. Agar koi owner nahi hai, to yeh client ke sab se busy din tootegi aur kisi ko pata nahi hoga ke yeh kis ka kaam hai.

Aik "mujhe nahi pata" theek hai — staging par test karein aur pata laga lein. Do ya zyada "mujhe nahi pata" ka matlab hai abhi install na karein.

docs.title: Install karein — jab kisi aur ne pehle se behtar hal kar diya ho
docs.text:
Install karein jab masla aik poora module ho, app official ya well-maintained ho, aur khud banana hafton ka kaam ho:

Zaroorat Install karein Kyun CRM Frappe CRM — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/crm Official, actively developed, web forms + pipeline. CRM lesson dekhein. Support desk Frappe Helpdesk Official, SLAs + portal + knowledge base. Helpdesk lesson dekhein. HR Frappe HRMS (hrms app) Official HR: leave, attendance, payroll. HR lesson dekhein. Chat Raven (official, github.com/frappe/raven) Desk ke andar team chat; v3 current version hai. POS POSNext (v15+, offline mode) ya POS Prime (v14/v15/v16, zero core changes) POS aik product hai, feature nahi — is ko kabhi scratch se na banayein. Dashboards Frappe Insights Live data par official BI. Note: v3.50 ne v2 hata diya — pehle v2 dashboards migrate karein. WhatsApp Frappe WhatsApp Suite (+ chat UI + chatbot) ya official WABA Integration Woh channel jo Pakistan mein clients asal mein parhte hain.

Rule of thumb: agar app official Frappe code hai, to pehle install karein aur behes baad mein karein. Official apps ko version branches, upgrade patches aur aik migration path milta hai — woh teen cheezein jo upgrade ke waqt aap ko mehngi parti hain.

docs.title: Khud banayein — jab gap chhota aur specific ho
docs.text:
Banayein jab zaroorat aik register, aik form, aik chhota workflow ho — poora module nahi:

  • Aik gate-pass register, aik sample tracker, aik visitor log. Aik Studio mini-app, jo aik analyst visually aik din mein bana le (dekhein Studio, Flow & Insights). Aik register ke liye poori app install karna aise hai jaise tap theek karne ke liye poori company hire kar lein.
  • Kisi existing DocType par aik extra field ya aik chhota rule. Aik Custom Field (fixture ke tor par) ya aik Server Script — app nahi, fork nahi. Server Scripts dekhein.
  • Aik gap jo kisi ne abhi tak nahi banaya. Pakistan payments asal example hain: koi free public Easypaisa / JazzCash app nahi hai — catalog ka sab se bara gap. Yeh aik build hai (Payment Core par, github.com/aerele/payment-core), aur yeh aik product opportunity hai, sirf aik project task nahi.

Agar build Studio mein aik din se kam ya code mein aik hafte se kam ka hai, to bana lein. Agar yeh aik mahine se zyada ka hai, to dobara app dhoondein — ya client se build ke paise honestly lein, aik product ke tor par, favour ke tor par nahi.

docs.title: Extend karein — beech ka rasta
docs.text:
Zyada tar asal kaam na install hai na build — woh woh hai jo pehle se hai us ko extend karna, apni app se:

  • Custom Fields aur Property Setters, fixtures ke tor par export kiye hue.
  • Aik quick rule ke liye Server Scripts (dekhein Server Scripts).
  • doc_events hooks.py mein, jo aap ki app mein aik override file ki taraf point karein.
  • Aik whitelisted method + frappe.call, aik button ke liye jo server ka kaam kare.

Aur sakht rule, hamesha: kabhi kisi aur app ka code edit na karein. Aik line bhi nahi, "sirf is dafa" bhi nahi. Agla bench update us ko mita dega, aur client ko Monday ko pata chalega. Apni app se extend karein, ya na karein. (Common mistakes §2 dekhein.)

docs.title: Red flags — door hat jayein
docs.text:
• Abandoned. Aakhri commit aik saal se purana, issues ke jawab nahi. TailPOS (aakhri activity Oct 2022) aur ALYF Banking (repo Archived flag hai) catalog ke examples hain — sirf staging test ke liye, kabhi promise na karein.
  • Yeh core DocTypes ko fork karti hai. Aik app jo Sales Order / Stock Entry ko replace ya rewrite karti hai, woh agle ERPNext update par toot jayegi. Install karne se pehle check karein ke yeh kya override karti hai.
  • Aap ke Frappe version ke liye koi version branch nahi. v16 site par "v15 par chalti hai" aik staging-test failure hai jo hone wala hai.
  • Is ko chalne ke liye Administrator chahiye. Aik app jo sirf Administrator ke tor par kaam karti hai, us ka permission model hai "sab admin hain". Is ko client site par na lagayein.
  • Paid, bina trial ke. Bina staging par test karne ke tareeqe ke aik price aik sales call hai, product nahi. Pehle staging licence maangein.
  • Koi uninstall story nahi. Agar README mein is ko hatane ke baare mein kuch nahi likha, to maan lein ke data phansa hua hai.

docs.title: Worked example — aik client, teen zarooratein
docs.text:
Aik spice manufacturer (fmc demo client) teen cheezein maangta hai. Wahi framework, teen mukhtalif jawab:

(a) CRM — install karein. Real masla (leads WhatsApp mein rehte hain), official app (Frappe CRM, github.com/frappe/crm), version-16 branch, data exportable, owner: sales lead. Decision: bench get-app Frappe CRM. Client ko kabhi legacy ERPNext CRM par start na karein — woh v17 mein removal ke liye scheduled hai.

(b) Gate-pass register — khud banayein. Aik form, aik list, aik approval. Catalog mein koi app sirf yeh nahi karti, aur aik register ke liye poori app aik dependency hai jis ka koi faida nahi. Decision: Studio mein aik din mein bana lein — form, list view, approval step — Desktop par publish karein. (Yeh Studio example hai.)

(c) WhatsApp notifications — install karein. Real masla (customers kabhi email nahi parhte), maintained app, version branch mojood hai. Decision: Frappe WhatsApp Suite install karein (Business Cloud API + in-Desk chat + chatbot) — ya official WABA Integration agar client sirf Frappe-maintained code chahta hai. Order aur invoice alerts document events par bahar jayenge; chat UI us shared phone ki jagah le lega jo sales team aapas mein pass karti hai.

docs.title: Maintenance cost — har app aik upgrade dependency hai
docs.text: Install ki hui app install day ke baad free nahi hoti. Har upgrade par, har app aik aur branch hai jo check karni hai, aik aur migrate jo fail ho sakta hai, aik aur staging test. Agle upgrade se pehle, har installed app ki list banayein aur 5 sawal dobara poochein — aik app jo pichle saal sahi thi, is saal abandoned ho sakti hai. Poora upgrade process Upgrade guide mein hai.

docs.title: bench get-app se pehle — checklist
docs.text:
• [ ] Aik real project par aik real masla, likh kar named
  • [ ] Repo check kiya: recent release, issues ke jawab, aap ke Frappe version ke liye version branch
  • [ ] Pehle staging par uninstall + data export test kiya
  • [ ] Jab yeh toot jaye to us ke liye aik owner named
  • [ ] Staging par install kiya, real user accounts se test kiya (Administrator se nahi)
  • [ ] Upgrade impact note kiya: upgrade checklist par aik aur app

docs.title: Sources
docs.text: App facts Apps Catalog se (66 apps, 11 categories, Nov 2026 mein verified) aur ERPNext lessons se. Decision rules asal NexTash projects se; upgrade cost Upgrade guide se.

docs.title: Aam Ghaltiyan — jo asal projects mein waqai hoti hain
docs.text: Mukhtasar, concrete, NexTash ke asal kaam se. Har ghalti ke saath uska fix bhi hai. Agar aap ko apna project kisi bhi section mein nazar aaye, to pehle usi ko fix karein.

docs.title: 1. Kharab field layout
docs.text:
Ghalti: aik DocType jis mein 20 fields aik hi lambi column mein stacked hon, na Section Breaks hon, na Column Breaks, aur har cheez par "In List View" tick ho. Form aik aisi scroll ban jata hai jo koi nahi parhta, aur list 12 columns chauri ho jati hai.

Fix — paanch rules:

  1. Pehle form parhein. Field add karne se pehle maujooda form kholein. Jo flow pehle se hai, usi mein add karein.
  2. insert_after se place karein. Har naya field us field ka naam bataye jis ke baad woh aaye. Jin fields ki koi position nahi hoti, woh neeche dher mein ja girti hain.
  3. Har row mein do fields. Field, Column Break, field — phir Section Break se agli row shuru hoti hai.
  4. Child table ka apna section ho. Us se pehle aik clear label ("Items") wala Section Break ho.
  5. List View mein zyada se zyada 4–5 columns. Sirf woh fields jin ko dekh kar user record dhoondhta hai.

Kharab layout wale maujooda forms waisay hi rehne dein — ye rules aage banne wale fields par lagte hain, purane forms ko dobara banane par nahi.

docs.title: 2. Hooks ghalat jagah par
docs.text:
Ghalti: business logic hooks.py ke andar likhi ho, apni app ke apne DocType ke liye doc_events, ya aik "*" doc_event jo har DocType ke har save par chale. Ya is se bhi bura: kisi behaviour ko badalne ke liye ERPNext ki files ko seedha edit kar dena.

Fix — placement ke rules:

Kya Kahan jata hai Apne DocType par logic Us ka controller (validate, on_submit, …) Doosri app ke DocType par logic hooks.py mein doc_events → apni app mein aik override file Doosri app ke DocType ke liye Form JS public/js/<name>.js + hooks.py mein doctype_js Custom Field / Property Setter Fixtures, module se filter kar ke

Aur sakht rules:

  • hooks.py aik registry hai, code file nahi. Sirf dotted paths, koi logic nahi.
  • Kabhi doosri app ki files edit na karein. "Sirf aik chhoti line" bhi nahi. Apni app se extend karein, warna agli update usay mita degi.
  • Kabhi "*" doc_events nahi jab tak logic waqai har DocType par lagoo na hota ho — woh har save par, har jagah, hamesha chalta hai.
  • Aik hi DocType ke liye duplicate frappe.ui.form.on blocks nahi — maujooda handler ko extend karein.
  • Validation server par karein. JS sirf UX ke liye hai. Jo rule sirf JS mein enforce ho, woh rule hi nahi — API usay bypass kar deti hai.
# hooks.py — registry only
doc_events = {
    "Sales Invoice": {
        "validate": "my_app.selling.overrides.sales_invoice.validate",
    },
}

docs.title: 3. Permissions ki ghaltiyan
docs.text:
Ghalti: users jo apne documents dekh nahi sakte, ya users jo sab kuch dekh sakte hain. Dono aam tor par wohi teen ghaltiyan hoti hain.

Fix:

  • JS mein field chhupana security nahi hai. Koi bhi field ko API se parh sakta hai. Is ke bajaye permlevel (field-level permission) use karein.
  • Bina wajah ignore_permissions=True. Agar aap ye pass karte hain, to us ke saath aik comment mein wajah likhein. Warna agla developer isay har jagah copy kar lega.
  • allow_guest=True kisi bhi cheez par jo write karti ho. Guest endpoints read-only hote hain, rate-limited hote hain, aur har input ko validate karna zaroori hota hai.
  • v16: has_permission ko saaf True return karna hota hai. None return karna ab access deny kar deta hai (v14/v15 mein None ka matlab tha "koi raye nahi"). Jo hook True return karna bhool jaye, woh sab ko lock out kar deta hai.
  • Sharing aik role nahi hai. Aik document share karne se sirf us aik document tak access milti hai — user ko DocType par read permission phir bhi chahiye hoti hai. Jo user khaali list dekhta hai, us ke documents aam tor par User Permission (Company, Branch) chhupa rahi hoti hai, koi missing share nahi.
  • Whitelisted methods pehle permission check karte hain. Data return karne se pehle frappe.has_permission(..., throw=True) se check karein, baad mein nahi. Jo method @frappe.whitelist() ke baghair ho, usay form ya API se bilkul call nahi kiya ja sakta (403).

403? Is order mein check karein: DocType par role permission → User Permission jo document chhupa rahi ho → has_permission hook jo None ya False return kar raha ho → whitelisted method jis mein decorator ya check missing ho → API token ka user jis ke paas role na ho.

docs.title: 4. Performance ki ghaltiyan
docs.text:
Ghalti: aik report ya submit jo 30 seconds le, aam tor par in mein se aik wajah se.

Fix:

N+1 queries — sab se bari wajah. Loop ke andar aik value parhne ke liye kabhi frappe.get_doc na karein.

# ❌ one query per row
for row in self.items:
    group = frappe.db.get_value("Item", row.item_code, "item_group")

# ✅ one query, then a dict lookup
item_codes = [row.item_code for row in self.items]
groups = dict(frappe.get_all("Item",
    filters={"name": ("in", item_codes)},
    fields=["name", "item_group"], as_list=True))
for row in self.items:
    group = groups.get(row.item_code)
  • Sahi read use karein. Aik field ke liye frappe.db.get_value / frappe.get_cached_value — get_doc nahi. Aggregates SQL mein karein, rows ko Python mein load kar ke nahi.
  • Frequent filters mein use hone wale fields par search_index lagayein.
  • Request ke andar kabhi frappe.db.commit() na karein. Framework commit karta hai. (Sirf lambe background jobs / patches mein allowed hai, batches mein.)
  • Slow kaam background job mein bhejein. Kuch seconds se zyada ka kaam — bulk processing, bulk email, external APIs, bari reports — frappe.enqueue(..., queue="long") se jata hai, aur user ko completion par notify kiya jata hai.
  • refresh se server ko us data ke liye call na karein jo kabhi-kabhi badalta ho. Aik dafa onload mein load karein, ya controller se frm.doc.__onload set karein.

docs.title: 5. Ledger aur stock — na-qabil-e-maafi ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Kabhi GL Entry ya Stock Ledger Entry seedha insert na karein. Ye submit par automatically banti hain. Agar koi posting missing hai, to document ghalat hai — document ko fix karein.
  • Submitted document ke fields kabhi edit na karein. Cancel karein aur amend karein. Edited submitted document aur us ka ledger hamesha ke liye disagree karte hain.
  • Bin ko haath se kabhi edit na karein. Balance ghalat hai? Stock Reconciliation karein, posting date aur reason ke saath.

docs.title: Pre-ship checklist
docs.text:
Kisi bhi custom app ke client ke paas jane se pehle, check karein:

  • [ ] Har naya field insert_after se place ho, har row mein 2, child tables apne section mein, ≤ 5 list columns
  • [ ] hooks.py mein koi logic nahi; koi "*" doc_events nahi; doosri apps mein koi edit nahi
  • [ ] Validation server par ho, sirf JS mein nahi
  • [ ] Bina comment ke koi ignore_permissions=True nahi; koi allow_guest writes nahi
  • [ ] Loop mein koi get_doc nahi; slow kaam enqueue ho
  • [ ] Haath se likhi koi GL / SLE rows nahi; submitted documents mein koi edit nahi
  • [ ] bench --site <site> migrate run ho, aur us se pehle backup liya gaya ho

docs.title: Go-Live Checklist
docs.text: Go-live aik project hai, aik din nahi. System tab ready hota hai jab data theek ho, users apna kaam kar sakte hon, aur purana system ab bhi aap ko bacha sakta ho. Aik distributor perfect code aur ghalat opening stock ke saath live gaya — pehle mahine ki reports fiction thi. Ye checklist is liye hai ke ye dobara na ho.

docs.title: 1. Data import order
docs.text:
Dependency ki tarteeb mein import karein — aik transaction us master ko reference nahi kar sakti jo abhi maujood hi nahi hai:

1. Company → Chart of Accounts → Cost Centers → Tax Templates
2. Masters: Item (+ Item Group, UOM, Warehouse), Customer, Supplier,
   Price List, BOM
3. Opening balances: stock + accounts (section 2)
4. Open transactions: open Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, open
   Sales/Purchase Invoices, open Payment Entries

Rules: aik DocType ke liye aik file, Data Import se import karein (v16.50 mein step-based wizard hai — usi ko use karein). Pehle test import par validate karein; kabhi seedha live mein import na karein. Har import ko reconcile karein: file mein row counts vs system mein rows, das records haath se khol kar dekhein. Ghalat data file mein fix kiya jata hai aur dobara import kiya jata hai — file hi record hai.

docs.title: 2. Opening balances
docs.text:
Stock — Stock Reconciliation, posting date = cutover date, har line par reason ke saath. Bin quantities physical count se match karni chahiye. Agar warehouse count aur sheet mein farq ho, to count jeet ti hai aur farq likh diya jata hai, chhupaya nahi jata.

Accounts — customer aur supplier ke opening balances Opening Invoice Creation Tool se (har party ke liye aik opening invoice, cutover date wali), bank aur cash ka opening Journal Entry se. Phir woh test jo matter karta hai: Trial Balance ko balance hona chahiye (debits = credits) go-live se pehle. Agar balance na ho, to go-live ruk jata hai.

Users ke aane se pehle reconcile karein: books mein stock value vs stock report, Accounts Receivable vs customer ledger, Accounts Payable vs supplier ledger. Teen numbers, teen matches, koi exception nahi.

docs.title: 3. Permissions & roles
docs.text:
• Role Permission Manager mein roles aur permissions set karein — har DocType, har role ke liye, har shakhs ke liye nahi. User Permissions (Company, Warehouse, Branch) un users ke liye jo sirf apni branch ya warehouse dekh sakte hon.
  • Asal user accounts se test karein. Accountant, store keeper, sales rep ke tor par log in karein — aur un ka asal kaam karein: Sales Invoice banayein, Stock Entry submit karein, Purchase Order approve karein. Administrator ke tor par test karne se kuch sabit nahi hota; Administrator sab kuch kar sakta hai.
  • Portal users (customers, suppliers) ko bhi test karein — woh portal se log in karte hain aur sirf apne documents dekhte hain.
  • v16 par, has_permission hooks ko explicit True return karna lazmi hai (dekhein Lesson 09). None return karne wala hook sab ko lock kar deta hai.
  • JS mein field chhupana security nahi hai — permlevel use karein. Validation server par karein, sirf JS mein nahi (dekhein Common mistakes).

docs.title: 4. User training
docs.text:
• NexTash client ke super users ko train karta hai; super users apni teams ko train karte hain. Poore staff ko seedha train karna scale nahi karta aur yaad bhi nahi rehta.
  • Har role ke liye material, har kaam ke liye aik page: "How to make a Sales Invoice", "How to receive stock", "How to approve a leave application". Chhoti SOPs, woh manual nahi jo koi parhta hi nahi.
  • Training sample data wali training site par hoti hai, kabhi live par nahi. Users training mein cheezein tor kar seekhte hain; users live mein cheezein tor dein to business ruk jata hai.
  • Har role training mein apna asal kaam aik dafa karta hai — pehla asal invoice pehla invoice nahi hona chahiye jo kabhi banaya gaya ho.

docs.title: 5. Cutover plan
docs.text:
• Freeze date likh kar agree ki jati hai. Friday close ke baad purane system mein koi nayi transaction nahi. Freeze ke baad ki har cheez ERPNext mein jati hai.
  • Final import Saturday ko: masters delta (hafte ke dauraan add kiye gaye customers ya items), opening balances, open transactions.
  • Delta entries: final import ke baad jo kuch reh gaya ho, woh Monday subah haath se enter kiya jata hai aur list se tick kar diya jata hai.
  • Communication: har user ko freeze date, go-live date, aur ye pata ho ke stuck hone par kis ko call karna hai. Client ka manager is ka elaan karta hai.

docs.title: 6. Backups & restore test
docs.text:
bench --site <site> backup --with-files
  • Scheduled backups go-live se pehle on hon (v16 par, offsite backups aik alag app hai — use install karein, ye na maan lein ke ye built in hai).
  • Go-live se pehle spare site par restore test kiya gaya ho. Jo backup kabhi restore nahi kiya gaya, woh backup nahi hai.
  • Backup files server se bahar rakhi jayein — database wali disk par backup aik copy hai, backup nahi.

docs.title: 7. Monitoring
docs.text: Pehle hafte mein, koi rozana check karta hai: Scheduler chal raha hai — bench doctor aur Desk mein Background Jobs list. Ruka hua scheduler matlab no emails, no notifications, no auto-reposts — khamoshi se. Email Queue drain ho rahi hai — emails bheji ja rahi hain, stuck nahi hain. Error Log saaf hai — har error parha gaya, sirf gina nahi gaya; aik error jo 200 dafa repeat ho, woh aik bug hai, use fix karein. Disk space — bhari hui disk database ko rok deti hai. Integrations end-to-end — payment gateway, WhatsApp, webhooks: go-live wale din har aik ki aik asal transaction.

docs.title: 8. Rollback / Plan B
docs.text:
• Purana system aik hafte tak chalane ke qabil rehta hai. Excel, purana ERP, paper register — jo bhi tha, woh go-live wale din delete nahi kiya jata.
  • Rollback trigger pehle se agree kiya jata hai: masalan "agar invoicing do ghante ke liye down ho, to hum purane system par wapas chale jate hain aur dobara plan karte hain." Ye ab sukoon se tay kiya jata hai, Monday ko panic mein nahi.
  • Rollback se pehle ERPNext mein enter kiya gaya data exportable hona chahiye — use bahar kaise nikalna hai (report export), ye pehle se pata ho, zaroorat parne se pehle.

docs.title: 9. Go-live day runbook
docs.text: Waqt Kaam Zimmedar 08:00 Scheduler, Email Queue, Error Log, disk check ki gayi; backup liya gaya NexTash 08:30 Users log in karte hain; har role apna workspace kholta hai Super users 09:00 Pehla asal Sales Invoice sales team ke saath mil kar banaya gaya Sales super user 10:00 Pehli stock movement Bin se check ki gayi Store keeper 12:00 Pehli Payment Entry, bank balance check kiya gaya Accountant 14:00 Error Log review kiya gaya; har error fix kiya gaya ya owner ke saath log kiya gaya NexTash 16:00 Day-1 sign-off call: kya kaam kiya, kya blocked hai, kal ki list Client manager + NexTash 17:00 Backup liya gaya; day-1 notes likh diye gaye NexTash

docs.title: Go-live checklist
docs.text:
Data - [ ] Masters tarteeb se import kiye gaye, row counts reconcile kiye gaye - [ ] Opening stock physical count se reconcile kiya gaya - [ ] Opening balances import kiye gaye; Trial Balance balance hai - [ ] AR / AP / stock value ledgers se reconcile kiye gaye - [ ] Open transactions import ki gayi hain (orders, open invoices)

Permissions - [ ] Roles har DocType ke liye set hain; User Permissions har branch/warehouse ke liye - [ ] Asal user accounts se test kiya gaya, Administrator se nahi - [ ] Portal users test kiye gaye

Training - [ ] Super users train kiye gaye; har role ke liye SOPs likhi gayi hain - [ ] Har role ne training site par apna asal kaam aik dafa kiya

Cutover - [ ] Freeze date likh kar agree ki gayi; final import ho gaya - [ ] Monday subah ke liye delta list tayyar hai

Backups & monitoring - [ ] Scheduled backups on hain; spare site par restore test kiya gaya - [ ] Scheduler, Email Queue, Error Log check kiye gaye; integrations end-to-end test ki gayi hain

Rollback - [ ] Purana system aik hafte tak chalane ke qabil hai - [ ] Rollback trigger client se agree kiya gaya

docs.title: Practice Project — Masala Factory
docs.text:
Lessons parhne se aap ko pieces samajh aate hain. Yeh project aap ko sikhata hai ke woh pieces aik saath kaise fit hote hain. Aap aik chhoti masala manufacturer — Lal Mirch Foods — ke liye aik working ERP banayenge: khaali bench se live order-to-cash flow tak, apni app mein, apni site par.

Factory kachchi mirch khareedti hai, use pees kar 1 kg ke pack mein Red Chilli Powder banati hai, distributors ko bechti hai, dispatch se pehle quality check karti hai, invoice banati hai, aur payment leti hai. Har step mein aik real ERPNext document use hota hai — wohi jo lessons sikhate hain — plus aik custom DocType aap ka apna (Lesson 03 wala Gate Pass).

Waqt: taqreeban 3–4 shaamein, har phase taqreeban aik ghanta. Nateeja: aik site jo aap client ko demo kar sakte hain, aur yeh confidence ke agla project aap scratch se bana sakte hain.

docs.title: Shuru karne se pehle
docs.text:
Aap ko chahiye: ERPNext v16 ke saath aik working bench (dekhein Lesson 02 — Bench, Sites & Apps). Phase 2 se pehle Lesson 03 — Your First DocType parh lein — wahan wala Gate Pass hi woh hai jis par aap kaam karenge.

Demo data — yeh names har jagah exactly aise hi use karein, taa ke har phase agle se mil jaye:

Master Values Company Lal Mirch Foods Items RAW-CHILLI — Raw Chilli (Whole), Kg, valuation rate 400 RCP-1KG — Red Chilli Powder 1 Kg Pack, Nos, standard rate 650 Warehouses Stores, Work In Progress, Finished Goods Customer Karachi Spice Traders Price List Standard Selling (default)

Flow jo aap bana rahe hain:

Gate Pass → BOM → Work Order → Stock Entry (Manufacture)
    → Sales Order → Delivery Note → Quality Inspection
    → Sales Invoice → Payment Entry → Report + Print Format

Har phase ke end par aik checkpoint hai — kuch aisa jo aap ko aage barhne se pehle karna aana chahiye. Checkpoints skip na karein; agar Phase 3 ka stock ghalat hai to Phase 4 chup chaap toot jayega.

docs.title: Phase 1 — Bench, site, app aur masters
docs.text: Uses: Lesson 02 — Bench, Sites & Apps

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. App aur site banayein:
cd ~/frappe-bench
bench new-app spice_factory
bench new-site spice.local --install-app erpnext
bench --site spice.local install-app spice_factory
  1. Is site ke liye developer mode on karein, taa ke Desk mein banaye gaye DocTypes aap ki app mein save hon:
bench --site spice.local set-config developer_mode 1
bench --site spice.local migrate
bench start

  1. Desk mein upar wali table ke masters banayein: Company (Lal Mirch Foods), Item RAW-CHILLI (Item Group Raw Material, UOM Kg) aur RCP-1KG (Item Group Products, UOM Nos, Standard Selling Rate 650), Warehouses (Stores, Work In Progress, Finished Goods), Customer (Karachi Spice Traders).

  2. Aik Stock Entry, purpose Material Receipt, t_warehouse Stores, valuation rate 400 se 200 kg RAW-CHILLI Stores mein daal dein. Submit karein. Yeh aap ka opening stock hai — is ke baghair Phase 3 ke paas consume karne ko kuch nahi hoga.

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Ab aap ko browser mein spice.local khol kar apni app installed nazar aani chahiye, aur Stock Balance report mein Stores mein 200 kg RAW-CHILLI milna chahiye.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• App install karne ke baad migrate skip karna. App listed to ho jati hai, lekin us ki tables tab tak nahi banti jab tak aap migrate na karein.
  • Masters ghalat site par banana. URL bar mein site ka naam check karein — spice.local, koi doosri dev site nahi.
  • Developer mode bhool jana. Is ke baghair Phase 2 ka Gate Pass sirf database mein save hota hai, app mein nahi, aur aap use ship nahi kar sakte.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Gate Pass DocType bilkul Lesson 03 jaisa banayein — wohi fields, wohi order:
Fieldname Label Type Notes naming_series Series Select Options: GP-.YYYY.-.#### gate_pass_date Date Date Default: Today visitor_name Visitor Data Required company Company Link Options: Company purpose Purpose Select Visit / Delivery / Pickup items Items Table Options: Gate Pass Item remarks Remarks Small Text

Child table Gate Pass Item: item_name (Data, In List View), qty (Int, In List View), direction (Select: In / Out). Autoname ko naming_series par set karein.

  1. Aik Client Script add karein — date khud bhar jaye, aur Delivery ya Pickup pass baghair items ke refuse ho jaye:
// spice_factory/spice_factory/doctype/gate_pass/gate_pass.js
frappe.ui.form.on("Gate Pass", {
    refresh(frm) {
        // New passes always start with today — the guard should not type it.
        if (frm.is_new()) {
            frm.set_value("gate_pass_date", frappe.datetime.nowdate());
        }
    },
    validate(frm) {
        if (
            (frm.doc.purpose === "Delivery" || frm.doc.purpose === "Pickup") &&
            !frm.doc.items.length
        ) {
            frappe.throw(__("Add at least one item for a Delivery or Pickup pass."));
        }
    },
});

bench --site spice.local migrate chalakar Desk reload karein.

  1. Do passes banayein: aik Delivery (supplier 50 kg RAW-CHILLI lata hai, direction In) aur aik Visit (aik buyer, koi items nahi). Dono submit karein.

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Ab aap ko aik minute se kam mein Gate Pass banana aana chahiye, list mein woh GP-2026-0001 nazar aana chahiye, aur agar aap baghair items ke Delivery pass save karne ki koshish karein to saaf error milna chahiye.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Client Script ghalat file mein daalna. Form behaviour gate_pass.js mein rehta hai, DocType folder ke andar — Server Script mein nahi, hooks.py mein nahi.
  • Script add karne ke baad migrate bhool jana. .js file tab hi pick hoti hai jab DocType app se dobara load ho.
  • refresh mein validate karna, validate mein nahi. refresh har dafa chalta hai jab form khulta hai; wahan check lagane se error tab bhi aata hai jab user sirf dekh raha ho.

docs.title: Phase 3 — Banayein: BOM, Work Order, Stock Entry
docs.text: Uses: Manufacturing, Stock & Inventory

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. RCP-1KG ke liye aik BOM banayein, quantity 1:
Item Qty UOM RAW-CHILLI 1.05 Kg

(1 kg powder ke liye 1.05 kg kachchi mirch chahiye — peesne mein taqreeban 5% waste hota hai. BOM submit karein.)

  1. Aik Work Order banayein: production_item RCP-1KG, qty 100, bom_no (BOM se fetch hoga), fg_warehouse Finished Goods, wip_warehouse Work In Progress. Submit karein. Ab Work Order plan reserve kar chuka hai: 105 kg kachchi mirch andar, 100 pack bahar.

  2. Work Order ke against aik Stock Entry, purpose Manufacture, post karein:

Row Item Qty Source Target 1 RAW-CHILLI 105 Stores — 2 RCP-1KG 100 — Finished Goods

Submit karein. Stock Balance mein ab Stores mein 95 kg RAW-CHILLI aur Finished Goods mein 100 pack RCP-1KG hone chahiye.

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Ab aap ko Stock Ledger se bata sakhna chahiye ke har kilo kahan gaya: 200 andar, 105 consume, 100 pack produce. Agar numbers match nahi kar rahe to aage na barhein — Phase 4 wohi stock bechta hai jo Phase 3 ne banaya hai.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Work Order submit karne se pehle Stock Entry post karna. Manufacture entry ko link karne ke liye submitted Work Order chahiye.
  • Ghalat purpose. Purpose Material Receipt wali Manufacture entry stock to move kar deti hai, lekin raw material kabhi consume nahi karti — ledger balance nahi karega.
  • Submitted Work Order ko qty badalne ke liye edit karna. Cancel karke amend karein — woh pehle hi stock reserve aur move kar chuka hai.

docs.title: Phase 4 — Bechna: Sales Order → Delivery Note → Sales Invoice
docs.text: Uses: Selling, Stock & Inventory, Accounting, Lesson 05 — Server Scripts & Document Events

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Karachi Spice Traders ke liye aik Sales Order banayein: item RCP-1KG, qty 50, rate 650, delivery_date agle hafte, warehouse Finished Goods. Submit karein. (Order-to-cash hamesha Quotation → Sales Order → Delivery Note → Sales Invoice → Payment Entry hota hai.)

  2. Sales Order se Create → Delivery Note banayein. Item row check karein: us mein against_sales_order wapas order ki taraf point karta hai, aur warehouse Finished Goods hai. Submit karein — stock 50 pack reh jayega.

  3. Delivery Note se Create → Sales Invoice banayein. Totals check karein (50 × 650 = 32,500), phir submit karein.

  4. Aik guard lagayein taa ke yeh kabhi oversell na ho. validate hook drafts ko bhi block kar dega, is liye on_submit hook karein:

# spice_factory/hooks.py
doc_events = {
    "Sales Order": {
        "on_submit": "spice_factory.api.check_stock_before_submit",
    },
}

# spice_factory/api.py
import frappe
from frappe import _


def check_stock_before_submit(doc, method):
    """Block submitting a Sales Order we cannot fulfil from stock."""
    for row in doc.items:
        if not row.warehouse:
            continue
        available = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Bin",
            {"item_code": row.item_code, "warehouse": row.warehouse},
            "actual_qty",
        ) or 0
        if row.qty > available:
            frappe.throw(
                _("Not enough stock for {0} in {1}: need {2}, have {3}").format(
                    row.item_code, row.warehouse, row.qty, available
                )
            )

bench --site spice.local migrate chalakar test karein: 60 pack ka doosra Sales Order (sirf 50 bache hain) submit hone se refuse hona chahiye; 40 pack wala pass hona chahiye.

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Ab aap aik sale ko end to end trace kar sakhte hain: Sales Order SO-0001 → Delivery Note → Sales Invoice SINV-0001, aur dikha sakhte hain ke invoice ka outstanding_amount payment tak 32,500 hai.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Delivery se pehle invoice banana. Invoice money document hai; Delivery Note stock document hai. Delivery Note skip karein to stock kabhi move nahi hoga.
  • Submit-only rule ke liye validate hook karna. validate har save par chalta hai, is liye drafts bhi block ho jate hain. "Commit karne se mana karna" ke liye on_submit sahi event hai.
  • Stock check frappe.db.sql se karna. Bin par frappe.db.get_value use karein — raw SQL yahan kuch bypass nahi karta, lekin yeh aik aadat hai jo doosri jagah permissions torti hai. (Lesson 08 dekhein.)

docs.title: Phase 5 — Dispatch se pehle quality gate
docs.text: Uses: Quality

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. RCP-1KG ke liye aik Quality Inspection Template banayein, do parameters ke saath:
Parameter Type Acceptance Moisture % Numeric Minimum 0, Maximum 10 Colour Value-based Accepted value: Red

  1. RCP-1KG Item par Inspection Required before Delivery tick karein aur Quality Inspection Template set karein. Ab se ERPNext khud gate enforce karta hai: is item ka Delivery Note tab tak submit nahi ho sakta jab tak passing inspection mojood na ho — aur rejected inspection use poori tarah block kar deti hai.

  2. Doosra Delivery Note banayein (Phase 4 wale 40-pack Sales Order se). Item row mein Quality Inspection field par click karke aik inspection banayein: inspection_type Outgoing, reference_type Delivery Note, sample_size 5. Readings daalein — Moisture 8%, Colour Red — aur submit karein. status Accepted ho jayega.

  3. Delivery Note submit karein. Yeh pass ho jayega, kyun ke gate pass ho chuka hai.

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Ab aap aik Delivery Note dikha sakhte hain jo apni inspection pass hone tak blocked tha, aur bata sakhte hain ke kyun: inspection transaction ki precondition hai, parallel activity nahi.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Inspection ghalat type ki banana. Outgoing dispatch ke liye hai; Incoming purchases ke liye; In Process Job Cards ke liye. Ghalat type ghalat gate pass karta hai.
  • Template set karna lekin Item checkbox tick na karna. Template akele kuch nahi karta — Item ka inspection flag hi gate on karta hai.
  • Dispatch ke baad inspect karna. Agar maal ja chuka hai to inspection sirf paperwork hai. Check Delivery Note submit hone se pehle hona chahiye.

docs.title: Phase 6 — Payment lein, aur gate pass approve karwayein
docs.text: Uses: Accounting, Lesson 10 — Workflows & Assignments

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Sales Invoice SINV-0001 khol kar Create → Payment Entry banayein. Fields check karein: payment_type Receive, party_type Customer, party Karachi Spice Traders, paid_amount 32,500. Get Outstanding Invoices par click karein, poori amount SINV-0001 ke against allocate karein (references table: reference_doctype Sales Invoice, reference_name invoice, allocated_amount 32,500), aur submit karein. Invoice ka outstanding_amount ab 0 hai aur us ka status Paid hai.

  2. Ab Gate Pass ko approval dein. Aik Workflow banayein, Document Type Gate Pass, Is Active tick karein:

State Docstatus Draft 0 Pending Approval 0 Approved 1 Rejected 0

Transitions: Draft → Pending Approval ("Send for Approval", allowed role Gatekeeper), Pending Approval → Approved ("Approve", allowed role Manufacturing Manager), Pending Approval → Rejected ("Reject", allowed role Manufacturing Manager).

  1. Gatekeeper ke tor par aik Gate Pass banakar approval ke liye bhejein. Manufacturing Manager user se log in karke use approve karein. Dekhein ke Submit button gayab ho gaya hai — ab document ko workflow chalata hai.

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Ab aap aik Paid invoice dikha sakhte hain jis ka outstanding amount zero hai, aur aik Gate Pass dikha sakhte hain jisay aik hi shakhs bana aur approve nahi kar sakta.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Get Outstanding Invoices par click kiye baghair payment allocate karna. references table khaali rehti hai, paisa unallocated advance ban kar gir jata hai, aur invoice Unpaid rehti hai.
  • Approver role sab ko de dena. Aik workflow jis mein creator apna pass khud approve kar sake, woh control nahi, decoration hai.
  • Workflow inactive chhor dena. Inactive Workflow kuch nahi badalta — purana Submit button rehta hai, aur approval kabhi hoti hi nahi.

docs.title: Phase 7 — Dekhein: Order-to-Cash report + invoice print format
docs.text: Uses: Lesson 08 — Reports & Print Formats

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Aik Script Report "Order to Cash" banayein (Report Type: Script Report, Reference DocType: Sales Invoice, Module: aap ki app), is code ke saath:
# spice_factory/spice_factory/report/order_to_cash/order_to_cash.py
import frappe
from frappe import _


def execute(filters=None):
    filters = frappe._dict(filters or {})
    return get_columns(), get_data(filters)


def get_columns():
    return [
        {"label": _("Invoice"), "fieldname": "name", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Sales Invoice", "width": 130},
        {"label": _("Date"), "fieldname": "posting_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
        {"label": _("Customer"), "fieldname": "customer", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Customer", "width": 180},
        {"label": _("Grand Total"), "fieldname": "grand_total", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
        {"label": _("Outstanding"), "fieldname": "outstanding_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
        {"label": _("Status"), "fieldname": "status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100},
    ]


def get_data(filters):
    query_filters = {"docstatus": 1}
    if filters.get("customer"):
        query_filters["customer"] = filters.customer
    if filters.get("from_date") and filters.get("to_date"):
        query_filters["posting_date"] = ("between", [filters.from_date, filters.to_date])
    return frappe.get_list(
        "Sales Invoice",
        filters=query_filters,
        fields=["name", "posting_date", "customer", "grand_total", "outstanding_amount", "status"],
        order_by="posting_date desc",
    )

// spice_factory/spice_factory/report/order_to_cash/order_to_cash.js
frappe.query_reports["Order to Cash"] = {
    filters: [
        { fieldname: "from_date", label: __("From Date"), fieldtype: "Date", default: frappe.datetime.month_start() },
        { fieldname: "to_date", label: __("To Date"), fieldtype: "Date", default: frappe.datetime.month_end() },
        { fieldname: "customer", label: __("Customer"), fieldtype: "Link", options: "Customer" },
    ],
};

Ise chalakar dekhein: SINV-0001 mein Grand Total 32,500, Outstanding 0, Status Paid nazar aana chahiye.

  1. Sales Invoice ke liye aik Print Format banayein (Print Format Type: Jinja), apni factory ke header aur items table ke saath:
<div style="text-align: center;">
  <h2>{{ doc.company }}</h2>
  <p>Tax Invoice — {{ doc.name }}</p>
</div>
<p><strong>Customer:</strong> {{ doc.customer_name }}<br>
<strong>Date:</strong> {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.posting_date) }}<br>
<strong>Due Date:</strong> {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.due_date) }}</p>
<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
  <tr><th style="text-align: left;">Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Rate</th><th>Amount</th></tr>
  {% for row in doc.items %}
  <tr>
    <td>{{ row.item_name }}</td>
    <td>{{ row.qty }}</td>
    <td>{{ row.get_formatted("rate") }}</td>
    <td>{{ row.get_formatted("amount") }}</td>
  </tr>
  {% endfor %}
</table>
<p style="text-align: right;"><strong>Grand Total: {{ doc.get_formatted("grand_total") }}</strong></p>

SINV-0001 ko is se print karke check karein ke totals Desk se match karte hain.

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Ab aap apni report se jawab de sakhte hain ke "kis se kitne paise lene hain" — aur customer ko aik printed invoice de sakhte hain jo aap ki factory ki lagti hai, default template ki nahi.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Query mein filter karne ke bajaye Python mein filter karna. Filters query_filters mein rehte hain — har invoice fetch karke loop mein filter karna N+1 ghalti hai, report ki shakal mein (Lesson 14 dekhein).
  • User-facing read ke liye frappe.db.sql use karna. Yeh tamam permission checks bypass kar deta hai. frappe.get_list un ka ehtram karta hai — wohi use karein.
  • Print format mein company ka naam hard-code karna. {{ doc.company }} use karein — format har company par reuse hota hai.

docs.title: Phase 8 — Lock karein: permissions, backup, go-live
docs.text: Uses: Lesson 09 — Permissions & Roles, Lesson 21 — Ops, Go-Live Checklist

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Aik Role "Gatekeeper" banayein aur use sirf Gate Pass ki permissions dein: read, write, create — submit nahi, delete nahi, Sales Invoice ya Payment Entry tak access nahi. Ise guard ke user ko assign karein. Us user se log in karke confirm karein: Gate Pass chalta hai, Sales Invoice nahi khulti.

  2. Done kehne se pehle backup lein:

bench --site spice.local backup

Check karein ke file sites/spice.local/private/backups/ mein mojood hai.

  1. Is site ke liye Go-Live Checklist par chalein: opening balances (aap ki 200 kg receipt), permissions (step 1), training (guard ko Gate Pass dikhayein, manager ko approval dikhayein), aur rollback plan (step 2 wale backup se restore).

docs.title: Checkpoint
docs.text: Ab aap site kisi aur ko de sakhte hain: woh apne role se log in karega, sirf apna kaam karega, aur agar bench mar jaye to sab kuch backup se restore ho sakta hai.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Permissions ko Administrator ke tor par test karna. Administrator ko sab kuch nazar aata hai. Asli user accounts se test karein, warna aap ne kuch test hi nahi kiya.
  • Har kaam ke liye aik role. "Sab kuch karne wala" role hi woh tareeqa hai jis se guard invoices cancel karne ke qabil ho jata hai.
  • Go-live se pehle backup na lena. Pehla backup hamesha disaster ke agle din liya jata hai. Abhi lein.

docs.title: Aage kya banayein
docs.text:
Aap ki factory chal rahi hai. Yeh agle real features hain, usi order mein jis mein client inhein mangega:

  1. Production Plan — open Sales Orders se Work Orders khud ba khud banayein, haath se banane ke bajaye. Dekhein Manufacturing.
  2. Batch tracking — har RAW-CHILLI receipt ko Batch No dein aur sab se pehle purana stock bechein (FEFO). Dekhein Stock & Inventory.
  3. Low-stock alert — aik nightly Scheduler job jo email kare jab RAW-CHILLI 50 kg se neeche jaye. Dekhein Lesson 11 — Scheduler & Background Jobs.
  4. Distributor portal — Karachi Spice Traders ko un ke apne orders aur invoices dekhne dein, aur kuch nahi. Dekhein Lesson 19 — Website & Portal.
  5. Insights dashboard — monthly sales, outstanding amounts, aur stock value aik page par. Dekhein Lesson 18 — Insights.

docs.title: Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain
docs.text: Yeh project woh demo hai jo NexTash pehli meeting mein aik manufacturing client ko dikhata hai: wohi Gate Pass, wohi masala flow, wohi quality gate — laptop par chal raha hai, client ke apne numbers daal kar. Aik prospect jo apna order das minute mein Sales Order se Paid invoice tak jata dekh le, woh "ERPNext yeh karta hai?" poochna band karke "hum kab shuru kar sakte hain?" poochne lagta hai.

docs.title: Sources
