docs.text: DocType fields ERPNext v16 source (Sales Order, Delivery Note Item, Stock Entry, Quality Inspection, Payment Entry) aur ERPNext docs (order-to-cash flow, Quality Inspection enforcement, Payment Entry references) se verify kiye gaye. Lesson links is hub ki apni lessons ki taraf point karte hain; Gate Pass fields bilkul Lesson 03 jaisi hain.

docs.title: Upgrade Guide — v14 → v15 → v16
docs.text: Upgrade aik project hai, sirf command nahi. Neeche diya gaya har rule kisi aise upgrade se aaya hai jo ghalat ho gaya tha — aam tor par is liye ke kisi ne seedha production par chala diya tha.

docs.title: Usool
docs.text:
1. Aik waqt mein aik major version. v14 → v15, verify karein, phir v15 → v16. Kabhi v15 skip na karein — v16 ke patches pehle se maan kar chalte hain ke v15 ka schema pehle se maujood hai.
  2. Hamesha pehle staging. Poora upgrade production data ki copy par chalta hai.
  3. Jo backup kabhi restore nahi kiya gaya, woh backup nahi hai. Pehle staging par restore test karein.
  4. Har custom app ke liye target version ki branch chahiye — warna use pehle hata diya jata hai.

docs.title: 1. Readiness check
docs.text:
Pehle ye tay karein ke aap kis version se upgrade kar rahe hain — andaze se nahi, asal source se:

grep __version__ apps/frappe/frappe/__init__.py apps/erpnext/erpnext/__init__.py
bench version

Phir frappe_core_skills se upgrade scan chalaiyein (/frappe-upgrade-check): ye aap ki apps mein neeche wali tables mein di gayi har removed ya changed API ko dhoondhta hai aur files ki list deta hai. Pehle in hits ko fix karein — staging par mile to delay hoti hai, production par outage.

Target version ke liye minimum runtime (frappe-upgrade skill se): v15 ko Python 3.10–3.11 aur Node 18/20 chahiye; v16 ko Python 3.14+ (purane versions SyntaxError dete hain) aur Node 24+ chahiye. MariaDB 10.6+ dono par; v16 ke liye Ubuntu 24.04 recommended hai.

Shuru karne se pehle, kagaz par list bana lein: har custom app, Server Script, Workflow, print format aur integration (payment gateway, WhatsApp, email). Har aik toot sakta hai, aur har aik ka aik owner hona chahiye.

docs.title: 2. Backup — aur sabit karein ke restore hota hai
docs.text:
bench --site <site> backup --with-files --compress

Phir us backup ko staging site par restore karein aur confirm karein ke site khulti hai aur aik document banaya ja sakta hai. Server ka snapshot bhi lein (VM snapshot, ya Frappe Cloud backup), aur backup files ko upgrade ke kam az kam aik hafte baad tak sambhal kar rakhein — upgrade wale din unhein delete karna hi woh tareeqa hai jis se aik kharab upgrade disaster ban jata hai.

bench --site staging restore <backup.sql> --with-public-files <public.tar> --with-private-files <private.tar>

docs.title: 3. Upgrade order
docs.text:
Pehle Framework, phir ERPNext, phir alag apps, phir aap ki custom apps. Branches dependency ki tarteeb mein aik saath switch ki jati hain:

cd ~/frappe-bench
bench switch-to-branch version-15 frappe erpnext hrms  # v14 -> v15
bench --site <site> migrate
bench switch-to-branch version-16 frappe erpnext hrms  # v15 -> v16
bench --site <site> migrate

bench migrate har app ke patches dependency ki tarteeb mein chalata hai. HRMS, Frappe CRM, Helpdesk aur Payments alag apps hain — har aik ko apni version-15 / version-16 branch chahiye. Jis custom app ki koi branch nahi, use migrate fail hone ke baad nahi, pehle hata diya jata hai.

Frappe Cloud par koi bench commands nahi hain — version site dashboard mein switch kiya jata hai — lekin usool wohi hain. Jump ke baad, monthly patches bench update se aate hain (v16.61.0 aur us jaisi versions ab monthly hain — dekhein history).

docs.title: 4. Breaking changes — v14 → v15
docs.text:
Upgrade scan ko aksar ye hits milti hain:

Purana / hataya gaya Iski jagah use karein frappe.db.set() doc.db_set() frappe.db.update() frappe.db.set_value() frappe.db.set_value() on Singles frappe.db.set_single_value() frappe.db.set_temp / get_temp frappe.cache JS window.get_today / show_alert / user / roles frappe.datetime.get_today, frappe.show_alert, frappe.session.user, frappe.user_roles this in Client Scripts frm / cur_frm

Is ke ilawa: Server Scripts v15+ par by default disabled hain — dobara enable karne ke liye bench set-config -g server_script_enabled 1 chalaiyein. Event Streaming apni alag app mein chala gaya hai, aur frontend Vue 3 hai — custom Vue 2 components ko dobara likhna hoga; staging par check karein, live par nahi.

docs.title: 5. Breaking changes — v15 → v16
docs.text:
Change Kya karein has_permission hooks Explicit True return karna lazmi hai — None return karne par ab access deny ho jata hai DB commit inside document hooks Allowed nahi hai — framework khud commit karta hai Default list sort creation (pehle modified tha) — jahan order matter karta ho, wahan order_by explicitly pass karein frappe.get_doc(dt, name, field=val) Ab values set nahi karta frappe.sendmail(now=True) Ab commit nahi karta State-changing API methods Sirf POST (logout, upload_file, send_login_link) PDF Chrome renderer — wkhtmltopdf deprecated hai, v17 mein remove ho jayega Classic print formats Deprecated hain — v17 mein kaam karna band kar dein ge, abhi naye print designer par dobara banayein /app URL /desk — bookmarks aur hardcoded links fix karein Blog, Newsletter, Energy Points, Offsite backups Alag apps (offsite backups: frappe/offsite_backups)

Do app moves hain jin ki planning karni hai, upgrade ke waqt discover nahi karna: legacy ERPNext CRM v17 mein remove hone wala hai — client ko Frappe CRM app par abhi, v16 upgrade ke dauraan, shift karein. Aur standard workspace customisations upgrade par reset ho jati hain — unhein apni app mein fixtures ke tor par rakhein, kabhi Desk edits ke tor par nahi.

docs.title: 6. Patches — aur aik failed patch
docs.text:
Schema aur data ki tabdeeliyan patches/ mein hoti hain, aur patches.txt mein un ki entry hoti hai — har change ke liye aik patch, jahan mumkin ho idempotent. Jo patches kabhi skip nahi karne, woh hooks.py mein never_skip_patches = ["my_app.patches.v16_0.critical_data_fix"] ke tor par list hote hain.

Agar koi patch fail ho jaye, to migration ruk jati hai. Traceback parhein — woh patch aur row ka naam batata hai. Staging par data fix karein (aik ghalat value, aik duplicate, aik missing master), patch ko nahi. Database ko haath se edit kar ke patch ko done dikhana kabhi na karein — agli migrate us jhoot par bharosa karegi. Dobara bench --site <site> migrate chalaiyein; ye failed patch se dobara shuru hoti hai. bench migrate --skip-failing sirf non-critical failures ke liye hai — aik skipped patch debt ki entry hai, kamyabi nahi.

Aik spice-factory client ke paas aik dafa duplicate batch number par patch fail hua tha. Fix ye tha ke staging par duplicates ko merge kiya gaya, phir migrate dobara chalayi gayi — das minute. Patch skip karne se production stock mein aik number wale do batches reh jate.

docs.title: 7. Test the upgrade on the staging copy
docs.text:
Production backup ko staging par restore karein, wahan poora upgrade chalaiyein, phir test karein — haath se, umeed par nahi: Desk load hota hai aur /desk kaam karta hai; har us DocType ke liye jise upgrade ne chhua ho, create, save, submit, cancel, print, aur aik list-view filter karein; app tests bench --site <test_site> run-tests --app <app> se chalaiyein; har whitelisted method, workflow aur scheduled job dobara check karein; client ka asal invoice Chrome renderer par kholein. Sirf jab staging pass ho, tab production ki date di jati hai.

Rollback plan: agar migrate beech mein fail ho jaye, to pre-upgrade backup ko purane code par restore karein (git checkout se purani branches, DB + files restore karein). Agar aap ye staging par aik ghante se kam mein nahi kar sakte, to aap production upgrade ke liye tayyar nahi hain. Pehle se client se agree kar lein: "agar migrate fail ho jaye aur do ghante mein fix na ho sake, to hum restore karte hain."

docs.title: 8. Checklists
docs.text:
Upgrade se pehle:

  • [ ] Maujooda versions record ki gayi hain; upgrade scan chalaya gaya, hits fix ki gayi hain
  • [ ] Runtime target version ke mutabiq hai (Python, Node, MariaDB, OS)
  • [ ] Backup --with-files --compress ke saath liya gaya, restore test kiya gaya
  • [ ] Har app ke paas target version ki branch hai (ya use hata diya gaya hai)
  • [ ] Server Scripts, workflows, print formats, integrations list ki gayi hain, har aik ka aik owner hai
  • [ ] Poora upgrade production data ki staging copy par rehearsal kiya gaya
  • [ ] Staging tests pass hain (create/save/submit/cancel/print, run-tests)
  • [ ] Rollback plan client se agree kiya gaya, restore rehearsal kiya gaya

Upgrade ke baad:

  • [ ] Desk load hota hai, /desk URL, workspaces theek hain
  • [ ] Reports khulti hain (General Ledger, Stock Balance, Trial Balance)
  • [ ] Print formats Chrome PDF par render hote hain — asal invoice check kiya gaya
  • [ ] Scheduled jobs chal rahe hain (Scheduler, Background Jobs)
  • [ ] Email Queue drain ho rahi hai, email sending kaam karti hai
  • [ ] Integrations end-to-end test ki gayi hain (payment gateway, WhatsApp, webhooks)
  • [ ] Permissions: has_permission hooks True return karte hain, roles asal users se test kiye gaye, Administrator se nahi
  • [ ] Dashboards: upgraded sites classic dashboards tab tak rakhte hain jab tak change na kiye jayein — Insights par sirf har aik ko check karne ke baad switch karein
  • [ ] Offsite backups app installed hai (v16 — ab built in nahi hai)
  • [ ] Upgrade ke baad backup liya gaya

docs.title: Seekhein: ERPNext Modules — Noob to Pro
docs.text: Har module: ye kya karta hai, core DocTypes, shuru se akhir tak ka flow, aur ek asli use case jis mein NexTash / client kaam ke liye "Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain" line hai.

docs.title: People & customers
docs.text:
1. HR — employees, leave, payroll, attendance
  2. CRM — leads, deals, web forms (Frappe CRM istemal karein, legacy CRM nahi)
  3. Helpdesk — tickets, SLAs, support workflow
  4. Support & Portal — customer portal, communication

docs.title: New in v16
docs.text:
1. Studio se banay gaye mini-apps, Flow (AI), Desk mein Insights dashboards
  2. Cross-module flows — forecast → MPS → MRP, sales → stock → accounts

Asli duniya ki misaal: fmc — Food Manufacturing for ERPNext. Manufacturing + Quality + Stock ko ek asli app mein dekhein.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Accounting woh module hai jis mein har doosra module post karta hai. Selling revenue book karta hai, Buying cost book karta hai, Stock value book karta hai — aur ye sab ek hi General Ledger mein aata hai. Agar ledger ghalat hai to business ke numbers ghalat hain, chahe baaki ERP kitna hi acha kyun na ho.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Company Legal entity. Har transaction ek Company aur ek Cost Center mein post hota hai. Chart of Accounts / Account Accounts ka tree: Asset, Liability, Equity, Income, Expense. Sales Invoice Customer ko bill karta hai. Submit par ye revenue + tax book karta hai aur receivable banata hai. Purchase Invoice Supplier ka bill book karta hai. Submit par ye payable banata hai. Payment Entry Paisa andar ya bahar record karta hai, invoices ke against (ya advance ke tor par). Journal Entry Accounts ke darmiyan manual adjustments — corrections, opening balances, accruals. GL Entry Ek ledger line. Submit par khud ban jati hai — isay haath se kabhi insert na karein. Cost Center Paisa kis ka hai (branch, department, project). Har transaction ko ek Cost Center chahiye hota hai. Sales Taxes and Charges Template Sales invoice par lagne wale tax rules (masalan Sales Tax 18%). Purchase Taxes and Charges Template Purchase invoices ke liye yehi cheez. Mode of Payment Cash, bank, cheque, card — paisa kaise move hua.

docs.title: End-to-end flow
docs.text:
Setup:  Company → Chart of Accounts → Tax Templates → Cost Centers
Sell:   Sales Invoice (submit) → GL Entry: Dr Customer, Cr Income + Tax
Pay:    Payment Entry against the invoice → GL Entry: Dr Bank, Cr Customer
Buy:    Purchase Invoice (submit) → GL Entry: Dr Expense/Stock, Cr Supplier
Pay:    Payment Entry against the invoice → GL Entry: Dr Supplier, Cr Bank
Fix:    Journal Entry for anything that is not an invoice or a payment
Check:  General Ledger, Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss reports

Do rules poora module chalatay hain:

  1. Business state sirf submit / cancel se badalti hai. Submit ki hui invoice ko theek karne ke liye usay cancel karein aur amend karein. Uske fields kabhi edit na karein, aur GL Entry rows kabhi seedha na likhein.
  2. Balances ledger reports se aate hain, code mein GL Entry ko sum karke nahi, aur submit ke baad kisi document ke apne totals se bhi nahi.

docs.title: Amli misaal — ek trading company, ek din
docs.text:
Al-Noor Traders ek retailer ko cooking oil ke 100 cartons bechta hai:

  1. Sales Invoice Rs 500,000 + 18% sales tax (Rs 90,000) ke liye. Submit. Ledger: Dr Customer 590,000 — Cr Sales Income 500,000 — Cr Sales Tax Payable 90,000. Ab customer par 590,000 baaqi hai.
  2. Retailer bank transfer se Rs 300,000 deta hai. Invoice ke against Payment Entry. Ledger: Dr Bank 300,000 — Cr Customer 300,000. Baaki balance: 290,000.
  3. Company apne supplier se 200 cartons khareedti hai: Purchase Invoice Rs 400,000 + tax ke liye. Ledger: Dr Stock/Expense 400,000 — Cr Supplier.
  4. Month end: accountant Trial Balance kholta hai (debits = credits), Profit & Loss (income − expense), aur Balance Sheet — ye sab ek hi ledger se parhe jate hain, is liye ye apas mein khud hi milte hain.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Lahore ka ek distributor Excel mein invoicing karta tha aur bank ek alag register mein rakhta tha. Month-end mein ek hafta lagta tha aur tax return hamesha andaza hota tha. Invoicing aur payments ERPNext mein le jaane ke baad, Sales Tax Payable account kisi bhi waqt exact liability dikhata tha, aur return General Ledger report se file ho gayi.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Accounting ko har implementation mein pehla module bana kar bechein — aik client jo "sirf stock chahta hai" usay bhi ledger chahiye hota hai, aur tax template setup (Sales Tax, withholding) ek fixed-price service hai jo hum har Pakistani client ke liye dobaara de sakte hain.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Ghalat Company ya Cost Center mein posting. Jo document sahi company ke baghair hai, woh ghalat books mein post hota hai. Har user ke liye default Company set karein aur har implementation ki pehli invoice par isay check karein.
  • Submit ki hui invoice ko edit karna. Cancel karein aur amend karein. Edit ki hui submitted document aur uska ledger hamesha ke liye alag ho jayenge.
  • Code mein GL Entry rows insert karna. Ledger system ki yaad hai. Agar koi posting missing hai to woh document ghalat hai jis ne usay banana tha — document ko theek karein, ledger ko nahi.
  • Sab kuch ke liye ek bank account. Har bank (aur har currency) ke liye alag accounts rakhein warna reconciliation andaza ban jata hai.
  • Tax ek manual line ke tor par. Tax templates istemal karein. Likha hua tax amount usi waqt ghalat ho jata hai jab rate badalta hai.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 02 — Stock & Inventory — samaan kahan hai, aur uski qeemat kya hai.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Stock do sawalon ka jawab deta hai: ye kahan hai? aur ye kis qeemat ka hai? Har movement — purchase receipt, delivery, transfer, manufacture — ek Stock Ledger Entry (SLE) likhta hai. SLE stock ki yaad hai, bilkul waisay hi jaisay GL Entry paisay ki yaad hai. Aur wahi rule lagta hai: isay kabhi haath se na likhein.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Item Master: code, name, group, UOM, valuation method, is-stock-item. Warehouse Ek tree (All Warehouses → Main Store → Cold Room). Stock hamesha ek warehouse mein hota hai. Stock Entry Manual movements. Types: Material Issue, Material Receipt, Material Transfer, Manufacture, Repack, Material Transfer for Manufacture. Stock Ledger Entry (SLE) Ek stock movement line. Submit par khud ban jati hai — isay haath se kabhi insert na karein. Bin Har Item + Warehouse ka balance: actual_qty, projected_qty, reserved_qty. Batch Expiry date wala ek production lot. Traceability aur FEFO mumkin banata hai. Serial and Batch Bundle Record karta hai ke transaction mein exactly kaun se serials / batches istemal hue. Stock Reconciliation Ghalat balance ko theek karne ka sahi tareeqa — posting date aur reason ke saath. Delivery Note Stock bahar bhejta hai (selling side). Purchase Receipt Stock andar lata hai (buying side) aur uski value book karta hai.

docs.title: End-to-end flow
docs.text:
Setup:   Item masters → Warehouses → opening Stock Reconciliation
In:      Purchase Receipt (submit) → SLE in, Bin up, value booked
Move:    Stock Entry — Material Transfer → SLE out of A, SLE in to B
Out:     Delivery Note (submit) → SLE out, Bin down
Make:    Stock Entry — Manufacture → raw materials out, finished goods in
Fix:     Stock Reconciliation (never edit Bin or SLE by hand)
Check:   Stock Balance, Stock Ledger, Stock Ageing reports

Quantities Bin se ya kisi stock report se parhein — apne code mein SLE rows ko sum karke kabhi nahi. Aur paisa ledger reports se parhein, submit ke baad kisi document ke totals se nahi.

docs.title: Batches, serials and FEFO
docs.text:
• Batch — ek production lot. Ek batch ki manufacturing date aur expiry date hoti hai, is liye recall mein exact lot ka naam liya ja sakta hai ("recall batch SP-104", "sab kuch recall karo" nahi).
  • FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) — woh batch pehle pick karein jiski expiry sab se pehle hai. Food, pharma aur chemicals ke liye zaroori hai. ERPNext expiry ke hisaab se batches khud select kar sakta hai, is liye store team ko yaad rakhne ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Serials — har unit ke liye ek unique number (ek phone, ek machine). Serial and Batch Bundle record karta hai ke kis delivery mein kaun se serials gaye.
  • Valuation — har Item FIFO ya Moving Average istemal karta hai. FIFO issues ko sab se purani purchase cost par value karta hai; Moving Average har receipt par average dobaara calculate karta hai. Har item ke liye ek pick karein aur usay chhor dein — saal ke beech mein isay badalna history dobaara likh deta hai.

docs.title: Amli misaal — ek spice manufacturer, ek batch
docs.text:
NexTash ka food client (dekhein fmc) 500 kg laal mirch Batch CH-231 ke tor par receive karta hai, expiry 2027-06-30:

  1. Purchase Receipt — 500 kg "Raw Material Store" mein. Bin: 500 kg.
  2. Production ko 200 kg chahiye. Stock Entry (Manufacture) batch CH-231 se 200 kg consume karta hai aur 190 kg mirch powder add karta hai (10 kg process loss).
  3. Customer ka order 100 kg powder ship karta hai. Delivery Note sab se purana powder batch pehle pick karta hai — FEFO, is liye shelf par kuch expire nahi hota.
  4. Ek quality complaint aati hai. Pack par batch number se pata chal jata hai ke ye CH-231 hai, supplier kaun tha, receipt date kya thi aur us lot ke har doosre pack ka kya hua.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Ek pharma distributor expiry ki wajah se stock kho raha tha: store jo cheez nazdeek hoti thi wohi pick karta tha, aur sab se purane batches shelf ke peechay expire ho jate thay. Batches aur FEFO picking ke saath, sab se pehle expire hone wala stock pehle ship hota hai, aur Stock Ageing report dikhata hai ke agle 90 din mein kya expire hoga — write-off banne se pehle.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: batch + FEFO + Stock Ageing ko ek package ke tor par har food aur pharma client ko offer karein. Ye wahi pattern hai jo fmc ki batch traceability mein hai — aur demo (receive, produce, ship, trace back) ek hi meeting mein sale close kar deta hai.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Bin ya SLE ko haath se edit karna. Balance ghalat hai? Reason ke saath Stock Reconciliation karein. Haath se edit kiye gaye bins aur ledger hamesha ke liye alag ho jayenge.
  • Expirable goods ke liye batches nahi. Batches ke baghair na FEFO hai na recall. Agar cheez expire hoti hai to usay batch chahiye.
  • Stock nikalne ke liye code mein SLE rows ko sum karna. Bin ya Stock Balance report istemal karein. Rows ko sum karna slow hai aur usi waqt ghalat ho jata hai jab koi backdated entry aa jaye.
  • Saal ke beech mein valuation method badalna. FIFO vs Moving Average ek policy decision hai, try karne wali setting nahi. Setup par decide karein.
  • Sab kuch ke liye ek warehouse. Raw, finished, quarantine aur returns ke liye alag warehouses rakhein — warna "ye kahan hai?" ka koi jawab nahi.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 03 — Selling — quotation se cash tak.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Selling customer ki dilchaspi ko bank mein paisa bana deta hai — aur stock ko sahi waqt par warehouse se bahar bhejta hai. Har step ek document hai, aur har document ka ek kaam hai. Delivery Note stock move karta hai; Sales Invoice sale book karta hai. In do kaamon ko mix karna hi woh jagah hai jahan selling implementations ghalat ho jati hain.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Customer Master: name, group, territory, default price list, credit limit. Quotation Ek priced offer. Na stock move hota hai, na paisa book hota hai. Sales Order Confirmed order. Stock reserve karta hai, delivery date promise karta hai. Delivery Note Samaan ship karta hai. Submit par stock bahar move hota hai (SLE) aur order "To Bill" ban jata hai. Sales Invoice Sale book karta hai. Submit par revenue + tax ledger mein post hote hain aur customer par paisa baaqi ho jata hai. Payment Entry Invoice ke against milne wala paisa record karta hai. Price List / Item Price Kisi customer group ke liye item ki qeemat kya hai (Retail, Wholesale, Export). Pricing Rule Automatic discounts: "Rs 100,000 se zyada ke orders par 10% off". Sales Taxes and Charges Template Invoice par lagne wala tax.

docs.title: End-to-end flow
docs.text:
Quotation → Sales Order → Delivery Note → Sales Invoice → Payment Entry
   (offer)     (promise)      (ship)          (bill)         (collect)
  • Quotation ek click mein Sales Order ban sakta hai. Prices saath chali jati hain.
  • Delivery Note stock bahar bhejta hai; Sales Invoice sale book karta hai.
  • Invoice order se delivery ke baghair bhi ban sakta hai — service sales ke liye, jahan kuch physical ship nahi hota.
  • Returns mein original invoice ke against is_return = 1 wali Sales Invoice istemal hoti hai. Kabhi negative manual entry nahi.
  • Sales Order partially delivered aur partially billed ho sakta hai. Status bar batata hai ke kya baaqi hai: "To Deliver", "To Bill", "Completed".

docs.title: Amli misaal — ek distributor, ek order
docs.text:
Ek retailer Al-Noor Traders se cooking oil ke 200 cartons order karta hai:

  1. Quotation — Rs 2,500 per carton, 7 din ke liye valid. Retailer maan jata hai.
  2. Sales Order — 200 × 2,500 = Rs 500,000. Submit. Order warehouse mein 200 cartons reserve kar deta hai, aur delivery date promise ho jati hai.
  3. Delivery Note — 200 cartons "Main Store" se nikalte hain. Submit. Stock 200 kam ho jata hai; order status "To Bill" ban jata hai.
  4. Sales Invoice — Rs 500,000 + 18% sales tax. Submit. Ledger: Dr Customer 590,000 — Cr Sales Income 500,000 — Cr Sales Tax Payable 90,000.
  5. Payment Entry — retailer bank transfer se pay karta hai. Invoice close ho jati hai; order "Completed" hai.

Yehi flow service company ke liye bhi kaam karta hai — Delivery Note skip karein aur order se seedha invoice karein.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Ek packaging supplier WhatsApp par orders leta tha aur deliveries ek register mein likhta tha. Orders bhool jate thay, deliveries double ho jati thin, aur kisi ko nahi pata hota tha ke kaun sa customer kitna dena hai. Sales Order → Delivery Note → Sales Invoice par aane ke baad, "To Deliver" list subah ki work list ban gayi, aur Accounts Receivable report exactly dikhati thi ke kaun kitna dena hai, ageing ke saath.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har sales demo mein "To Deliver / To Bill" lists ko core banayein — business owner apna pending kaam ek screen par dekhta hai, aur yehi cheez module bechti hai. Client ki asli discount policy (wholesale slabs, seasonal offers) ke liye Pricing Rules pehle hafte mein add karein, baad ki soch ke tor par nahi.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Goods ke liye delivery se pehle invoicing. Customer us stock ke liye paisa dena hai jo abhi aapke warehouse mein hai. Delivery Note ke baad invoice karein — jab tak sale service ki na ho.
  • Qty badalne ke liye submitted order ko edit karna. Cancel karein aur amend karein. Edit kiya hua submitted order aur uski stock/ledger postings alag ho jayengi.
  • Sab ke liye ek price list. Retail, wholesale aur export customers alag prices dete hain. Price Lists aur Item Prices sahi se set karein, warna har invoice ek manual negotiation ban jata hai.
  • Credit limits nahi. Bina credit limit ke Customer hamesha order kar sakta hai. Limits set karein — configure karne par ERPNext over-limit orders ko block karta hai.
  • Delivery Note ko invoice samajhna. Ye stock move karta hai, paisa book nahi karta. Agar accountant ke paas sirf Delivery Note hai to books mein sale kabhi hui hi nahi.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 04 — Buying — mirror image: zaroorat se payment tak.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Buying zaroorat ko shelf par stock aur ek aisa bill bana deta hai jo aap pay kar sakte hain. Ye Selling ka mirror image hai: Material Request → Purchase Order → Purchase Receipt → Purchase Invoice → Payment Entry. Wahi discipline lagti hai — ek document, ek kaam. Purchase Receipt stock andar lata hai; Purchase Invoice liability book karta hai.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Supplier Master: name, group, default currency, payment terms, tax details. Material Request "Humein ye chahiye." Koi bhi department raise kar sakta hai; type Purchase, Transfer ya Manufacture. Request for Quotation Ek hi items par kai suppliers se price maangein. Supplier Quotation Ek supplier ka priced jawab. Purchase Order Ek supplier ko confirmed order: items, qty, rate, delivery date. Purchase Receipt Samaan aa gaya. Submit par stock andar move hota hai aur stock value book ho jati hai. Purchase Invoice Supplier ka bill. Submit par liability book ho jati hai. Payment Entry Invoice ke against diya gaya paisa record karta hai. Purchase Taxes and Charges Template Purchase invoice par lagne wala tax.

docs.title: End-to-end flow
docs.text:
Material Request → Purchase Order → Purchase Receipt → Purchase Invoice → Payment Entry
   (we need it)     (we order it)     (it arrived)      (we owe for it)   (we pay)
  • Purchase Receipt stock andar lata hai aur stock value book karta hai. Purchase Invoice supplier liability book karta hai. Ye alag documents hain.
  • Invoice receipt se pehle ya baad mein aa sakta hai — supplier pehle bill bhej sakta hai, ya pehle deliver kar sakta hai. ERPNext inhein item aur qty se match karta hai, date se nahi.
  • Returns mein original invoice ke against is_return = 1 wali Purchase Invoice istemal hoti hai.
  • Three-way match hi control hai: Purchase Order (hum ne kya order kiya) vs Purchase Receipt (kya aaya) vs Purchase Invoice (humein kis ka bill mila). Agar teeno mein farq hai to kuch ghalat hai — pay karne se pehle usay dhoondein.

docs.title: Amli misaal — ek manufacturer raw material khareedta hai
docs.text:
Ek spice factory ko 500 kg laal mirch chahiye:

  1. Material Request — production raise karta hai: 500 kg laal mirch, Friday tak chahiye.
  2. Request for Quotation — teen suppliers ko bheja gaya. Do ne jawab diya.
  3. Purchase Order — saste supplier ko: 500 kg at Rs 800/kg, delivery Friday. Submit.
  4. Purchase Receipt — Friday, 500 kg aaye aur tole gaye: 495 kg accept hue, 5 kg reject hue (damaged). 495 kg ke liye submit karein. Stock 495 kg barh gaya; reject kiye gaye 5 kg kabhi stock mein nahi aaye.
  5. Purchase Invoice — supplier 500 kg ka bill bhejta hai. Invoice receipt se match hoti hai: sirf 495 kg accept hue, is liye payable 495 kg ka hai. 5 kg ka farq payment se pehle pakra gaya.
  6. Payment Entry — agreed terms (30 days) par pay kiya gaya. Ledger: Dr Supplier — Cr Bank.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Ek food manufacturer suppliers ko sirf invoice dekh kar pay karta tha, receipts match kiye baghair. Kam deliveries ki poori payment mahino tak hoti rahi. Three-way match ke baad, Accounts Payable report har supplier ke against exact outstanding dikhati thi, aur ek supplier ki baar baar kam shipments Purchase Receipt history mein nazar aati thin — renegotiation ke liye saboot.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har buying pitch mein three-way match (order vs receipt vs invoice) demo karein — ye woh ek screen hai jis se finance head ko system par bharosa ho jata hai. Manufacturing clients ke liye flow ko Purchase Order se nahi, production se Material Request se shuru karein, taake paisa commit hone se pehle zaroorat nazar aaye.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Receipt ke baghair invoice se pay karna. Agar samaan kabhi aaya hi nahi to aap ne hawa ke liye pay kar diya. Hamesha pehle receipt match karein.
  • Ek supplier, ek price, hamesha ke liye. Supplier Quotation comparison ke baghair koi leverage nahi. Har recurring cheez par do quotes lein.
  • Received qty ke bajaye ordered qty ke liye invoice book karna. Payable us se match karna chahiye jo aaya hai. Short-shipments classic leak hain.
  • Material Request nahi. Purchasing se seedha uthaye gaye orders asli zaroorat ko chhupa dete hain. Request hi audit trail hai — kis ne maanga, kya maanga, aur kyun.
  • Qty theek karne ke liye submitted receipt ko edit karna. Cancel karein aur amend karein. Receipt stock post karti hai; usay edit karne se stock ledger ghalat ho jata hai.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: Aap ne Core modules mukammal kar liye: Accounting, Stock, Selling, Buying. ERPNext path mein agla: Operations — Manufacturing, Quality, Projects aur Assets (Beta).

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text:
Manufacturing raw material ko finished goods mein badal deta hai — aur ye saabit karta hai ke har unit ki cost kya aayi. Recipe hai BOM (Bill of Materials), banane ka order hai Work Order, aur shop floor par hua kaam Job Cards par track hota hai. Jab Work Order mukammal hota hai, to ek Stock Entry raw material bahar nikaalti hai aur finished goods andar laati hai, aur ledger production cost book kar leta hai.

Agar aap Manufacturing skip kar ke sirf Stock Entries karte hain, to aap wo do cheezein kho dete hain jin ki factory owner ko parwah hoti hai: cost kya aayi aur kaam kahan atak gaya.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai BOM Recipe: finished item + raw materials + operations + cost. Har item ke liye ek BOM (version ke hisaab se variants ke saath). BOM Creator Multi-level BOM banane ka tez tareeqa, finished item se neeche ki taraf. Work Order "Is ka 500 kg banao." Is mein BOM, qty, warehouse, planned dates aur status hota hai. Job Card Shop floor par ek operation (grinding, packing). Time, operator aur completed qty track karta hai. Routing Operations ki tarteeb wali list jin se product guzarta hai. Operation Ek step: naam, workstation, standard time. Workstation Ek machine ya work centre (grinder, packing line) jis ka hourly rate hota hai. Production Plan Planner: Sales Orders / forecasts ko Work Orders aur Material Requests mein badal deta hai. Master Production Schedule Kya banana hai, har period ke hisaab se, Production Plan chalne se pehle ka plan. Sales Forecast Har item ki expected demand, har period ke hisaab se — schedule ka input. Stock Entry (Manufacture) Movement: raw material bahar, finished goods andar. Work Order mukammal hone par post hoti hai. Downtime Entry Record karta hai ke workstation kab ruka, aur kyun. Subcontracting Order Raw material bahar ke vendor ko bhejo taake wo ek step kar de (masalan packing). Subcontracting Receipt Finished kaam vendor se wapas aata hai. Subcontracting Inward Order Ulta (v16): customer aap ko material bhejta hai aur aap kaam karte hain.

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak flow
docs.text:
Setup:   Item masters → BOM → Routing + Workstations → Operations
Plan:    Sales Forecast → Master Production Schedule → Production Plan
Order:   Work Order (submit) → materials reserved / transferred to WIP
Make:    Job Card per operation → time logged → Stock Entry (Manufacture)
Cost:    finished goods valued at BOM cost + labour + overhead
Check:   Work Order Summary, Production Plan, Job Card, BOM Cost reports
  • Work Order ek BOM se shuru hota hai. BOM badlo to har future Work Order us ke saath badal jata hai — isi liye BOM master hai, Work Order nahi.
  • Material work-in-progress warehouse mein Stock Entry se jata hai jis ki type Material Transfer for Manufacture hoti hai; finished goods Manufacture ke saath wapas aate hain.
  • Job Card shop-floor ki sachai hai: kis ne kiya, kitna time laga, kitna bana. Job Cards ke baghair aap labour ki cost nahi nikaal sakte aur na hi slow operation dhoond sakte hain.
  • Subcontracting us step ke liye hai jo aap khud nahi karte: Subcontracting Order material bahar bhejta hai, Subcontracting Receipt finished kaam wapas lata hai, aur vendor ko service ki payment milti hai.

docs.title: Amli misaal — ek spice manufacturer, ek Work Order
docs.text:
fmc demo client (fmc — Food Manufacturing for ERPNext) ko 500 kg red chilli powder chahiye:

  1. BOM "Chilli Powder 500g pack" ke liye: 1 kg raw chilli, 0.02 kg packaging, operations: cleaning → grinding → packing.
  2. Work Order 500 kg ke liye. Submit. 500 kg raw chilli (Batch CH-231) WIP warehouse mein chala jata hai.
  3. Job Cards: cleaning (2 hrs), grinding (4 hrs grinder workstation par), packing (3 hrs). Har card time aur operator log karta hai.
  4. Stock Entry (Manufacture): 500 kg raw chilli consume hui, 490 kg powder bana (10 kg process loss), 500 g ke 980 packs mein pack hua.
  5. Packs par production batch hota hai, is liye customer ki complaint CH-231, grinder, operator aur us din tak trace ho jati hai jis din ye bana tha.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Lahore ki ek spice factory production notebook mein plan karti thi aur cost andaze se nikaalti thi. Unhein kabhi pata nahi chalta tha ke asal mein kaun sa product paisa bana raha hai — grinding losses aur packing time nazar nahi aate thay. BOMs + Work Orders + Job Cards ke baad, BOM cost report ne har pack ki asal cost dikha di, aur slow operation (grinding) Job Card report par nazar aa gaya — dusre grinder ke liye case, numbers ke saath.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Manufacturing har food, pharma aur textile client ko becho, wo module jo "cost kya aayi?" ka jawab deta hai — aur isay fmc ke saath demo karo, jis mein food-manufacturing flow (batches, FEFO, QC) pehle se bana hua hai. Subcontracting un clients ke liye alag fixed-price add-on hai jo packing ya stitching outsource karte hain.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• BOM nahi, sirf Stock Entries. BOM ke baghair production ki koi standard cost nahi hoti aur koi variance nahi — aap bata nahi sakte ke batch efficient tha ya wasteful.
  • Job Cards skip karna. In ke baghair, labour cost aik andaza hai aur bottleneck operation chhupa rehta hai.
  • Raw, WIP aur finished ke liye ek warehouse. Material mix ho jata hai aur "ye kahan hai?" ka koi jawab nahi hota. Inhein alag rakho.
  • Qty badalne ke liye submitted Work Order edit karna. Cancel karo aur amend karo — Work Order pehle hi stock reserve kar ke move kar chuka hota hai.
  • Subcontracting receipts bhool jana. Bahar bheja gaya material jo kabhi wapas nahi aaya, wo stock hai jo khamoshi se books se ghaib ho jata hai.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 06 — Quality — inspections, quarantine, release aur reject.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Quality faisla karta hai ke goods istemal, bechne ya ship karne ke qaabil hain ya nahi — aur kharab goods ko stock se bahar rakhta hai. Ek Quality Inspection receipt, production batch ya delivery ko ek Quality Inspection Template (parameters ki list, acceptance values ke saath) ke khilaaf check karta hai. Jo goods fail ho jayein, wo quarantine warehouse mein jate hain, wapas sellable stock mein nahi. Quality Goals, Procedures aur Reviews management side hain: targets, likha hua process, aur regular check ke process kaam kar raha hai ya nahi.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text:
DocType Ye kya hai Quality Inspection Ek inspection: kya check hua, kis template ke khilaaf, pass ya fail. Quality Inspection Template Checklist: parameters, acceptance values, har item ya item group ke liye. Quality Inspection Parameter Ek measurable check (moisture %, colour, weight) jis ki value ya range hoti hai. Quality Inspection Reading Inspection ke dauraan record ki gayi ek measured value. Quality Goal Ek measurable target (masalan "rejection rate 2% se kam") jis ka owner hota hai. Quality Procedure Quality activity ke liye likha hua process. Quality Action Failure se uthaya gaya corrective ya preventive action. Quality Review Goals, actions aur inspection results ka periodic review. Quality Feedback Customer ya internal team ki taraf se quality ke baare mein feedback. Quality Meeting Meeting ka record: agenda, minutes, actions.

Inspections Stock module mein rehte hain (ye receipts, deliveries aur production se attach hote hain), jabke goals, procedures aur reviews un ke gird quality management system hain.

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak flow
docs.text:
Setup:   Quality Inspection Templates per item → quarantine warehouse
In:      Purchase Receipt → Quality Inspection → Accepted / Rejected
Fail:    rejected qty → quarantine warehouse (never into sellable stock)
Fix:     Quality Action (return to supplier, rework, or scrap)
Make:    in-process inspection on the Work Order → out-going inspection
Check:   Quality Inspection report, rejection rate vs Quality Goal
  • Inspection ek reference document se linked hoti hai — aam tor par Purchase Receipt, Delivery Note ya Stock Entry. Inspected qty us document par accepted ya rejected hoti hai.
  • Accepted stock normal warehouse mein jata hai. Rejected stock quarantine warehouse mein jata hai (ya wapas kar diya jata hai). Ye kabhi chupke se sellable stock mein add nahi hota.
  • Quality Goal inspection results ko aik number mein badal deta hai jis par owner nazar rakhta hai — rejection rate, on-time inspections, complaints per month.
  • Quality Action wo hai jo failure ke baad hota hai: lot wapas karo, rework karo, supplier badlo, ya process badlo. Action ke baghair, wahi failure agle mahine dobara hota hai.

docs.title: Amli misaal — ek spice manufacturer, ek rejected lot
docs.text:
fmc demo client (fmc) ko 500 kg red chilli milti hai:

  1. Purchase Receipt — 500 kg aa gaye. Item ka Quality Inspection Template hai (moisture ≤ 10%, colour grade A, no stones).
  2. Quality Inspection — lab moisture 13% measure karta hai. Lot fail ho jata hai.
  3. 500 kg quarantine warehouse mein chale jate hain. 5 kg sample supplier dispute ke liye rakha jata hai; baaki istemal ke qaabil nahi hai.
  4. Quality Action — supplier ko wapas karo, aur supplier ki terms mein pre-shipment moisture check add karo. Rejected lot kabhi production tak nahi pahunchta, is liye koi finished batch contaminate nahi hota.
  5. Quality Goal "rejection rate 2% se kam" dikhata hai ke ye supplier quarter mein 8% par hai — suppliers badalne ka saboot.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Ek food exporter ne aik container ship kiya jo buyer ne arrival par moisture ki wajah se reject kar diya — poori shipment zaya ho gayi. Receipt kabhi inspect nahi hui thi kyunke "supplier trusted hai". Quarantine warehouse ke saath incoming inspections ke baad, kharab lots gate par hi pakde jate hain, aur rejection report dikhati hai ke kaun se suppliers paisa zaya karte hain — container ke sail karne se pehle.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Quality ko har Manufacturing aur Buying implementation ke saath bundle karo food aur pharma clients ke liye — Purchase Receipt par incoming inspection aik din ka setup hai jo client ki sab se mehngi failure (rejected shipment) ko rokta hai. Quality Goal dashboard phase-2 ki sale hai.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Quarantine warehouse nahi hai. Sellable stock mein mila hua rejected stock aik recall ka intezar hai.
  • Istemaal ke baad inspect karna. Delivery Note par inspection bohat der se hoti hai — receipt par inspect karo, material ke production mein jaane se pehle.
  • Template jis mein numbers nahi hain. "Looks fine" koi parameter nahi hai. Har check ki acceptance value honi chahiye (moisture ≤ 10%, "dry enough" nahi).
  • Failures jin ka koi Quality Action nahi. Wahi lot agle mahine usi supplier se dobara fail hota hai. Action log karo, owner assign karo, close karo.
  • In-process inspection skip karna. Finished pack stage par problem pakarna poora batch zaya karta hai — production ke dauraan check karo.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 07 — Projects — tasks, timesheets, costing.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Projects "client ke liye ye kaam karo" ko measurable bana deta hai: aik Project jis mein Tasks hon, time Timesheets par book ho, costs timesheets, expenses aur purchases se jama hon — aur akhir mein aik profit number. Is ke baghair, services business apni revenue janta hai aur cost ka andaza lagata hai. Is ke saath, har project dikhata hai ke us ne paisa banaya ya gawaya, jabke abhi bhi waqt hai ke use theek kiya ja sake.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Project Kaam: client, dates, expected dates, costing, billing status. Task Project mein kaam ka ek hissa, jis ka owner, dates aur dependencies hon. Timesheet Project / task ke khilaaf book kiya gaya time, billable aur costing rates ke saath. Timesheet Detail Ek time entry: hours, activity type, billable ya nahi. Activity Type Kaam ki qisam (Development, Consulting, Support) jis ka costing aur billing rate hota hai. Activity Cost Har employee ke liye Activity Type ka cost rate. Project Template Standard kaam ke liye reusable task list (masalan "ERPNext go-live"). Project Type Grouping aur reporting ke liye category (Internal, External, Support). Project Update Project par status note, team ke saath share ki jati hai.

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak flow
docs.text:
Setup:   Activity Types + rates → Project Template for the standard job
Plan:    Project → Tasks (with dependencies) → assign owners
Work:    Timesheet entries against tasks (billable / non-billable)
Cost:    timesheets + Expense Claims + Purchase Invoices roll into the project
Bill:    Timesheet → Sales Invoice (time billed to the client)
Check:   Project Profitability report — revenue vs cost, per project
  • Ek Task dusre Task par depend kar sakta hai — wo tab tak shuru nahi ho sakta jab tak pehla mukammal na ho. Dependencies hi plan ko honest banati hain.
  • Timesheet entry ke do rates hote hain: costing rate (hour ki cost kya hai) aur billing rate (aap kya charge karte hain). Profit in ke darmiyan ka farq hai.
  • Billable hours client invoice par jate hain; non-billable hours phir bhi cost hain — wo sirf kamate nahi hain. Sab kuch billable mark karna asal margin chhupa deta hai.
  • Project Profitability report wo aik number hai jo owner check karta hai: revenue booked minus cost incurred, har project ke liye.

docs.title: Amli misaal — ERPNext implementation, aik project
docs.text:
NexTash Lahore ke aik distributor ke liye ERPNext implementation leta hai:

  1. Project "Al-Noor ERPNext Go-Live", type External, "ERPNext go-live" Project Template se: setup → data import → training → go-live, dependencies tarteeb se.
  2. Tasks assign hui: Irfaan (setup, data import), aik colleague (training).
  3. Har hafte team Timesheets book karti hai: 30 hrs Development (billable), 6 hrs internal meetings (non-billable).
  4. Travel aur aik test server Expense Claims aur aik Purchase Invoice ke tor par project ke khilaaf aate hain.
  5. Mahine ke akhir mein, Sales Invoice 30 hours agreed rate par bill karta hai. Project Profitability report dikhati hai revenue 450,000, cost 280,000 — project on track hai, aur 6 non-billable hours nazar aa rahe hain, chhupe hue nahi.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Aik services company mahine ke akhir mein clients ko yaad se bill karti thi — hours bhool jate thay, aur kisi ko pata nahi tha ke kaun sa client profitable hai. Projects + Timesheets ke baad, har invoice booked time se aati hai, aur profitability report ne dikhaya ke aik "bara" client asal mein loss-making tha jab internal hours count kiye gaye. Unhon ne us client ko report ko saboot bana kar reprice kiya.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: NexTash ka apna client kaam Projects mein chalao — ye hamara internal tool bhi hai aur demo bhi hai. Jab client poochhe "aap hamara project kaise track karte hain?", to unhein live project dikhao: tasks, timesheets, profitability. Ye demo module ko kisi bhi slide se behtar bechta hai.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Timesheets mahine ke akhir mein bharna. Yaad koi time record nahi hai. Time daily book karo, warna billable hours aik andaza hain.
  • Costing rate nahi hai. Agar sirf billing rate set hai, to project profitable lagta hai jab tak salaries count na hon.
  • Sab kuch billable mark karna. Client ko bill kiya gaya internal kaam aik dispute ka intezar hai — aur ye asal cost chhupa deta hai.
  • Tasks jin ka koi owner aur koi dates nahi. Owners ke baghair task list aik wish list hai. Har task ka aik owner aur aik due date honi chahiye.
  • Profitability report ko ignore karna. Report is liye hai ke losing project ko jaldi pakra ja sake. Isay hafte mein aik dafa check karo, akhir mein nahi.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 08 — Assets — asset lifecycle, depreciation, maintenance.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Assets un cheezon ko track karta hai jo business ke paas hain aur aik saal se zyada chalti hain — machines, vehicles, computers, furniture — purchase se disposal tak. Ek Asset Purchase Invoice se banta hai, schedule par depreciate hota hai taake books us ki girti hui value dikhayein, plan par maintain hota hai taake wo kharab na ho, locations ke darmiyan move hota hai taake wo gum na ho, aur akhir mein scrap ya sell ho jata hai. Is ke baghair, business ke paas cheezein hoti hain jinhein wo dhoond nahi sakta aur wo cheezein depreciate karta hai jo us ke paas ab hain hi nahi.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Asset Ek owned item: value, location, custodian, status, depreciation schedule. Asset Category Group (Plant & Machinery, Vehicles, IT Equipment) jis ke accounts aur depreciation defaults hon. Asset Depreciation Schedule Har finance book ke liye depreciation plan: method, rate, dates, amounts. Asset Maintenance Asset ka maintenance plan: tasks aur un ki frequency. Asset Maintenance Task Maintenance plan mein aik recurring task (oil change har 3 mahine mein). Asset Maintenance Log Aik completed maintenance event, cost ke saath. Asset Movement Asset ko locations ya custodians ke darmiyan move karna. Asset Repair Aik repair job: kya kharab hua, kitni cost aayi, kab theek hua. Asset Value Adjustment Asset ki value upar ya neeche karna (revaluation ya impairment). Asset Capitalization Stock items ya services ko asset mein capitalise karna (masalan parts se machine banana). Location Assets kahan rehte hain: aik tree (Factory → Hall A → Line 1).

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak flow
docs.text:
Setup:   Asset Categories (accounts + method) → Locations
Buy:     Purchase Invoice → Asset created (or capitalised from stock)
Value:   Asset Depreciation Schedule runs → depreciation posts to the ledger
Use:     Asset Movement when it changes location or custodian
Care:    Asset Maintenance plan → Asset Maintenance Log per visit
Fix:     Asset Repair when it breaks
End:     sell or scrap → Asset Value Adjustment / disposal, ledger updated
Check:   Fixed Asset Register, Asset Depreciation report
  • Depreciation methods: Straight Line (har period mein same amount), Written Down Value (baqi value ka aik %), Double Declining Balance, ya Manual. Har category ke liye choose karo, har asset ke liye nahi, aur isay mid-life mein change mat karo.
  • Fixed Asset Register "hamare paas kya hai?" ka audit jawab hai: har asset, us ki location, us ka custodian, us ki book value.
  • Asset Movement wo control hai jo assets ko chale jaane se rokta hai — Movement entry ke baghair move ki gayi machine wo machine hai jise register dhoond nahi sakta.

docs.title: Amli misaal — aik factory, aik machine
docs.text:
Aik spice factory Rs 1,200,000 ka grinder khareedti hai:

  1. Purchase Invoice — grinder book ho gaya. Is se aik Asset bana, category "Plant & Machinery", location "Factory → Hall A", custodian production supervisor.
  2. Asset Depreciation Schedule — Straight Line, 10% per year, 10 saal. Har mahine Rs 10,000 depreciation automatically ledger mein post hoti hai.
  3. Asset Maintenance — oil change har 3 mahine mein, belt check har 6 mahine mein. Har visit Asset Maintenance Log mein cost ke saath log hoti hai.
  4. Saal 3 mein, motor jal jata hai. Asset Repair — Rs 85,000, do din downtime. Repair cost asset ke khilaaf nazar aati hai, general expenses mein chhupi hui nahi.
  5. Saal 8 mein, grinder Rs 300,000 mein bech diya jata hai. Book value Rs 240,000 hai — disposal par Rs 60,000 ka gain book hota hai, aur asset register se nikal jata hai.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Aik manufacturer ke paas do halls mein 40 machines thi aur koi register nahi tha. Jab auditor ne fixed asset list maangi, to accountant ne purani invoices se andaza lagaya — jin mein wo machines bhi thi jo saalon pehle bech di gayi thi. Assets ke baad, Fixed Asset Register floor se match karta tha, depreciation manual journals ke baghair har mahine post hoti thi, aur maintenance log dikhata tha ke kis machine ki repairs par sab se zyada kharcha aaya — use replace karne ka case.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Fixed Asset Register ko har manufacturing implementation mein audit-ready deliverable ke tor par offer karo — auditors isay naam se maangte hain, aur jis client ke paas ye hai wo wapas nahi jayega. Maintenance plans un clients ke liye phase-2 ki sale hain jin ke paas plant and machinery hai.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Assets expenses ke tor par book karna. "General Expense" mein Rs 1,200,000 ki machine balance sheet aur tax return kharab kar deti hai. Isay capitalise karo.
  • Depreciation manual journals se. Mahine ke manual journals drift karte hain aur bhool jate hain. Schedule istemal karo — wo khud post hota hai.
  • Koi Location ya custodian nahi. Jis asset ki koi location nahi, wo asset dhoonda nahi ja sakta. Dono creation par set karo.
  • Repairs expenses mein chhupi hui. Agar repair cost asset par nahi hai, to aap dekh nahi sakte ke kaun si machine paisa kha rahi hai.
  • Mid-life mein depreciation method badalna. Ye book value ki history dobara likh deta hai. Setup par decide karo, har category ke liye.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 09 — HR — employees, leave, payroll, attendance.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: HR business ka people side chalata hai: yahan kaun kaam karta hai, kab chhutti par hai, aaya ya nahi, aur usay kya pay milti hai. Ek Employee ko leave allocate hoti hai, wo us ke liye apply karta hai, present ya absent mark hota hai, Shift par kaam karta hai, aur Payroll Entry se generate hone wali Salary Slip se pay pata hai. v16 mein HR module alag Frappe HR app (hrms) hai — Employee master khud abhi bhi ERPNext core mein hai, aur HRMS us par build karta hai.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Employee Master: naam, company, department, designation, date of joining, reports-to. Leave Type Chhutti ki qisam: Annual, Sick, Casual — apne rules ke saath. Leave Allocation Employee ko aik period ke liye leave days deta hai. Leave Application Request: dates, leave type, approver. Submit par leave ledger mein post hoti hai. Leave Ledger Entry Leave ki aik movement. Automatically banti hai — isay kabhi haath se insert mat karo. Attendance Aik din ka record: Present, Absent, Half Day, On Leave. Employee Checkin Aik punch: in ya out, time ke saath (biometric ya manual entry se). Shift Type Aik shift: start, end, late-entry aur early-exit rules. Shift Assignment Employee ko aik period ke liye shift par lagata hai. Holiday List Saal ki chhuttiyan, har company ya location ke liye. Salary Structure Pay design: earnings aur deductions (basic, allowances, tax, provident fund). Salary Structure Assignment Employee ko aik date se structure assign karta hai. Salary Slip Aik employee ki aik mahine ki pay: gross, deductions, net. Payroll Entry Payroll run: employees ke set ke liye Salary Slips generate karta hai. Expense Claim Employee ka claim (travel, fuel) approval aur payment ke liye.

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak flow
docs.text:
Setup:   Departments → Holiday List → Leave Types → Shift Types → Salary Structures
Hire:    Employee → Leave Allocation → Shift Assignment → Salary Structure Assignment
Daily:   Employee Checkin → Attendance (auto-marked from checkins)
Leave:   Leave Application (submit) → balance drops → Attendance shows On Leave
Pay:     Payroll Entry → Salary Slips → Payment Entry (bank) → ledger
Check:   Leave Balance, Attendance, Salary Register reports
  • Leave Allocation days deta hai; Leave Application unhein kharch karti hai. Allocation nahi, to application nahi — balance negative ho jata hai aur report ye dikhati hai.
  • Attendance Employee Checkin (biometric ya manual punches) se mark ho sakti hai ya direct enter ki ja sakti hai. Checkins audit trail hain; attendance wo record hai jo payroll parhta hai.
  • Payroll Entry run hai: period aur employees choose karo, aur ye Salary Slips generate karta hai. Slip har employee ke liye har mahine aik hoti hai — submitted slip ko kabhi edit mat karo, cancel karo aur dobara generate karo.
  • Salary Structure wo jagah hai jahan pay policy rehti hai: basic pay, house rent, medical, tax aur provident fund components ke tor par. Policy structure mein badlo, individual slips mein nahi.

docs.title: Amli misaal — aik factory, aik mahina
docs.text:
Aik spice factory mein do shifts par 45 staff hain:

  1. Employees department, designation aur joining date ke saath bane. Saal ke liye Holiday List, Shift Types Morning (8–4) aur Evening (4–12), har worker ke liye Shift Assignments.
  2. Daily, workers punch in karte hain. Employee Checkin records Attendance feed karte hain — Present, Late, ya Absent.
  3. Aik worker 3 din annual leave ke liye apply karta hai. Leave Application approve hoti hai; balance 12 se 9 ho jata hai; wo din On Leave dikhate hain.
  4. Mahine ke akhir mein: Payroll Entry 45 Salary Slips generate karta hai. Late days salary structure ke hisaab se deduct hote hain; leave days paid hote hain. Slips submit hoti hain aur bank se aik Payment Entry mein pay hoti hain.
  5. Salary Register har employee ke liye gross, deductions aur net dikhata hai — wahi report jo accountant file karta hai.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
60 logon ki aik company attendance register mein aur payroll Excel mein chalati thi. Leave balances HR head ki yaad mein rehte thay, aur salary day dobara check karne mein teen din lagte thay. HR ke baad, checkins attendance automatically mark karte hain, leave balances sab ko nazar aate hain, aur payroll run aik dopahar mein ho jata hai — Salary Register audit record ke tor par.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: HR ko Accounting ke baad dusra module becho kisi bhi client ko jis ke 20+ staff hon — attendance + leave + payroll wo package hai jis ka dard har growing business mehsoos karta hai. Biometric checkin sync aik chhota fixed-price add-on hai (apps catalog ki HR entries dekho).

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Allocation ke baghair leave. Zero balance ke khilaaf applications negative balances aur saal ke akhir mein arguments banati hain.
  • Edited slips se payroll. Submitted Salary Slip aik record hai — cancel karo aur dobara generate karo, kabhi edit mat karo.
  • Koi Shift Assignment nahi. Is ke baghair, checkins ke paas compare karne ke liye kuch nahi hota aur "late" ka koi matlab nahi hota.
  • Salary policy slips mein, structures mein nahi. 45 slips mein type kiya gaya wahi allowance ghalat hone ke 45 chances hain. Isay structure mein daalo.
  • Attendance daily haath se mark karna. Checkins istemal karo. 45 logon ke liye manual attendance aik full-time job hai aur disputes ki wajah hai.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 10 — CRM — leads, deals, web forms (Frappe CRM).

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: CRM ajnabi logon ko customer bana deta hai: aik Lead capture karo, usay qualify karo, usay stages se guzar kar aik Deal ke tor par kaam karo, aur phir close kar do. Frappe CRM istemal karo — alag app — ERPNext ke andar wala legacy CRM nahi. Legacy module (ERPNext core mein Lead, Opportunity) ko deprecate karne ka faisla ho chuka hai aur version 17 mein ye poori tarah hata diya jayega, aur Frappe CRM wohi jagah hai jahan tamam nayi development ho rahi hai: lead capture ke liye web forms, deal pipelines, enrichment, aur workflow automations. November 2026 mein isay Framework scheme ke mutabiq renumber kiya gaya (v16.x, Frappe v16 ko target karta hai) aur ye ~2,500 paid sites par chal raha hai.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text:
DocType Ye kya hai CRM Lead Aik prospect: naam, contact, source, status. Funnel ka sab se upar wala hissa. CRM Deal Aik opportunity: value, stage, probability, expected close date. CRM Organization Woh company jis se lead ya deal ka talluq hai. CRM Task Aik follow-up: call, visit, quote bhejna — due date aur owner ke saath. CRM Call Log Aik call: kis se, kab, kya kaha gaya, agla step kya hai. FCRM Note Lead ya deal par aik note. CRM Lead Status / CRM Deal Status Pipeline stages (New, Contacted, Qualified, Won, Lost). CRM Service Level Agreement Leads ke liye response-time targets (pehla reply X hours ke andar). CRM Form Script CRM ke web forms ke liye scripting (validation, defaults).

Isay bench get-app crm se install karo — ye aik alag app hai, ERPNext core ka hissa nahi. Website par capture honay walay leads CRM ke web forms se aate hain; aik lead tab deal ban jata hai jab wo qualify ho jaye, aur aik deal tab ERPNext mein Customer + Quotation ban jata hai jab wo won ho jaye.

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak ka flow
docs.text:
Capture:  web form / email / manual → CRM Lead
Qualify:  Lead → contact, understand the need → convert to CRM Deal
Work:     CRM Deal through stages → CRM Task + CRM Call Log per step
Close:    Won → Customer + Quotation in ERPNext → Sales Order
Lose:     Lost → CRM Lost Reason recorded (the data that fixes the funnel)
Check:   CRM dashboard — pipeline value, conversion rate, ageing deals
  • Aik Lead ghair-qualify shuda dilchaspi hai; aik Deal aik qualify shuda opportunity hai jis ki value hoti hai. Bohat jaldi convert karne se pipeline mein shor bhar jata hai; bohat der se convert karne ka matlab hai ke koi follow-up nahi karta.
  • Har deal ko aik next step chahiye — aik CRM Task, date aur owner ke saath. Aik deal jis ka koi next step nahi, woh deal hai jo chup chap mar jati hai.
  • Lost Reason CRM ka sab se qeemti field hai. Lagatar das dafa "Too expensive" ka matlab pricing ka masla hai, sales ka masla nahi.
  • CRM ka apna Service Level Agreement hai: muqarar waqt ke andar pehla response. Jin leads ka jawab der se diya jaye, wo leads competitor ke paas chale jate hain.

docs.title: Amli misaal — NexTash, aik lead se aik project tak
docs.text:
Aik food manufacturer NexTash ki site par "Get a quote" form bharta hai:

  1. Web form se CRM Lead khud-ba-khud ban jata hai: company, contact, "ERPNext for spice factory", source Website.
  2. Irfaan usi din call karta hai. CRM Call Log: "wants Manufacturing + Quality, 40 users, currently on Excel". Lead status → Qualified.
  3. CRM Deal ban jata hai: value Rs 1,800,000, stage "Proposal", close date aglay mahine. CRM Tasks: proposal bhejna (Tue), follow-up call (Fri).
  4. Client maan jata hai. Deal → Won. ERPNext mein aik Customer aur Quotation ban jate hain, aur kaam aik Project ke tor par shuru ho jata hai (lesson 07 dekhein).
  5. Dashboard funnel dikhata hai: is mahine 12 leads, 5 qualified, 2 won — aur haaray hue deals kehte hain "no budget this quarter", jo aglay quarter ke liye follow-up list hai, dead end nahi.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Aik distributor ki sales team leads ko apni personal WhatsApp chats mein rakhti thi. Jab aik salesperson chala jata, to leads bhi us ke saath chale jate. Frappe CRM ke baad, har lead system mein hai, owner aur next step ke saath, manager poori pipeline aik dashboard mein dekhta hai, aur aik lead jis ka 24 hours mein jawab nahi diya gaya, nazar aa jata hai — aik mahine baad pata nahi chalta.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: pehle NexTash ki apni pipeline ke liye Frappe CRM istemal karo — ye woh demo hai jis se har sales call shuru hoti hai. Phir ye har us client ko becho jis ki sales WhatsApp aur yaad-dasht par chalti hai: unlimited agents, koi per-seat fee nahi, aur web form un ki website ko lead machine bana deta hai. Naye projects par hamesha Frappe CRM install karo; kisi client ko legacy ERPNext CRM par kabhi shuru na karo.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Legacy ERPNext CRM istemal karna. Ye v17 mein hata diya jayega. Nayi implementations Frappe CRM par hongi, bas.
  • Leads jin ka koi owner aur koi next step nahi. Aik lead jis ka koi owner nahi, woh khoya hua lead hai. Har lead ko usi din aik owner chahiye jis din wo aaye.
  • Koi Lost Reason nahi. Aik haara hua deal baghair wajah ke kuch nahi sikhata. Har dafa isay record karo.
  • Deals jo hafton tak aik hi stage par atke hon. Aik purana deal aik mara hua deal hai jis ka stage khula reh gaya hai. Pipeline ko haftawar review karo aur close karo ya dobara date do.
  • Koi web form nahi. Agar leads sirf phone se aate hain, to website kuch nahi kar rahi. Form aik ghantay ka setup hai.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 11 — Helpdesk — tickets, SLAs, support workflow.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Helpdesk support ki afra-tafri ko aik queue bana deta hai: har request aik HD Ticket ban jati hai jis mein type, priority, owner aur aik clock hoti hai. Clock hai Service Level Agreement — first response aur resolution targets jin ke khilaf team ko naapa jata hai. Tickets email, customer portal ya form se aate hain; agents aik team mein un par kaam karte hain; aur knowledge base (HD Article) sawal ka jawab ticket banne se pehle hi de deta hai. Frappe Helpdesk aik alag app hai (bench get-app helpdesk), November 2026 mein v16.x par renumber hua — unlimited agents, koi per-seat fee nahi.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai HD Ticket Aik request: customer, subject, type, priority, status, agent, SLA. HD Agent Aik support agent: jisay tickets assign kiye ja sakte hain. HD Team Agents ka aik group (masalan "ERP Support", "Billing"). HD Service Level Agreement Har priority aur customer ke liye response aur resolution targets. HD Service Level Priority SLA ke andar aik priority ke targets (masalan Urgent: 1 hr response). HD Ticket Type Request ki qism: Bug, Question, Feature Request. HD Ticket Priority Urgent, High, Medium, Low. HD Ticket Status Open, Replied, Resolved, Closed. HD Customer Helpdesk mein aik customer, jo un ke ERPNext Customer se linked hai. HD Article Knowledge base ka aik article, aik category mein. HD Article Category Knowledge base ka aik hissa (Getting Started, Billing). HD Saved Reply Aik aam jawab ke liye tayyar-shuda response. HD Ticket Template Ticket raise karne ke liye aik form template (har type ke liye fields).

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak ka flow
docs.text:
Raise:    email / portal / form → HD Ticket (auto-created, type + priority set)
Assign:   ticket → HD Team → HD Agent (round-robin or manual)
Work:     agent replies, ticket moves Open → Replied → Resolved
Clock:    SLA measures first response and resolution against targets
Close:    customer confirms → Closed; feedback requested
Learn:    repeated questions → HD Article → fewer tickets next month
Check:   ticket ageing, SLA breach, first-response time reports
  • Aik ticket ka aik waqt mein aik hi owner hota hai. Aik ticket jisay assign nahi kiya gaya, woh ticket hai jis par koi kaam nahi kar raha — queue view isay wazeh kar deta hai.
  • SLA clock us waqt shuru hoti hai jab ticket banaya jata hai aur ruk jati hai jab agent customer ka intezar karta hai. Breaches woh report hain jo support lead har subah check karta hai.
  • HD Article sab se sasti support hai: har sawal ka aik dafa knowledge base mein jawab de diya jaye, to woh ticket kabhi nahi aata.
  • Aik Saved Reply jawabon ko consistent rakhta hai — aik hi sawal ka aik hi sahi jawab milta hai, chahe shift par koi bhi ho.

docs.title: Amli misaal — NexTash support, aik hafta
docs.text:
Aik client ki user Purchase Receipt post nahi kar sakti:

  1. Wo support ko email karti hai. Aik HD Ticket khud-ba-khud ban jata hai: type Question, priority High, customer un ke ERPNext Customer se linked.
  2. Ticket "ERP Support" team ki queue mein aata hai aur aik agent ko assign ho jata hai. SLA kehta hai pehla response 4 hours ke andar.
  3. Agent wajah dhoond leta hai — Purchase Receipt DocType par aik missing permission — aur fix ke saath jawab deta hai. Status → Replied.
  4. Client confirm karta hai ke kaam ho gaya. Status → Resolved → Closed.
  5. Wohi sawal doosray client se aata hai. Agent aik HD Article likhta hai ("Why you cannot submit a Purchase Receipt") aur aik Saved Reply jo us ki taraf ishara karta hai. Teesri dafa, jawab mein 30 seconds lagte hain.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Aik software company shared inbox se support chalati thi. Aik hi sawal ke paanch mukhtalif tareeqon se jawab diye jate thay, urgent requests routine wali requests ke peechay pari rehti theen, aur kisi ko nahi pata tha ke kitne tickets khule hue hain. Helpdesk ke baad, queue ne asli workload dikhaya, SLA report ne dikhaya ke first-response time aik din se gir kar do ghantay ho gaya, aur knowledge base ne repeat tickets aik tihai kam kar diye.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: NexTash ki apni client support Helpdesk par chalao — ye demo aur tool aik saath hai. Phir ye har us client ko becho jis ki support shared inbox ya WhatsApp par chalti hai: SLA report hi pitch hai ("aap ke customers ko pata hoga ke aap dinon mein nahi, ghanton mein jawab dete hain"), aur knowledge base phase-2 ki sale hai.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Koi SLA nahi. Targets ke baghair, "urgent" aik raay hai aur response time wohi hai jo ho gaya. SLA pehle din set karo.
  • Tickets jin ka koi owner nahi. Queue mein unassigned tickets numayan nazar aane chahiye — warna wo sar jate hain.
  • Confirm kiye baghair resolve karna. Aik ticket jo customer ki tasdeeq se pehle band kar diya jaye, woh ticket hai jo zyada gusse ke saath dobara khul jata hai.
  • Koi knowledge base nahi. Aik hi sawal ka das dafa jawab dena das tickets hain jinay aik article rok sakta tha.
  • Shared inbox mein support. Email mein na queue hai, na owner, na clock. Yehi woh cheez hai jisay Helpdesk replace karta hai.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 12 — Support & Portal — customer portal, communication, portal users.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Portal woh jagah hai jahan customers khud apni madad karte hain: wo log in karte hain aur apne orders, invoices, payments aur support tickets dekhte hain — kisi ko email kiye baghair. Aik Portal User aik contact hai jisay Customer se linked login diya gaya ho; portal unhain sirf un ke apne documents dikhata hai. Is ke peechay communication hai: document par har email, call aur comment us document par record hota hai, is liye aik customer ki poori history aik click ki doori par hoti hai. Portal "mera order kahan hai?" ko support ticket se aik aise page mein badal deta hai jo customer khud khol leta hai.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Portal User Customer contact ke liye aik login: user, Customer, roles. Customer par woh child table jo portal access deti hai. Customer Master: portal is customer ke apne orders, invoices aur tickets dikhata hai. Contact Customer ke paas woh shakhs: email, phone — jab access di jaye to Portal User ban jata hai. HD Customer Customer ka Helpdesk wala pehlu: un ke tickets ko ERPNext Customer se link karta hai. HD Ticket Woh cheez jo customer portal mein raise karta hai aur track karta hai. Web Form Aik public form (lead capture, ticket raising, feedback) jo system mein likhta hai. Website Settings Portal pages ke peechay site configuration. Issue Legacy ERPNext support ticket (HD Ticket se replace ho raha hai). Email / Comment Document par record ki gayi communication — har guftagu ki history.

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak ka flow
docs.text:
Setup:   Customer → Contact → Portal User (login + roles)
Visit:   customer logs in → sees their Sales Orders, Invoices, Payments
Ask:     customer raises an HD Ticket from the portal
Track:   ticket status visible in the portal; replies by email + portal
Pay:     customer sees outstanding invoices and pays (where configured)
Check:   portal usage, open tickets per customer, ageing receivables
  • Aik Portal User sirf apne Customer ke documents dekhta hai — User Permissions isay enforce karte hain. Aik portal login jo doosray customer ki invoices dekh sakta ho, woh data leak hai; go-live se pehle isay aik asli portal account se test karo.
  • Har email aur comment us document par store hota hai jis se is ka talluq hai. Jab customer call karta hai, to history un ke Sales Order ya ticket par hoti hai — kisi ko inbox mein dhoondna nahi parta.
  • Aik Web Form public front door hai: lead form, ticket form, feedback form. Ye seedha system mein likhta hai, is liye kuch dobara type nahi karna parta.
  • Aik behtar portal ke liye (custom pages, dashboards, document libraries), isay Frappe Builder se banao — website builder jo Frappe stack ke saath aata hai.

docs.title: Amli misaal — aik distributor, aik customer
docs.text:
Al-Noor Traders 200 retailers ko supply karta hai. Aik retailer, "Karachi Mart", baar baar call kar ke poochta hai ke us ki delivery kahan hai:

  1. Customer par aik Contact (store manager) banaya jata hai aur usay Portal User login diya jata hai.
  2. Wo log in karta hai aur apne Sales Orders (kya wada kiya gaya), Delivery Notes (kya ship hua, dates ke saath) aur Sales Invoices (kitna dena hai) dekhta hai.
  3. Aik delivery kam hoti hai. Wo portal se aik HD Ticket raise karta hai — ye support queue mein aata hai, us ka Customer pehle se linked hota hai.
  4. Agent jawab deta hai; jawab aur ticket status portal mein nazar aate hain. Agli "mera order kahan hai?" wali call kabhi nahi hoti.
  5. Mahine ke akhir mein, store manager apni statement khud portal se download kar leta hai — Al-Noor mein kisi ko bhejni nahi parti.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Aik supplier ki sales team roz aik ghanta "mera order kahan hai?" ka jawab dene aur statements email karne mein guzarti thi. Portal ke baad, customers ne khud orders check kiye, statements self-service ho gayin, aur support queue chhoti ho gayi — team ne woh ghanta bechne mein guzara. Portal aik barray customer ke rukne ki wajah bhi ban gaya: "aap ke competitors har cheez ke liye humein call karne par majboor karte hain."

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har B2B implementation mein portal ko self-service add-on ke tor par shamil karo — ye aik chhota setup hai (Portal Users + permissions) jis ka wazeh faida client ke customers mehsoos karte hain. Builder se bana hua custom portal page un clients ke liye fixed-price upsell hai jo standard pages se zyada chahte hain.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Permissions test kiye baghair portal access. Hamesha aik asli portal user ke tor par log in karo aur check karo ke wo sirf apne documents dekhta hai.
  • Ghalat contacts ke liye Portal Users. Sirf woh log jinhein account dekhna chahiye, login paate hain — account par mojood har email nahi.
  • System ke bahar communication. WhatsApp par tay honay walay deals jo kabhi record na hon, woh deals hain jo agla shakhs nahi dekh sakta. Isay document par log karo.
  • Portal mein koi ticket form nahi. Agar customers sirf email kar sakte hain, to portal aik display window hai, channel nahi. Form add karo.
  • Portal ko chhupana. Aik portal jis ke baaray mein kisi ko bataya hi na jaye, woh portal hai jisay koi istemal nahi karta. Go-live par is ka elan karo, har customer ko logins bhej kar.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 13 — Studio, Flow & Insights — Desk mein naye v16 tools.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: v16.60 (17 Nov 2026) ne teen cheezein core Desk experience mein la di hain. Studio — drag-and-drop app builder — Framework mein merge ho gaya, is liye chhoti apps baghair code ke visually banti hain. Frappe Flow (beta) Desk ke andar AI harness hai: aik LLM jo aap ke data ko analyse karta hai aur forms bharta hai, permission-aware, aap ki apni AI keys istemal kar ke. Insights dashboards ab Desk mein embed hote hain, is liye managers live charts wahin dekhte hain jahan wo kaam karte hain, Excel mein export karne ke bajaye. Mil kar ye badal dete hain ke "customisation" kya hai: developer ke kaam se aik aisi cheez jo aik analyst aik din mein bana sakta hai.

docs.title: Core pieces
docs.text:
Piece Ye kya hai Studio Aik mini-app visually banao: pages, layouts, data sources, CRUD — baghair code ke. Apps andar se standard Frappe apps hoti hain. Frappe Flow Desk mein AI harness (beta): apne data se sawal poocho, documents draft karo, forms bharo — AI sirf wohi dekhta hai jo user dekh sakta hai. Insights Dashboard Desk mein aik live dashboard: ERP data se charts aur numbers, kholne par refresh. Insights Workbook Mutaliq queries aur charts ka aik set, live data ki spreadsheet ki tarah jis par kaam kiya jaye. Insights Query Data ke khilaf aik sawal (SQL ya visual builder). Insights Data Source Woh jagah jahan se query parhti hai: aik DocType, aik table, ya aik external database. Insights Chart Query se bana hua aik chart.

Studio apps banata hai; Flow aap ke data ke baaray mein baat karta hai; Insights isay dikhata hai. In mein se koi bhi modules ko replace nahi karta — ye un ke upar baithte hain.

docs.title: Shuru se akhir tak ka flow
docs.text:
Build:   Studio → new mini-app (e.g. gate pass, sample tracking) → publish to Desktop
Ask:     Flow → "which customers are overdue?" → answer from live data, permission-aware
See:     Insights Dashboard → sales, stock, finance charts embedded in Desk
Act:     dashboard number → drill into the document → fix it there
  • Studio us chhoti app ke liye hai jo developer ko justify nahi karti: visitor register, gate pass, sample tracking, asset check-in. Isay visually banao, Desktop par publish karo, aur ye kisi bhi doosri app ki tarah behave karti hai.
  • Flow design se hi permission-aware hai: ye sirf wohi dekh sakta hai jo signed-in user dekh sakta hai. Ye permissions ko bypass nahi karta, aur ye aap ki apni AI keys istemal karta hai — data aap ke AI provider ke paas jata hai, Frappe ke paas nahi.
  • Desk mein Insights ka matlab hai ke dashboard wahin hai jahan kaam hota hai. Query aik dafa banao, chart ko dashboard par lagao, aur manager Desk khol kar isay dekh leta hai — na export, na purani spreadsheet.
  • v16.61 ne Flow public agents aur aik AI assistant add kiya jo images dekh sakta hai — naye monthly release train par harness har mahine barh raha hai.

docs.title: Amli misaal — aik din mein aik gate pass app
docs.text:
Aik factory ka gate pass aik kagaz ki slip hai: kis ne kya bahar le jaya, guard ke dastakhat ke saath:

  1. Studio mein, aik analyst "Gate Pass" mini-app banata hai: aik form (item, qty, vehicle, driver, purpose), aik list view, aur aik approval step.
  2. App Desktop par publish ho jati hai. Guard phone par isay khol kar har pass log karta hai; store manager Desk se approve karta hai.
  3. Manager Flow se poochta hai: "how many gate passes this week, and for which items?" — jawab live data se aata hai, numbers ke saath.
  4. Aik Insights Dashboard rozana passes aur gate se nikalne wali top items dikhata hai — pilferage pattern ki pehli nishani, kisi report ko chalaye baghair nazar aa jati hai.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Aik client ke quality head ko aik sample-tracking register chahiye tha — labs ko bhejay gaye samples, wapas aane walay results, expiry dates. Coded app ke tor par ye do hafton ka kaam tha; Studio mein ye aik analyst ne aik din mein bana liya, lab results aik form se enter hote thay jisay lab technician istemal kar sakta tha. Client ko app usi hafte mil gayi jis hafte unhon ne manga tha — aur unhon ne do aur mangi.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Studio se bani mini-apps ko aik nayi service line ke tor par offer karo — fixed-price, dinon mein bani hui, har app ke hisab se billed. Aik NexTash analyst ko Studio par train karo taake chhoti apps developer ka waqt lena band kar dein. Flow ko aik dostana client ko test site par pilot ke tor par offer karo ("ask your ERP" un ke apne data par) isay wasee paimane par bechne se pehle.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Studio mein woh banana jo module mein hona chahiye. Agar app asal mein Manufacturing ya HR hai, to module istemal karo. Studio modules ke aas-paas ke gap ke liye hai, un ki jagah lene ke liye nahi.
  • Flow ke jawab par check kiye baghair bharosa karna. Flow data ko analyse karta hai; ye isay ghalat samajh sakta hai. Jawab aik shuruaat hai — report se verify karo.
  • Dashboards jinhein koi nahi kholta. Aik dashboard jo teen clicks ki gehrai mein daba ho, woh decoration hai. Woh aik number jo ahem hai, Desktop par lagao.
  • AI keys aise logon ko dena jo un ke malik nahi. Flow aap ki apni AI keys istemal karta hai — faisla karo ke ye kis ke account aur budget ki hain, pilot se pehle, bill ke baad nahi.
  • Permission check chhor dena. Flow permissions ka ehtaram karta hai, lekin pehle andar walay roles sahi hone chahiye — aik over-permissioned user AI ko over-informed bana deta hai.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 14 — Cross-Module Flows — forecast → MPS → MRP, sales → stock → accounts.

docs.title: Ye kya karta hai
docs.text: Koi module akela kaam nahi karta. Aik sale stock istemal karti hai, stock purchase trigger karta hai, purchase ledger mein post hoti hai, aur forecast production plan chalata hai. Ye lesson us naqshe ka hai ke modules kaise jurtay hain — woh teen flows jo har asli implementation mein chalte hain. Agar aap inhein samajhte hain, to aap system mein kisi bhi number ko us document tak trace kar sakte hain jis ne isay banaya tha, aur aap client ko samjha sakte hain ke aik ghalat entry teen modules mein kyun goonjti hai.

docs.title: Core DocTypes
docs.text: DocType Ye kya hai Sales Forecast Har item, har period ke liye expected demand — shuruati andaza. Master Production Schedule Har period mein kya banana hai, is ka plan, forecast aur asli orders se. Production Plan Planner: schedule aur Sales Orders ko Work Orders aur Material Requests mein badalta hai. Material Request (Manufacture) "Humein produce karne ke liye ye raw materials chahiye." Production Plan se raise hota hai. Work Order Plan se banaya gaya production order. Purchase Order Woh kami khareedta hai jo plan ne payi. Stock Entry Materials ko move karta hai aur finished goods ko post karta hai. Sales Order Confirm shuda customer order — plan ka doosra input. Delivery Note Goods ship karta hai, stock bahar move karta hai. Sales Invoice Revenue book karta hai; customer ko paisay dene hain. Payment Entry Isay collect karta hai.

docs.title: Flow 1 — forecast → MPS → MRP (planning)
docs.text:
Sales Forecast → Master Production Schedule → Production Plan
