   (what we expect to sell)   (what we plan to make)   (what to order + make)
        → Material Request (Manufacture) → Purchase Order → Purchase Receipt
        → Work Order → Job Cards → Stock Entry (Manufacture) → finished stock
  • Sales Forecast aik andaza hai; Master Production Schedule isay har period ke liye make-plan mein badal deta hai; Production Plan isay asli documents mein explode kar deta hai — jo banana hai us ke liye Work Orders, jo chahiye us ke liye Material Requests.
  • Plan pehle available stock check karta hai. Ye sirf wohi order karta hai jo kam hai. Aik plan jo ghalat stock ke saath chalaya jaye, woh plan hai jo woh order karta hai jo aap ke paas pehle se hai.
  • MRP (Material Requirements Planning) yehi explosion hai: demand minus stock minus on-order, har item, har date ke liye. Production Plan woh jagah hai jahan ERPNext ye karta hai.

docs.title: Flow 2 — sales → stock → accounts (rozana ka loop)
docs.text:
Sales Order → Delivery Note (stock out) → Sales Invoice (revenue) → Payment Entry (cash)
     ↑                ↓
  reserves stock   Bin down, SLE written, ledger posted — one submit, three effects
  • Aik submit teen jagah post karta hai: Delivery Note stock move karta hai, Sales Invoice revenue aur receivable book karta hai, Payment Entry isay clear karta hai. Isi liye submitted document ko edit karna mana hai — teenon records mein ikhtilaf ho jayega.
  • Wohi loop ulta: Purchase Order → Purchase Receipt (stock in, value booked) → Purchase Invoice (liability) → Payment Entry.

docs.title: Flow 3 — production → QC → sales (factory ka loop)
docs.text:
Work Order → Job Cards → Quality Inspection → finished stock → Delivery Note → invoice
   (make it)    (track it)   (prove it)        (sell it)
  • Production Quality ko feed karta hai (lesson 06) aur Quality Sales ko gate karti hai: aik batch jo inspection mein fail ho jaye, woh kabhi Delivery Note tak nahi pahunchta.
  • Batch traceability loop ko jor kar rakhti hai: woh pack jo customer ke paas hai, wo Work Order, raw-material batch, supplier aur us inspection tak trace hota hai jis ne isay pass kiya tha.

docs.title: Amli misaal — aik spice manufacturer, aik mahina
docs.text:
fmc demo client (fmc) October ki planning karta hai:

  1. Sales Forecast: October ke liye 2,000 kg chilli powder, pichlay saal ki sales aur naye distributor ke order se.
  2. Master Production Schedule: 2,000 kg banana hai, har hafte 500 kg.
  3. Production Plan chalta hai: haath mein stock 300 kg hai, is liye ye 1,700 kg ke liye Work Orders aur 1,800 kg raw chilli ke liye Material Requests banata hai (process loss ki gunjaish rakh kar). Requests Purchase Orders ban jati hain.
  4. Raw chilli aa jati hai (Purchase Receipt → Quality Inspection → raw store mein accept). Work Orders haftawar chalte hain; Job Cards grinding aur packing log karte hain; Stock Entry (Manufacture) har 500 kg batch par 490 kg book karta hai.
  5. Distributor ke orders ship hote hain: Delivery Note (FEFO — sab se purana batch pehle) → Sales Invoice → Payment Entry. Ledger revenue dikhata hai; stock report dikhati hai ke kya bacha hai; November ka plan asli numbers se shuru hota hai, andaze se nahi.

docs.title: Asli use case
docs.text:
Aik manufacturer Excel mein planning karta tha: planner demand ka andaza lagata, purchasing andaze se khareedti, aur production aik raw material se khali ho jati jab ke doosra dher ho jata. ERPNext mein forecast → MPS → MRP ke baad, plan asli orders aur asli stock se chala — aik material store mein expire hona band ho gaya, aur "humare paas chilli khatam ho gayi" wali emergency haftawar meeting se ghaib ho gayi.

Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: planning chain (forecast → MPS → MRP) har us textile, food aur spare-parts manufacturer ko pitch karo jo ab bhi Excel mein plan karta hai — ye woh v16 feature hai jo upgrade ko justify karta hai, aur demo (forecast andar, Work Orders aur Purchase Orders bahar) sale close kar deta hai. Sales → stock → accounts loop woh pehla flow hai jo har naye user ko sikhana hai: aik submit, teen effects.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Purane forecast se planning karna. Aik forecast jo kabhi update na ho, woh plan hai jo pichlay quarter ke andaze par bana hai. Isay mahana refresh karo.
  • Ghalat stock ke saath plan chalana. Plan Bin par bharosa karta hai. Agar stock ghalat hai, to plan ghalat order karta hai — pehle stock theek karo (Stock Reconciliation).
  • Modules ko alag systems samajhna. Aik "stock problem" aksar sales problem hota hai (koi Sales Order nahi) ya buying problem (koi Purchase Receipt nahi). Flow ko trace karo, symptom ko patch na karo.
  • Factory loop mein QC chhor dena. Aik batch jo delivery ke baad inspection mein fail ho, woh recall hai; delivery se pehle ye rework hai.
  • Bhool jana ke loop hi audit trail hai. Report mein har number aik document se aata hai. Agar aik number ghalat hai, to document dhoondo — report ko kabhi edit na karo.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: Aap ne ERPNext path mukammal kar liya hai: Core, Operations, People & Customers, aur v16. Poora map learn/erpnext/README.md mein hai.

docs.title: Seekho: Frappe Framework — Noob to Pro
docs.text: Tarteeb wala rasta: pehle beginner, phir advanced. Har topic: yeh kya hai, kab use karein, aik chhoti si misaal, aam ghaltiyan.

docs.title: Level 1 — Yahan se shuru karein
docs.text:
1. Frappe kya hai — Framework vs ERPNext vs Frappe Cloud
  2. Bench, sites aur apps — install, setup, pehli site
  3. Apna pehla DocType — fields, field types, layout (Section / Column Breaks)
  4. Desk, List View, Form View — users asal mein kaise kaam karte hain

docs.title: Level 2 — Banayein
docs.text:
1. Server Scripts aur Document Events — logic kahan honi chahiye
  2. Client Scripts — form behaviour, validation, UX
  3. APIs — frappe.call, REST, whitelisted methods
  4. Reports — Script Reports, Query Reports, Print Formats
  5. Permissions aur Roles — Role Permissions, field-level, User Permissions
  6. Workflows aur Assignments

docs.title: Level 3 — Achhi tarah chalayein
docs.text:
1. Scheduler, Background Jobs aur Queues
  2. Notifications, Email aur Integrations
  3. Testing — unit tests, UI tests
  4. Performance — indexes, query patterns, caching
  5. Security — kya kabhi na karein, permission hardening
  6. Debugging — logs, aam errors, traceback kaise parhein

docs.title: Level 4 — Aage ki cheezein
docs.text:
1. Studio aur Flow — no-code apps, Desk mein AI (v16.60+)
  2. Insights — live data par dashboards
  3. Website aur Portal — Frappe Website, Web Forms
  4. Upgrades — v14 → v15 → v16, readiness checks
  5. Ops — backups, monitoring, multi-site, Frappe Cloud vs self-hosted

Gehri reference: frappe_core_skills — 22 skills jo in topics ko tafseel se cover karti hain.

docs.title: 01 — Frappe Kya Hai: Framework vs ERPNext vs Frappe Cloud
Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Teen alag cheezein ek hi naam "Frappe" share karti hain. In ko aapas mein mila dena woh pehli ghalti hai jo aksar beginners karte hain.

Frappe Framework — platform. Python aur JavaScript mein aik full-stack web framework, MariaDB, Redis aur Node.js par. Yeh aap ko, box se bahar hi, yeh sab deta hai:

  • DocTypes — aik definition jo database table, form, list view, API aur permissions bana deti hai.
  • Desk — admin UI jis mein aap ke users har roz kaam karte hain.
  • REST API, background jobs, scheduler, workflows, reports, print formats, email aur notifications — sab built-in hain, koi extra libraries jorne ki zaroorat nahi.

Framework MIT-licensed hai aur open source hai. Current version: v16, monthly releases ke saath (16.60, 16.61, …). v16.60 se, Studio (no-code app builder) aur Flow (Desk mein AI) Framework ke andar hi aate hain.

ERPNext — Frappe par bana hua business app. Accounting, Stock, Selling, Buying, Manufacturing, HR, CRM, Projects, Assets, Helpdesk. Yeh aik app hai jo aik Frappe site par chalta hai, bilkul usi tarah jaise aap ka apna custom app chalta hai. GPL-3.0 licensed hai. Jab koi kehta hai "hum ERPNext chalate hain", to us ka matlab hai aik Frappe site jis par ERPNext app install hai.

Frappe Cloud — hosted Frappe. Aap ki sites Frappe ki infrastructure par chalti hain. Aap dashboard se Git repo se custom apps deploy karte hain. Is mein shell access nahi hai, aur shared benches par Server Scripts bhi nahi hain. Aap control ke badle mein zero server work lete hain.

Doosri Frappe apps bhi isi pattern par chalti hain: HRMS, CRM, Helpdesk, Insights, Raven, Builder, Wiki, Drive — har aik aik app hai jo aap site par install karte hain.

Aik line mein mental model: Framework engine hai, ERPNext us par bani hui gaari hai, Frappe Cloud driver ke saath gaari kiraye par lena hai.

docs.title: Yeh pieces aapas mein kaise fit hote hain
docs.text:
bench  (a folder on your machine or server)
 ├── apps/      frappe, erpnext, my_app, hrms, ...
 └── sites/     site1.local, client-a.com, ...
                 └── each site = one database + files

Aik bench mein kai sites hoti hain. Aik site par kai apps chalte hain. Aik document (aik Sales Order, aik Employee, aik custom record) hamesha aik hi site se belong karta hai.

docs.title: Kis cheez ko kab use karein
docs.text: Goal Use Seekhna hai, ya custom app banana hai Local bench par Framework Business ko end to end chalana hai ERPNext (Cloud ya self-hosted) Client ko zero server work chahiye Frappe Cloud Shell access, custom infra, local-only data rules chahiye Self-hosted bench Bechne ke liye product banana hai Framework par custom app (agar ERP ko extend kare to ERPNext bhi) Aik client ke liye jaldi prototype banana hai Code likhne se pehle Framework + Studio (v16.60+)

docs.title: Chhoti si misaal — khud dekh lein
docs.text:
Aik bench par jis par ERPNext pehle se install hai:

bench --version        # the bench CLI version
bench list-apps        # apps on this bench: frappe, erpnext, ...
bench --site mysite.local list-apps   # apps installed on one site

Phir http://mysite.local:8000 kholein aur Administrator ke tor par sign in karein:

  • Upar wale search bar mein "Company" search karein — yeh aik ERPNext DocType hai.
  • "DocType" search karein — yeh Framework ki apni DocTypes ki list hai.
  • "Sales Invoice" search karein — yeh phir ERPNext hai. Har screen jo aap dekhte hain, woh aik DocType hai jo Framework render karta hai.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Yeh samajhna ke ERPNext hi Frappe hai. ERPNext aik app hai. Framework woh platform hai jis par sab kuch chalta hai. Aap Frappe bilkul ERPNext ke baghair bhi chala sakte hain.
  • ERPNext ki files ko seedha edit karna. Kabhi doosri app ka code edit na karein. Usay apni app se hooks, overrides aur fixtures ke zariye extend karein.
  • Aik chhote client ke liye self-hosting karna jise sirf ERPNext chahiye. Aik server plus aap ka maintenance time, aksar chhoti sites ke liye Frappe Cloud se zyada kharcha karta hai.
  • Cloud chunna jab client ko shell-level kaam chahiye — custom system packages, local-only data, ya direct database access. Cloud mein shell nahi hai.
  • Code se shuru karna, yeh check kiye baghair ke kya pehle se mojood hai. ERPNext, HRMS, CRM aur Apps Catalog pehle se aksar requirements hal kar chuke hote hain. Sirf gap banayein.

docs.title: Ahem terms — yeh yaad rakhein
docs.text:
• DocType — record type ki definition (table + form + list + rules).
  • Document — aik record (aik Sales Order, aik Employee).
  • Desk — web UI.
  • bench — CLI aur folder jo apps aur sites ko sambhalta hai.
  • site — aik database + installed apps ka aik set.
  • app — DocTypes, code aur fixtures ka aik package (frappe, erpnext, aap ka apna).
  • docstatus — 0 Draft, 1 Submitted, 2 Cancelled. Aap ko yeh har ERPNext lesson mein milega.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 02 — Bench, sites aur apps — isay install karein aur apni pehli site aur app banayein.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
bench woh command-line tool hai jo sab kuch banata aur manage karta hai: bench folder, us ke andar ki apps, aur un par chalne wali sites.

  • Aik bench aik folder hai. Is mein apps/, sites/, config/ aur env/ hote hain.
  • Aik site aik database plus us ki files hai. Aik bench mein kai sites ho sakti hain.
  • Aik app DocTypes, Python/JS code aur fixtures ka aik package hai. Apps apps/ mein rehti hain aur kuch karne se pehle site par install hoti hain.

docs.title: Prerequisites (v16)
docs.text:
Item Version Python 3.14 Node.js 24+ (plus Yarn 1.22+) MariaDB 11.8 documented (10.6 works in practice) Redis required — caching, queues, realtime

bench khud uv se install karein (yeh current official tareeqa hai):

uv tool install frappe-bench
bench --version

docs.title: Chhoti si working misaal — zero se chalti hui site tak
docs.text:
# 1. Create a bench on the v16 branch
bench init --frappe-branch version-16 frappe-bench
cd frappe-bench

# 2. Download ERPNext (same major version as Frappe — never mix v15 and v16)
bench get-app --branch version-16 erpnext

# 3. Create a site and install ERPNext on it in one step
bench new-site mysite.local --install-app erpnext
#    (prompts for the MariaDB root password, then the Administrator password)

# 4. Create your own app
bench new-app my_app
#    (prompts for title, description, publisher, email, licence)

# 5. Install your app on the site
bench --site mysite.local install-app my_app

# 6. Start everything
bench start
#    Open http://mysite.local:8000 — sign in as Administrator

Har command ne kya kiya:

Command What it does bench init Bench folder banata hai, us mein Frappe install karta hai bench get-app App ko apps/ mein download karta hai — abhi kahin install nahi karta bench new-site Naya database + site folder banata hai; --install-app app ko foran install kar deta hai bench new-app apps/ mein nayi custom app ka scaffold banata hai bench --site X install-app App ko aik site par activate karta hai (us ki tables banata hai) bench start Development ke liye web server, workers aur scheduler chalata hai

Roz ke kaam ke useful commands:

bench use mysite.local                 # make this the default site (skip --site)
bench list-apps                        # apps on the bench
bench --site mysite.local list-apps    # apps installed on one site
bench --site mysite.local migrate      # apply DocType / patch / fixture changes
bench --site mysite.local backup --with-files --compress
bench --site mysite.local console      # Python shell inside the site
bench --site mysite.local clear-cache  # after hooks.py changes
bench --site mysite.local enable-scheduler

docs.title: Kis command ko kab use karein
docs.text:
• Naya project → bench init, phir bench new-app, phir aik site.
  • Mojooda bench par nayi client site → sirf bench new-site.
  • Site par ERPNext / HRMS / CRM add karna → bench get-app (har bench par aik dafa), phir bench --site … install-app (har site par aik dafa).
  • Aap ne DocType, patch ya fixture change kiya → bench migrate.
  • Aap ne public JS/CSS change kiya → bench build --app my_app.
  • Aap ne hooks.py change kiya → bench clear-cache.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• bench ko root ke tor par chalana. Aik dedicated frappe user use karein. Kabhi sudo bench na karein.
  • Major versions ko mila dena. Frappe v16 + ERPNext v15 (ya ulta) toot jata hai. Dono ko --branch version-16 se pin karein.
  • migrate bhool jana. DocType JSON, patches aur fixtures sirf bench --site … migrate par apply hote hain. Agar aap ka naya field missing hai, to pehle migrate karein.
  • App folder ko haath se delete karna. bench remove-app use karein — yeh database tables bhi remove karta hai. Haath se delete kiya hua folder aik tooti hui site chhor deta hai.
  • Update / migrate / restore se pehle backup na lena. Pehle backup lein, aur kam se kam aik dafa staging site par restore test karein — aik backup jise aap ne kabhi restore nahi kiya, woh backup nahi hai.
  • Aik bench, aik site, hamesha ke liye. Benches saste hain. Dev, staging aur production ko alag benches (ya alag servers) par rakhein, kabhi aik site par nahi.
  • Production ko bench start par chalana. Yeh development server hai. Production mein nginx + supervisor (bench setup production) ya Docker use hota hai.

docs.title: Khud ko check karein
docs.text: Upar wali misaal ke baad aap ko yeh jawab dena aana chahiye: bench par kaun si apps hain, mysite.local par kaun si install hain, aur bench start ne kya print kiya. Agar site nahi khulti, to pehle terminal output check karein — ghalti aksar ghalat MariaDB password ya pehle se use ho raha port hoti hai.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 03 — Apna pehla DocType — fields, types aur saaf layout ke saath aik record type define karein.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Aik DocType record type ki definition hai. Aik definition aap ko aik saath paanch cheezein deti hai: database table, form, list view, REST API, aur permissions. Agar aap DocType achhi tarah define kar sakte hain, to aap Frappe ka zyada tar hissa bana sakte hain.

Har DocType aap ki app mein aik JSON file hai:

my_app/
  my_app/doctype/gate_pass/gate_pass.json   # the definition
  my_app/doctype/gate_pass/gate_pass.py     # server logic (controller)
  my_app/doctype/gate_pass/gate_pass.js     # form behaviour (UX only)

docs.title: Chhoti si working misaal — aik Gate Pass
docs.text:
Aik factory ko gate pass chahiye: kaun aaya, kis company ke liye, kyun, aur kya andar ya bahar le gaya. Isay pehle UI mein banayein (Desk → search "DocType" → New), Module apni app par set kar ke aur developer_mode on kar ke, taake JSON aap ki app mein save ho.

Fields — isi order mein:

# Fieldname Label Type Notes 1 naming_series Series Select Options: GP-.YYYY.-.#### 2 gate_pass_date Date Date Default: Today 3 visitor_name Visitor Data Required 4 company Company Link Options: Company 5 purpose Purpose Select Visit / Delivery / Pickup 6 section_break_1 Details Section Break starts the items section 7 items Items Table Options: Gate Pass Item 8 remarks Remarks Small Text

Child table Gate Pass Item (apni DocType, "Is Child Table" mark ki hui):

Fieldname Label Type Notes item_name Item Data In List View qty Qty Int In List View direction Direction Select In / Out

Naming: Autoname ko naming_series par set karein. Pehla pass GP-2026-0001 ban jata hai. Agar aap Autoname khali chhor dein, to Frappe records ko aik hash se naam deta hai jise koi parh nahi sakta — hamesha isay set karein.

UI mein banane ke baad, isay site par apply karein:

bench --site mysite.local migrate

Phir Desk mein Gate Pass → New kholein aur aik banayein. Aap ne abhi zero code ke saath aik working app screen bana li hai.

docs.title: Field types jo aap sab se zyada use karein ge
docs.text:
Type For Example Data short text visitor name Link a record in another DocType Company, Customer, Item Select fixed list of options purpose, status Date / Datetime dates pass date, due date Currency / Float / Int numbers amount, qty, rate Check yes/no is active Text / Small Text longer text remarks, address Table child rows items, taxes Attach / Attach Image files CNIC copy, photo Section Break / Column Break / Tab Break layout only (no data stored)

Aam usool: agar value kisi master record se match honi chahiye, to Link use karein, kabhi free text nahi. Company ke naam ke liye free text ka matlab hai baad mein aik hi company ki das spellings.

docs.title: Layout rules — koi bhi field add karne se pehle yeh parhein
docs.text:
Kharab field layout sab se aam beginner ghalti hai. Yeh paanch rules asal projects se aaye hain (dekhein guides/common-mistakes.md):

  1. Pehle form ko parhein. Field add karne se pehle mojooda form kholein. Us flow mein add karein jo pehle se hai — fields ko end par bolt-on na karein.
  2. Position insert_after se dein. Har naya field us field ka naam deta hai jis ke baad woh aata hai. Position ke baghair fields neeche aik dher mein aa jate hain.
  3. Har row mein do fields. Aik row yeh hai: field, Column Break, field, phir aik Section Break agle row ko shuru karta hai. Kabhi aik column mein chhe fields stack na karein — form aik lambi, na parhne wali scroll ban jata hai.
  4. Child table ko apna section mile. Us se pehle Section Break lagayein, saaf label ke saath ("Items"). Do data fields ke beech dabbi hui table tooti hui lagti hai aur aasani se miss ho jati hai.
  5. List View mein max 4–5 columns. Sirf un fields par In List View tick karein jin ko user record dhoondne ke liye scan karta hai. Baaki sab form par hai.

Gate Pass par apply karein: Section 1 mein series, date, visitor, company, purpose hain (har row mein do); Section 2 ("Items") mein sirf table hai; remarks end par apni row mein hain.

docs.title: DocType kab use karein vs Custom Field
docs.text:
• Naya record type (Gate Pass, Sample Request, Service Ticket) → apni app mein naya DocType.
  • Kisi aur ke DocType par aik extra field (Delivery Note par "Transporter" field) → Custom Field, fixture ke tor par export karein — doosri app ka DocType JSON kabhi edit na karein.
  • Apne DocType par aik-off field → usay DocType mein add karein, sahi position par, upar wale paanch rules ko follow karte hue.

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Koi Section / Column Breaks nahi. 20 fields ka aik lamba column. Users ko is se nafrat hai, aur yeh pehli cheez hai jo aik reviewer flag karega.
  • Link ki jagah free text. "Customer" Data ke tor par, Customer se Link ke bajaye — reports aur filters toot jate hain.
  • Apne section ke baghair child table. Yeh cramped render hoti hai aur miss ho jati hai.
  • Sab kuch In List View. List mein das columns, jin mein se aadhe khali hain. Isay 4–5 par rakhein.
  • Koi naming series nahi. Hash se naam wale records phone par nahi milte.
  • DocType ko ghalat module mein banana. Yeh ghalat app mein aa jata hai aur ship nahi ho sakta. Shuru karne se pehle Module set karein.
  • migrate skip karna. DocType UI mein mojood hai lekin table tab tak nahi banti jab tak aap migrate nahi karte.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 04 — Desk, List View, Form View — users asal mein un records ke saath kaise kaam karte hain jo aap ne abhi define kiye hain.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text: Desk woh web UI hai jis mein har Frappe user rehta hai. Is ke teen hisse hain jin ko aap ko samajhna hai: Workspace (home screen), List View (records dhoondein), aur Form View (aik record par kaam karein). Aap ka DocType automatically teeno le leta hai — aap ka kaam hai in ko usable banana.

docs.title: Desk shell
docs.text:
• Sidebar — modules aur workspaces. Workspaces un DocTypes, reports aur dashboards ko group karte hain jo aik role ko chahiye. Aik workspace jis ka Module set nahi hai, woh har Desk user ko nazar aata hai — module set karein, aur finance/HR workspaces ko role se restrict karein.
  • Search bar (Awesomebar) — DocType, document ka naam, ya report type karein aur seedha wahan pahunch jayein. Isi tarah experienced users navigate karte hain; sidebar discovery ke liye hai.
  • Notifications aur assignments — ghanti, aur forms par "Assigned To" list. Kaam user ke paas aata hai, user ko usay dhoondna nahi parta.
  • User menu (upar right) — "About" batata hai ke site par kaun se versions chal rahe hain.

docs.title: List View — dhoondna aur triage karna
docs.text:
List View aik sawal ka jawab deti hai: kin records par tawajju chahiye?

  • Columns un fields se aate hain jo In List View mark kiye gaye hain (max 4–5 — dekhein Lesson 03). Yahi woh hain jin ko user scan karta hai. Woh fields chunein jo record ko pehchanti hain: naam, date, party, status, amount.
  • Filters — status, date, company, owner se filter karein. Aik filter ko named view ke tor par save karein ("My open orders", "Overdue invoices") taake team usay share kare.
  • Sort — transactions ke liye default newest first hai; jab kaam ko oldest-first chahiye to isay badlein (misal ke tor par, sab se purana unpaid invoice).
  • Views — List, Report, Kanban (status ke hisab se), Calendar, Gantt, Tree. Kanban pipeline ke liye sahi view hai (leads, support tickets); plain list triage ke liye sahi hai.
  • Bulk actions — rows select karein aur bulk mein Assign, print, export ya delete karein.
  • List Settings (gear icon) — baghair code ke chunein ke kaun se columns nazar aayein.

Aik achhi list user ko record seconds mein dhoondne deti hai aur us ki state aik nazar mein dikhati hai. Aik buri list 12 columns chauri, unfiltered, aur ghalat sort ke saath hoti hai.

docs.title: Form View — aik record par kaam karna
docs.text:
Form View jawab deti hai: yeh record kya hai, aur is ke saath mujhe kya karna hai?

  • Sections aur tabs — woh layout jo aap ne DocType mein define kiya tha. Sections mutaliqa fields ko group karte hain; tabs lambi form ko split karte hain (Details / Items / Terms).
  • Child tables — form ke andar rows (items, taxes). In ka apna section aur apne columns hote hain.
  • Status bar — Draft / Submitted / Cancelled (docstatus), plus workflow state jab Workflow active ho.
  • Save / Submit / Cancel / Amend — Save Draft ko editable rakhta hai. Submit isay lock kar deta hai aur us ke effects post karta hai (stock moves, GL entries). Cancel un ko reverse karta hai. Amend cancelled wale se linked naya Draft banata hai. Submitted document ke fields ko kabhi seedha edit na karein.
  • Timeline — har comment, assignment, attachment aur version change, order mein. Yeh audit trail hai — isi liye "bas mujhe call kar lein" koi process nahi hai.
  • Actions menu — Print, Email, Share, Duplicate, aur linked document ke liye "New" (misal ke tor par, Sales Order se Sales Invoice).
  • Customize (developer mode mein) — form se hi field add karein ya label change karein. Jaldi fix ke liye handy hai; baad mein isay fixture ke tor par ship karein.

docs.title: Chhoti si misaal — Desk mein aik subah ka kaam
docs.text:
Aap sales user hain. Subah 9 baje hain.

  1. Selling workspace kholein — aap ki quotations aur orders wahan hain.
  2. Sales Order → List kholein, Status = "To Deliver" filter karein, Delivery Date se sort karein. Overdue wale upar hain.
  3. Pehla order kholein. Form customer, items, taxes, aur status bar ("To Deliver and Bill") dikhata hai.
  4. Actions menu se Delivery Note banayein. Submit karein — stock bahar move ho jata hai. Timeline record karta hai ke kis ne kiya aur kab.
  5. List mein wapas jayein, order ab "To Bill" parhta hai. Sales Invoice usi tarah banayein. Ho gaya — order "Completed" hai.

Koi code nahi likha gaya. Yeh pura flow DocTypes, lists aur forms ka apna kaam karna hai.

docs.title: Kis view ko kab use karein
docs.text: Job View Record dhoondna List, filter ke saath Dekhna ke kya overdue / pending hai List, sorted aur filtered Pipeline par kaam karna (leads, tickets) Kanban Aik record enter ya check karna Form Dekhna ke record ke saath kya kuch hua Form → Timeline Meeting ke liye export karna List → Report view ya Export

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• List ko edit karne ki jagah samajhna. List dhoondne ke liye hai. Form par edit karein — validation, permissions aur timeline wahin hain.
  • List mein zyada columns. 4–5 se zyada hon to koi list ko scan nahi kar sakta.
  • Koi saved filters nahi. Har user roz "my open orders" dobara banata hai. Filter aik dafa save karein, role ke saath share karein.
  • Field ko JS mein chhupa kar "secure" karna. Chhupana security nahi hai — koi bhi field ko API se parh sakta hai. Is ke bajaye permlevel (field-level permission) use karein.
  • Timeline ke bajaye memory se kaam karna. Agar yeh timeline mein nahi hai, to yeh hua hi nahi. Comments aur assignments document par hone chahiye.
  • Sab ke liye aik workspace. Aik sales user ko payroll workspace nahi chahiye. Workspaces per role hote hain, per site nahi.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: Aap ne Level 1 mukammal kar liya hai. Aap Frappe ko explain kar sakte hain, bench chala sakte hain, saaf layout ke saath DocType define kar sakte hain, aur Desk mein kaam kar sakte hain. Level 2 Server Scripts aur Document Events se shuru hota hai — jahan logic hoti hai.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Server-side logic woh logic hai jo lazmi chalni chahiye — validation, totals, status changes, linked records banana. Yeh server par chalti hai, is liye koi bhi isay browser ya API se bypass nahi kar sakta. Is ke rehne ki teen jagahain hain, aur ghalat jagah chunna Level 2 ki sab se aam ghalti hai:

Kahan Kis ke liye Controller (gate_pass.py) Apni app ke DocType par logic Server Script (Desk → Server Script) Ek quick rule, app deploy kiye baghair doc_events in hooks.py Doosri app ke DocType par logic (Sales Order, Delivery Note)

Controller document ki zindagi ke fixed points par chalta hai — yeh hooks hain:

Hook Kab chalta hai before_insert Naya document pehli dafa save hone se pehle validate Har save se pehle (yeh "Before Save" hai) before_save Validate ke baad, save likhne se pehle on_update Har save ke baad before_submit / on_submit Submit ke aas paas (posting yahin hoti hai) before_cancel / on_cancel Cancel ke aas paas (reversals yahin hote hain) on_trash Delete se pehle

docs.title: Chhoti si working example — Gate Pass controller
docs.text:
Pehle, Lesson 03 wale Gate Pass DocType par Is Submittable tick karein, taake Submit maujood ho. Phir controller:

# my_app/my_module/doctype/gate_pass/gate_pass.py
import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.model.document import Document


class GatePass(Document):
    def validate(self):
        # Delivery / Pickup passes must list what is carried
        if self.purpose in ("Delivery", "Pickup") and not self.items:
            frappe.throw(
                _("Add at least one item for a {0} pass").format(self.purpose)
            )
        for row in self.items:
            if row.qty <= 0:
                frappe.throw(
                    _("Row {0}: Qty must be greater than 0").format(row.idx)
                )

    def on_submit(self):
        # A reminder for whoever submitted it — created by the system
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "ToDo",
            "description": _("Gate Pass {0} for {1} submitted").format(
                self.name, self.visitor_name
            ),
            "reference_type": self.doctype,
            "reference_name": self.name,
            "allocated_to": frappe.session.user,
            "status": "Open",
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)  # system-created, not a user action

validate / before_save ke andar rules: self par fields direct set karein, kabhi self.save() call na karein. on_update / on_submit ke andar, agar aap ko apne hi fields badalne hon, to self.db_set("field", value) use karein. frappe.utils helpers use karein (flt, getdate, add_days, date_diff) — doc fields par kabhi float() / int() na use karein, jo None bhi ho sakte hain.

docs.title: Wohi rule, code deploy kiye baghair — ek Server Script
docs.text:
Desk → Server Script search karein → New. Type: Document Event, Document Type: Sales Order, DocType Event: Before Save:

# No import statements — frappe and frappe.utils are pre-loaded
if doc.delivery_date and frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.delivery_date, frappe.utils.today()) < 0:
    frappe.throw(_("Delivery Date cannot be in the past"))

Server Scripts RestrictedPython sandbox mein chalte hain: koi import nahi, koi raise nahi ( frappe.throw use karein), aur v14–v15 par try/except blocked hai — frappe.db.exists() jaise if checks use karein. v15+ par yeh by default disabled hote hain; bench set-config -g server_script_enabled 1 se enable karein. Frappe Cloud shared benches par available nahi hain.

Event name trap: Server Script mein "Before Save" validate hook hai, before_save nahi. "After Save" on_update hai, "Before Submit" before_submit hai, "After Submit" on_submit hai.

docs.title: Wohi rule, doosri app ke DocType ke liye — doc_events
docs.text:
Aap ki app Sales Order ki malik nahi hai, is liye aap us ke controller ko nahi chhedein ge. Aap hooks.py mein ek hook register karte hain — sirf ek registry, is mein koi logic nahi hoti:

# hooks.py
doc_events = {
    "Sales Order": {
        "validate": "my_app.selling.overrides.sales_order.validate",
    },
}

# my_app/selling/overrides/sales_order.py
import frappe
from frappe import _


def validate(doc, method=None):
    if frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "disabled"):
        frappe.throw(
            _("Customer {0} is disabled").format(frappe.bold(doc.customer))
        )

docs.title: Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Apne DocType par logic Controller method (validate, on_submit, …) Ek quick rule, abhi app release nahi hui Server Script ERPNext ke DocType par logic doc_events in hooks.py → apni app mein override file 50 lines se bara rule, imports ya tests chahiye Controller — kabhi Server Script nahi Field show/hide karna, button, hint Client Script (Lesson 06), server nahi External API call karna on_update / on_submit + frappe.enqueue — kabhi validate mein nahi

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Logic hooks.py ke andar. Yeh dotted paths ki registry hai. Code us file mein rehta hai jis ki taraf path ishara karta hai.
  • Apni app ke DocType ke liye doc_events. Controller use karein — hooks entry ki bilkul zaroorat nahi.
  • "*" doc_events. Yeh har DocType ke har save par chalega, hamesha.
  • Validation sirf JS mein. JS UX hai (Lesson 06). Sirf JS mein lagaya gaya rule rule nahi hai — API isay bypass kar deti hai.
  • Sirf submit ka kaam validate mein. validate har save par chalta hai, drafts par bhi. Posting aur ledger ka kaam on_submit mein hai.
  • validate ke andar self.save() call karna. Aap pehle se save ke andar hain. self par fields set karein aur return karein.
  • Doosri app ki files edit karna. Kabhi apps/erpnext/... edit na karein — agli update isay mita degi. Apni app se extend karein.
  • Server Script jo app ban gaya. 50 lines se zyada, external libraries, ya tests chahiye? Isay controller mein le jayein.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 06 — Client Scripts — form behaviour, validation hints, aur UX. Browser mein kya rehta hai, aur server par kya rehna chahiye.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Client Script JavaScript hai jo user ke browser mein, form par chalti hai. Yeh behaviour aur experience control karti hai: field show ya hide karna, field mandatory banana, Link ko filter karna, button add karna, value fetch karke dikhana. Yeh sirf UX hai — yeh security nahi hai aur validation bhi nahi. Browser jo kuch kar sakta hai, API usay skip kar sakti hai.

Apni app ke DocType ke liye, script DocType ke saath rehti hai:

my_app/doctype/gate_pass/gate_pass.js   # form behaviour for Gate Pass

Doosri app ke DocType (Sales Order, Delivery Note) ke liye, Desk mein Client Script DocType use karein, ya hooks.py mein doctype_js use karein jo public/js/ ki file ki taraf ishara kare. Ek DocType ke liye wohi frappe.ui.form.on block kabhi duplicate na karein — maujooda handler ko extend karein.

docs.title: Chhoti si working example — Gate Pass form
docs.text:
// gate_pass.js
frappe.ui.form.on("Gate Pass", {
    setup(frm) {
        // set_query belongs here — it runs once per form load
        frm.set_query("company", () => ({ filters: { disabled: 0 } }));
    },

    refresh(frm) {
        // Items are mandatory for Delivery / Pickup, optional for Visit
        frm.toggle_reqd("items", ["Delivery", "Pickup"].includes(frm.doc.purpose));
        if (frm.doc.docstatus === 1) {
            frm.add_custom_button(__("Mark Returned"), () => {
                frappe.call({
                    method: "my_app.gate_pass.api.mark_returned",
                    args: { name: frm.doc.name },
                    callback() { frm.reload_doc(); },
                });
            }, __("Actions"));
        }
    },

    purpose(frm) {
        // Runs whenever the Purpose field changes
        frm.toggle_reqd("items", ["Delivery", "Pickup"].includes(frm.doc.purpose));
        frm.refresh_field("items");
    },

    validate(frm) {
        // A UX hint only — the server re-checks this in validate() (Lesson 05)
        if (["Delivery", "Pickup"].includes(frm.doc.purpose) && !frm.doc.items.length) {
            frappe.msgprint(__("Add at least one item for a Delivery or Pickup pass"));
        }
    },
});

Button ko jo server side chahiye (poora pattern Lesson 07 mein hai):

# my_app/gate_pass/api.py
import frappe


@frappe.whitelist()
def mark_returned(name):
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Gate Pass", name)
    doc.check_permission("write")
    doc.db_set("status", "Returned")

Is ke kaam karne ke liye Gate Pass ko status field chahiye — Lesson 03 wale DocType mein ek Select add karein (Open / Returned, default Open).

docs.title: Form events jo aap sab se zyada use karein ge
Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Field show/hide karna, mandatory banana Client Script (toggle_display, toggle_reqd) Link field ke options filter karna setup mein frm.set_query Linked document se field copy karna DocType mein field par Fetch From — JS nahi Static visibility / mandatory rules DocType mein Depends On / Mandatory Depends On — JS nahi Button jo server ka kaam kare frm.add_custom_button + whitelisted method par frappe.call Rule jo lazmi qaim rehna chahiye Server validate() (Lesson 05) — JS sirf is ki taraf ishara kar sakti hai Data parhna jo kabhi kabhi badalta hai onload mein ek dafa load karein — refresh se server call na karein

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Validation sirf JS mein. API form ko poori tarah bypass kar deti hai. Har rule jo matter karta hai, controller mein rehta hai.
  • refresh ya field event mein set_query. Yeh har render par chalta hai. Isay setup mein rakhein.
  • Field ko JS mein hide karke "secure" karna. Koi bhi field ko API ke zariye parh sakta hai. Permlevel use karein — Lesson 09.
  • cur_frm. Event jo frm argument deta hai, wohi use karein.
  • Ek file mein ek hi DocType ke liye do frappe.ui.form.on blocks. Ek handler ko extend karein.
  • Direct DOM manipulation (form fields par $(...)) jab frm.* API maujood ho (set_value, set_df_property, toggle_display).
  • Synchronous server calls (async: false). Promises (.then) ya async/await use karein.
  • Khule hue form ke liye API se save karna. frm.set_value use karein, phir frm.save() — khule hue form par kabhi frappe.client.set_value na use karein.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 07 — APIs — frappe.call, whitelisted methods, aur REST API. Browser, doosre systems, aur aap ka apna code server se kaise baat karte hain.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Har DocType ki API pehle se maujood hai — form, list aur REST API, sab ke neeche wohi server hai. Isay call karne ke teen tareeqe hain:

Tareeqa Kahan se Kis ke liye frm.call("method") Khula hua form Maujooda document ke controller ka method frappe.call({ method: "app.module.file.fn" }) Koi bhi form JS Module-level whitelisted function REST: /api/resource/..., /api/method/... Koi bhi system, curl, Postman Doosri apps aur integrations

Python function bahar se call tab hi ho sakti hai jab us par @frappe.whitelist() laga ho. Decorator ke baghair, call 403 hoti hai. Aur har whitelisted function ek public endpoint hai — usay data return karne se pehle permissions check karni chahiye, baad mein nahi.

docs.title: Chhoti si working example — available stock check karein
docs.text:
Aap ki app mein ek whitelisted function:

# my_app/stock/api.py
import frappe


@frappe.whitelist()
def get_available_qty(item_code, warehouse):
    frappe.has_permission("Bin", "read", throw=True)
    qty = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Bin",
        {"item_code": item_code, "warehouse": warehouse},
        "actual_qty",
    )
    return qty or 0

Sales Order form se isay call karein — ek "Check Stock" button:

frm.add_custom_button(__("Check Stock"), () => {
    const row = (frm.doc.items || [])[0];
    if (!row) return;
    frappe.call({
        method: "my_app.stock.api.get_available_qty",
        args: { item_code: row.item_code, warehouse: row.warehouse },
        callback(r) {
            frappe.msgprint(__("Available qty: {0}", [r.message]));
        },
    });
}, __("Actions"));

Wohi logic Frappe ke bahar se, REST par call karein. Pehle minimal roles wala dedicated API user banayein (kabhi Administrator keys use na karein), phir us ki keys generate karein (User → API Access → Generate Keys):

# Read one Sales Order
curl "https://mysite.local/api/resource/Sales%20Order/SAL-ORD-2026-00001" \
  -H "Authorization: token <api_key>:<api_secret>" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

# Call the whitelisted method over REST
curl -X POST "https://mysite.local/api/method/my_app.stock.api.get_available_qty" \
  -H "Authorization: token <api_key>:<api_secret>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"item_code": "SPICE-MIX-01", "warehouse": "Stores - NT"}'

GET /api/resource/<DocType> records list karta hai, GET .../<name> ek record parhta hai, POST banata hai, PUT update karta hai, DELETE delete karta hai. Bina kisi HTTP ke, bench se whitelisted method test karein:

bench --site mysite.local execute my_app.stock.api.get_available_qty \
  --args '["SPICE-MIX-01", "Stores - NT"]'

docs.title: Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Screen par khule hue document ke liye logic Controller method par frm.call Kai forms / DocTypes mein shared logic Module-level @frappe.whitelist() + frappe.call Doosra system Frappe data parhe ya likhe Dedicated API user ke saath REST /api/resource/... Doosre system ko ek custom operation chahiye Whitelisted function par REST /api/method/... Koi bhi cheez jo likhti hai POST, decorator par methods=["POST"] ke saath Frappe se external API call karna Timeout ke saath on_update / on_submit + frappe.enqueue — kabhi validate mein nahi Guest (logged-out) user ko data chahiye Sirf reads ke liye allow_guest=True, input validation ke saath — writes ke liye kabhi nahi

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Permission check nahi. Whitelisted method jis mein frappe.has_permission(..., throw=True) (ya doc.check_permission) nahi hai, woh data usay bhi de deti hai jo URL guess kar le.
  • @frappe.whitelist() missing. Call 403 par fail hoti hai aur method Python mein theek kaam karta hai — decorator hi isay expose karta hai.
  • Write ke liye GET. State changes POST se hoti hain. GET jo likhta hai, woh link, prefetch, ya retry se trigger ho sakta hai.
  • Administrator API keys. Keys user ki hoti hain, aur us user ke wohi roles hote hain jo us ke paas hain. Minimal roles wala dedicated API user nuqsan limit karta hai agar key leak ho jaye.
  • Secrets JS mein ya hardcoded. API keys aur passwords Settings Single DocType mein Password field ke saath (doc.get_password("api_key")) ya frappe.conf mein jate hain — kabhi client code mein nahi.
  • Outbound calls par timeout nahi. requests.post(url, json=..., timeout=30), try/except mein wrapped, errors frappe.log_error mein. Latka hua external API kabhi save ko nahi latkana chahiye.
  • API se poore documents return karna. Wohi fields return karein jo caller ko chahiye — poora doc woh fields bhi leak kar deta hai jo caller ko nahi dekhne chahiye.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 08 — Reports & Print Formats — Script Reports, Query Reports, aur Jinja print formats. Jo data aap ki API ne abhi return kiya hai, usay aisi cheez mein badalna jo manager parh sake.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Ek report kayi records par ek sawaal ka jawab deti hai ("is mahine kaun se gate pass abhi bhi khule hain?"). Ek print format ek document ko paper ya PDF ke liye render karta hai ("khud gate pass"). Pehle report ki type chunein:

Type Kis ke liye Report Builder (bina code) Ek DocType ki filtered list — jab yeh kaafi ho to isi ko tarjeeh dein Query Report Ek SQL query, bina Python logic Script Report Logic, kayi sources, computed columns — custom reports ke liye default

Ek standard report aapki app mein rehti hai, is liye yeh versioned hoti hai:

my_app/my_module/report/gate_pass_register/
  gate_pass_register.json   # the Report definition
  gate_pass_register.py     # execute(filters) -> columns, data
  gate_pass_register.js     # filters

docs.title: Minimal working example — Gate Pass Register (Script Report)
docs.text:
# gate_pass_register.py
import frappe
from frappe import _


def execute(filters=None):
    filters = frappe._dict(filters or {})
    validate_filters(filters)
    return get_columns(), get_data(filters)


def validate_filters(filters):
    if filters.from_date and filters.to_date and filters.from_date > filters.to_date:
        frappe.throw(_("From Date cannot be after To Date"))


def get_columns():
    return [
        {"label": _("Gate Pass"), "fieldname": "name", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Gate Pass", "width": 140},
        {"label": _("Date"), "fieldname": "gate_pass_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
        {"label": _("Visitor"), "fieldname": "visitor_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 160},
        {"label": _("Company"), "fieldname": "company", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Company", "width": 160},
        {"label": _("Purpose"), "fieldname": "purpose", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100},
    ]


def get_data(filters):
    query_filters = {}
    if filters.get("company"):
        query_filters["company"] = filters.company
    if filters.get("purpose"):
        query_filters["purpose"] = filters.purpose
    if filters.get("from_date") and filters.get("to_date"):
        query_filters["gate_pass_date"] = ("between", [filters.from_date, filters.to_date])
    elif filters.get("from_date"):
        query_filters["gate_pass_date"] = (">=", filters.from_date)
    elif filters.get("to_date"):
        query_filters["gate_pass_date"] = ("<=", filters.to_date)
    return frappe.get_list(
        "Gate Pass",
        filters=query_filters,
        fields=["name", "gate_pass_date", "visitor_name", "company", "purpose"],
        order_by="gate_pass_date desc",
    )

// gate_pass_register.js
frappe.query_reports["Gate Pass Register"] = {
    filters: [
        { fieldname: "from_date", label: __("From Date"), fieldtype: "Date", default: frappe.datetime.month_start(), reqd: 1 },
        { fieldname: "to_date", label: __("To Date"), fieldtype: "Date", default: frappe.datetime.month_end(), reqd: 1 },
        { fieldname: "company", label: __("Company"), fieldtype: "Link", options: "Company" },
        { fieldname: "purpose", label: __("Purpose"), fieldtype: "Select", options: "\nVisit\nDelivery\nPickup" },
    ],
};

Columns dicts hote hain jinn mein asal fieldtype hota hai (Currency, Link, Date) — naye code mein "Customer:Link/Customer:180" strings nahi. Filters query mein lagaye jate hain, Python mein nahi. frappe.get_list permissions ka khayal rakhta hai; frappe.db.sql tamam permission checks ko bypass kar deta hai — user-facing reads ke liye isay kabhi istemal na karein.

docs.title: Minimal example — ek Print Format (Jinja)
docs.text:
Desk → Print Format → New, DocType: Gate Pass, Print Format Type: Jinja. Template ko doc (document) aur frappe milta hai:

<h2>Gate Pass {{ doc.name }}</h2>
<p>{{ _("Date") }}: {{ doc.get_formatted("gate_pass_date") }}
  {{ _("Visitor") }}: {{ doc.visitor_name }}</p>
<table>
  <tr><th>{{ _("Item") }}</th><th>{{ _("Qty") }}</th><th>{{ _("Direction") }}</th></tr>
  {% for row in doc.items %}
  <tr><td>{{ row.item_name }}</td><td>{{ row.qty }}</td><td>{{ row.direction }}</td></tr>
  {% endfor %}
</table>

Currency aur dates ke liye doc.get_formatted("field") istemal karein, labels ke liye _(), aur database calls ko loops se bahar rakhein (frappe.db.get_value kam se kam, kabhi bhi har row par ek nahi). Print Format Builder ko tarjeeh dein, ya ek Jinja format jo aapki app mein standard print format ke tor par save ho, taake yeh app ke saath ship ho.

docs.title: Kab istemal karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use Ek DocType ki filtered list Report Builder — bilkul code nahi Ek SQL query, fixed columns Query Report Logic, kayi DocTypes, computed values Script Report Paper / PDF par ek document Print Format (pehle Builder, layout control chahiye ho to Jinja) Har client ke liye wohi report App mein standard report (Is Standard = Yes, module set) Ek user ke liye ek baar ka sawaal Report Builder, ya List View par save kiya hua filter — coded report nahi

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Loop ke andar frappe.get_doc (N+1). Har row par ek query se 500-row wali report 30 second leti hai. Ek dafa fetch karein, phir dict mein lookup karein (dekhein guides/common-mistakes.md §4).
  • Filters Python mein lagana. Filter query mein lagayein — database aapke loop se tez hai, aur yeh permissions ka khayal rakhta hai.
  • User-facing report ke liye frappe.db.sql. Yeh permissions ko bypass karta hai. frappe.get_list, Query Builder, ya permission-aware query istemal karein.
  • Naye code mein columns strings ke tor par. fieldtype wale dicts istemal karein — report links, currency aur dates ko sahi render karta hai.
  • Jinja loop ke andar database queries. Print format mein har row par ek get_value wohi N+1 ghalti hai, paper par.
  • Ek baar ke sawaal ke liye coded report. Agar Report Builder jawab de de to kuch ship na karein. Code maintenance hai.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 09 — Permissions & Roles — kaun yeh sab dekh sakta hai, edit kar sakta hai, submit kar sakta hai, aur print kar sakta hai. Role Permissions, field-level permissions, User Permissions, aur sharing.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Access sirf tab milti hai jab har layer ijazat de. Chaar layers hain, tarteeb mein — kisi bhi ek par fail hone ka matlab hai "nahi":

  1. Role permission — ek role ek DocType par kya kar sakta hai (read, write, create, submit, cancel, print, export, report…).
  2. User Permission — kaun se documents: ek user jo ek Company ya Branch tak mehdood hai, sirf us company ke records dekhta hai.
  3. Sharing — ek document, ek user ke saath share, exception ke tor par.
  4. has_permission hook — code jo ek document par faisla karta hai.

Desk aur /api/resource/... wohni checks chalate hain. Agar yeh Desk mein kaam karta hai lekin API se fail hota hai, to API user (token owner) ke paas woh role nahi hai.

docs.title: Minimal working example — Gate Pass access
docs.text:
1. Role permissions — Desk → Role Permissions Manager, DocType: Gate Pass. Pehle DocType par Is Submittable set karein (Lesson 05), phir:

Role Read Write Create Submit Cancel Gate Security ✓ ✓ ✓ — — Store Manager ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ Auditor ✓ — — — —

Jis role ke paas read permission nahi, woh DocType ko bilkul khol nahi sakta — ek document share karne se yeh theek nahi hota.

2. Field-level permission (permlevel). remarks field mein internal notes hain. DocType par iska Permlevel 1 par set karein, phir Role Permissions Manager mein level 1 read sirf Store Manager ko dein. Gate Security form dekhta hai — remarks field ke baghair.

3. User Permission — ek gate user sirf ek company dekhta hai:

frappe.permissions.add_user_permission("Company", "NexTash Pvt Ltd", "gate.security@example.com")

Yeh lists, links aur reports ko filter karta hai. Ek user jise khaali list nazar aati hai, aam tor par us ke paas User Permission hoti hai jo documents chhupa rahi hoti hai, share ki kami nahi.

4. Sharing — ek document, ek user, exception ke tor par:

frappe.share.add("Gate Pass", "GP-2026-0001", "auditor@example.com", read=1)
frappe.share.remove("Gate Pass", "GP-2026-0001", "auditor@example.com")

Sharing sirf us ek document tak access deti hai. Yeh role permission ki jagah nahi leti — user ko DocType par read abhi bhi chahiye. Routine access roles mein hoti hai, shares mein nahi.

Code mein waise hi check karein jaise framework karta hai:

frappe.has_permission("Gate Pass", "read", doc, throw=True)

docs.title: Kab istemal karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use Ek poori team ko DocType chahiye Role permission (Role Permissions Manager) Ek user ko sirf ek Company / Branch dekhni chahiye User Permission Ek document ek bahar wale shakhs ko, ek dafa Sharing Ek rule jiska faisla code kare ("sirf owner, ya manager") has_permission hook — v16 par yeh explicit True return karna lazmi hai; None return karne se access deny hoti hai Ek field ko ek role se chhupana permlevel — kabhi JS nahi Ek report ya page sirf ek role ke liye Page aur Report ke liye Role Permission

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Field ko JS mein chhupana security nahi hai. Koi bhi field ko API ke zariye parh sakta hai. permlevel istemal karein.
  • Bina wajah ignore_permissions=True. Agar aap yeh pass karein to wajah us ke saath wale comment mein likhein — warna agla developer isay har jagah copy karta rahega.
  • Kisi bhi cheez par allow_guest=True jo likhti ho. Guest endpoints read-only hote hain, rate-limited hote hain, aur har input ko validate karna lazmi hai.
  • v16 par has_permission ka None return karna. v14/v15 par None ka matlab tha "koi rai nahi"; v16 par yeh access deny kar deta hai. Explicit tor par True return karein.
  • Sharing ek role nahi hai. Ek document share karne se sirf us ek document tak access milti hai. User ko DocType par read abhi bhi chahiye.
  • Whitelisted methods permission ko aakhir mein check karte hain. Data return karne se pehle frappe.has_permission(..., throw=True) se check karein, baad mein nahi (Lesson 07).
  • User-facing reads ke liye frappe.db.sql. Yeh har permission layer ko bypass karta hai. frappe.get_list / frappe.get_all istemal karein, jo User Permissions khud lagate hain.

403? Is tarteeb mein check karein: DocType par role permission → User Permission jo document chhupa rahi hai → has_permission hook jo None ya False return kar raha hai → whitelisted method jis mein decorator ya check missing hai → API token ka user jis ke paas woh role nahi hai.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 10 — Workflows & Assignments — approvals aur automatic routing. Kaun document ko aage barha sakta hai, aur yeh kis ke paas jata hai.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Ek Workflow ek document ke liye state machine hai: kaun isay ek stage se agle stage par le ja sakta hai, aur kis shart par. Ek Assignment Rule document ko khud-ba-khud ek shakhs tak route karta hai — round robin, least busy, ya document par mojood ek field se. Dono mil kar jawab dete hain: isay kaun approve karta hai, aur yeh kis ki desk par jata hai?

Ek Workflow sirf ek submittable DocType (is_submittable) par kaam karta hai — yeh docstatus ko drive karta hai (0 Draft, 1 Submitted, 2 Cancelled), is liye drive karne ke liye ek submitted state honi chahiye. Jab aap Workflow activate karte hain, Frappe aap ke liye DocType par workflow_state field bana deta hai — state ko custom Select field se drive na karein.

docs.title: Minimal working example — Quality Inspection approval
docs.text:
Ek spice batch aaya hai. Batch istemal hone se pehle inspection ko QA Manager se approve karwana lazmi hai. Desk → Workflow → New, Document Type: Quality Inspection, Is Active ✓.

States — har state ka ek docstatus hota hai:

State Doc Status Kaun edit kar sakta hai Draft 0 Quality User Pending Approval 0 — Approved 1 — Rejected 0 Quality User

Transitions — har ek: ek state se, ek action, ek state tak, ek role, ek optional condition:

From Action To Allowed Condition Draft Submit for Approval Pending Approval Quality User Pending Approval Approve Approved Quality Manager Pending Approval Reject Rejected Quality Manager Rejected Revise Draft Quality User

Do rules jo asal projects ko bachate hain:

  • Intermediate approval states docstatus 0 par rehti hain. Sirf aakhri "Approved" state 1 hoti hai. Ek submitted document draft mein wapas nahi ja sakta — docstatus sirf aage barhta hai (0→0, 0→1, 1→1, 1→2).
  • Rejected docstatus 0 hoti hai, is liye isay theek karke dobara submit kiya ja sakta hai. Ek rejected inspection jo docstatus 1 ya 2 par ho, woh phans jati hai.

Allow Self Approval = 0 set karein jab creator ko apna khud ka document approve nahi karna chahiye. Ek DocType par sirf ek Workflow active ho sakta hai. Conditions document par Python expressions hote hain: doc.grand_total > 100000, doc.inspection_type == "Incoming".

Code mein transition lagayein — workflow_state ko kabhi seedha set na karein:

from frappe.model.workflow import apply_workflow, get_transitions

apply_workflow(doc, "Approve")   # respects roles and conditions
get_transitions(doc)              # actions available to the current user

docs.title: Minimal working example — inspections ko QA team tak route karein
docs.text:
Desk → Assignment Rule → New, Document Type: Quality Inspection:

Field Value Assign Condition doc.inspection_type == "Incoming" Rule Round Robin Users qa.ahmed@…, qa.sana@…, qa.bilal@… Priority 1 Assignment Days Mon–Fri

Round Robin users ke darmiyan tarteeb se cycle karta hai. Load Balancing document usay deta hai jis ke paas sab se kam open assignments hon — support tickets ke liye sahi choice. Based on Field document se khud ek User link field parhta hai (masalan, har factory ka designated auditor). Sab se zyada Priority wala rule jo match kare, woh jeet ta hai. Unassign Condition assignment ko release kar deta hai (masalan, jab document cancel ho jaye); Close Condition ToDo ko band kar deta hai jab kaam mukammal ho jaye.

docs.title: Kab istemal karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use "Isay kaun approve kar sakta hai, aur kis tarteeb mein?" Workflow "Yeh kis ki desk par jata hai?" Assignment Rule Ek rule jo document ko pass karna lazmi hai (dates, quantities, limits) Controller validate / before_submit — Workflow condition nahi Ek document jo kabhi submit nahi hota Koi Workflow nahi — workflows ko submittable DocType chahiye Email se ek baar ki approval Document share karein + ek comment — poora Workflow nahi Team, territory, ya workload ke hisab se routing Assignment Rule, Workflow state nahi

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Intermediate state docstatus 1 par. Document approval ke aadhe raste mein submit ho jata hai aur kabhi draft mein wapas nahi ja sakta. Approvals aakhri state tak 0 par rehti hain.
  • doc.workflow_state ko seedha set karna taake approval skip ho jaye. apply_workflow istemal karein — yeh roles, conditions, aur self-approval ko check karta hai.
  • Workflow-controlled document par doc.submit() call karna. Workflow khud submit karta hai, jab aakhri transition chalta hai.
  • State ko custom Select field se drive karna. Workflow State field (workflow_state) istemal karein — engine wohi parhta hai.
  • Koi state nahi jis ka docstatus 0 ho. Naye documents wahin se shuru hote hain. Is ke baghair kuch create nahi ho sakta.
  • Ek Assignment Rule jis mein koi users nahi, ya condition jo kabhi match nahi karti. Rule ko ek asal document se test karein — ek unmatched rule khamoshi se kuch nahi karta.
  • Ek DocType par do active workflows. Sirf ek active ho sakta hai; doosri activation pehli ko deactivate kar deti hai.
  • Transition condition mein business validation. Conditions yeh tay karti hain ke kaun act kar sakta hai; validation controller mein hoti hai (Lesson 05).

docs.title: Next
docs.text:
Aap ne Level 2 mukammal kar liya hai. Aap logic ko us ki sahi jagah par rakh sakte hain, form ko shape de sakte hain, API expose kar sakte hain, report aur print format bana sakte hain, lock down kar sakte hain ke kaun kya dekhta hai, aur approvals ko sahi logon tak route kar sakte hain.

Level 3 Scheduler se shuru hota hai — background jobs aur queues: 11 — Scheduler & Background Jobs.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Do alag cheezein hain jinhe beginners mix kar dete hain:

  • Scheduler code ko ghadi par chalata hai — har ghante, har din, raat 2 baje. Aap kaam ko hooks.py mein scheduler_events mein register karte hain. Scheduler aapka code nahi chalata; woh sirf usay enqueue karta hai. Ek worker process usay Redis queue se uthata hai aur chalata hai.
  • Background job code ko abhi, lekin request ke andar nahi chalata hai. Aap usay frappe.enqueue() se shuru karte hain — misaal ke taur par, jab user "Generate report" par click kare aur report ko do minute lagte hon. User ko foran jawab mil jata hai; kaam background mein mukammal hota hai.

Agar in mein se koi bhi hissa band ho — scheduler, workers, ya Redis — to kuch nahi chalta, aur user ko kuch nazar nahi aata. Isi liye "job kabhi chali hi nahi" ek debugging sawal hai (Lesson 16), code ka sawal nahi.

docs.title: Minimal working example — spice batch expiry check
docs.text:
Har subah, woh spice batches dhoondhein jo 30 din ke andar expire ho rahe hon aur QA Manager ko email karein. Scheduled kaam koi arguments nahi leta — scheduler koi argument nahi bhejta.

# my_app/tasks.py
import frappe
from frappe.utils import add_days, today


def notify_expiring_batches():
    """Runs daily. No arguments — the scheduler passes none."""
    expiring = frappe.get_all("Batch",
        filters={
            "expiry_date": ("between", [today(), add_days(today(), 30)]),
            "disabled": 0,
        },
        fields=["name", "item", "expiry_date"])
    if not expiring:
        return
    rows = "\n".join(
        f"- {b['item']} ({b['name']}) expires {b['expiry_date']}"
        for b in expiring
    )
    frappe.sendmail(
        recipients=["qa.manager@nextash.example"],
        subject=f"{len(expiring)} spice batches expiring soon",
        message=f"The following batches expire within 30 days:\n\n{rows}",
    )

# hooks.py — registry only, no logic here
scheduler_events = {
    "daily": ["my_app.tasks.notify_expiring_batches"],
    "hourly_long": ["my_app.tasks.sync_supplier_stock"],
    "cron": {"0 2 * * *": ["my_app.tasks.nightly_archive"]},
}

hooks.py mein koi bhi tabdeeli ke baad bench --site <site> migrate chalayein, warna scheduler naya event kabhi nahi dekhta.

Event key Kab Queue all Har tick (v15+: 60s) default — kabhi bhi 60s se zyada kaam nahi hourly / daily / weekly / monthly Har ghante / din / hafte / mahine default (5 min timeout) hourly_long / daily_long / weekly_long / monthly_long Wohi waqt long (25 min timeout) cron Koi bhi cron expression, misaal 0 2 * * * default, jab tak aap khud long mein enqueue na karein

docs.title: Minimal working example — button se ek lamba job
docs.text:
Ek user Sales Order submit karta hai aur 3 warehouses mein stock-availability check chahta hai. Is mein minutes lagte hain — yeh request ke andar nahi chalna chahiye:

# my_app/selling/api.py
import frappe
from frappe.utils.background_jobs import is_job_enqueued


@frappe.whitelist()
def check_stock_availability(sales_order):
    job_id = f"stock-check-{sales_order}"
    if is_job_enqueued(job_id):
        return _("Stock check already running for {0}").format(sales_order)
    frappe.enqueue(
        "my_app.selling.jobs.check_stock_availability",
        queue="long",
        timeout=1500,
        job_id=job_id,
        enqueue_after_commit=True,   # run only if the save commits
        sales_order=sales_order,      # simple values only — never a doc
    )
    return _("Stock check started — you will be notified when it finishes")

# my_app/selling/jobs.py
import frappe


def check_stock_availability(sales_order):
    """Runs in a worker. Handle its own errors — log, then re-raise."""
    order = frappe.get_doc("Sales Order", sales_order)
    # ... heavy warehouse checks, commit in batches ...
    # on failure: frappe.log_error(title=..., message=frappe.get_traceback())

Queues hain short (chhote jobs, ek minute se kam), default (1–5 min), aur long (bhaari jobs, 5 min se zyada, 25 min timeout). Hamesha queue= saaf taur par dein — kabhi default par bharosa na karein.

docs.title: Health check karna
docs.text:
bench doctor                                        # workers + scheduler alive?
bench --site mysite enable-scheduler                # turn the scheduler on
bench --site mysite trigger-scheduler-event daily   # run one event by hand
bench --site mysite execute my_app.tasks.notify_expiring_batches  # or run the fn directly

Desk → Scheduler Log dikhata hai ke har event aakhri baar kab chala aur kya woh fail hua; fail hone wale jobs Error Log mein bhi likhte hain, poore traceback ke saath. Frappe Cloud shared benches par koi shell nahi hoti — scheduler ko dashboard se manage karein.

docs.title: Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Kisi fixed waqt ya interval par chalta hai scheduler_events in hooks.py Is liye chalta hai ke user ne kuch kiya frappe.enqueue() controller / API se Ek khaas document par kaam frappe.enqueue_doc(doctype, name, method) 5 minute se zyada ka kaam *_long event ya queue="long" Kaam jo ek saath do baar nahi chalna chahiye job_id= + is_job_enqueued() check External API ko call karna on_submit / on_update + enqueue — kabhi validate mein nahi Ek quick check jiska user intezar karta hai Request ke andar hi chalayein — job ki zaroorat nahi

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Scheduled function par arguments. Scheduler koi argument nahi bhejta — def daily_cleanup(company): har tick par error dega.
  • daily event par 20 minute ka job. Default queue usay 5 minute par maar deta hai. daily_long ya queue="long" use karein.
  • validate mein external API call. User intezar karta hai, API slow hoti hai, save timeout ho jata hai. Is ke bajaye on_submit se enqueue karein.
  • enqueue ko document dena. Jobs serialise hote hain — naam aur IDs dein, phir job ke andar frappe.get_doc karein.
  • Aisa job jo idempotent nahi hai. Do baar chalne se double-post ya double-charge nahi hona chahiye. External ID ko document par save karein aur check karein.
  • enqueue_after_commit na dena. Job tab bhi chalta hai jab save rollback ho jaye, aise document par jo kabhi save hua hi nahi.
  • Dev site par scheduler disabled. bench new-site usay band chhod deta hai — enable-scheduler chalyein, warna job "kabhi nahi chalti".
  • Job mein errors ko chhupana. Aisa job jo khamoshi se fail ho, aisa lagta hai jaise job kabhi chala hi nahi. Catch karein, frappe.log_error karein, phir re-raise karein.
  • hooks.py edit karne ke baad bench migrate bhool jana. Scheduler purani list hi chalata rehta hai.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 12 — Notifications, Email & Integrations — logon ko batana ke kuch hua: Notification DocType, code se mail bhejna, aur webhooks.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Teen tareeqe jin se Frappe kisi ko batata hai ke kuch hua, aur ek tareeqa jin se woh doosre system ko batata hai:

Tareeqa Kis liye Notification DocType Document event par no-code alerts — users configure kar sakte hain, fixture ke taur par ship hota hai frappe.sendmail() Code se email, poore control ke saath ke kab aur kya bhejna hai frappe.publish_realtime() Browser mein live updates (bell icon, list refresh) Webhook DocType Jab document event ho to Frappe kisi external URL ko call karta hai

Email foran nahi bheji jati, queue hoti hai: frappe.sendmail Email Queue mein ek row daalta hai, aur scheduler usay bhejta hai. Isi liye mail ke liye working scheduler chahiye (Lesson 11) aur ek Email Account jis mein "Enable Outgoing" tick ho.

docs.title: Minimal working example — Notification, bina code
docs.text:
Ek Quality Inspection reject ho jati hai. QA Manager aur jis ne usay banaya tha, dono ko pata hona chahiye. Desk → Notification → New:

Field Value Document Type Quality Inspection Event Value Change Value Changed status Condition doc.status == "Rejected" Channel Email Recipients By Role: Quality Manager; By Document Field: owner Subject Inspection {{ doc.name }} rejected Message Batch {{ doc.batch_no }} failed inspection. Reason: {{ doc.remarks }}

Events yeh hain: New, Save, Submit, Cancel, Value Change, Days Before, Days After, Method, Custom. "Days Before/After" date field par chalta hai — misaal ke taur par, supplier contract khatam hone se 7 din pehle buyer ko remind karein. Conditions doc par Python expressions hain. Messages Jinja hain — {{ doc.name }}, {{ doc.customer }}, document ka koi bhi field.

docs.title: Minimal working example — code se email
docs.text:
Wohi idea, lekin logic tay karta hai ke kis ko milegi. Pehle Gate Pass DocType mein ek approved_by Link field (Options: User) add karein — kis ne yeh pass approve kiya. on_submit / on_update se bhejein, kabhi validate se nahi — validation abhi bhi fail ho sakti hai, aur phir aap ne aise document ke baare mein email kar diya jo kabhi save hua hi nahi.

# my_app/my_module/doctype/gate_pass/gate_pass.py
import frappe
from frappe import _


class GatePass(Document):
    def on_submit(self):
        frappe.sendmail(
            recipients=[self.approved_by],
            subject=_("Gate Pass {0} submitted").format(self.name),
            message=_(
                "Gate Pass {0} for visitor {1} was submitted by {2}."
            ).format(self.name, self.visitor_name, frappe.session.user),
            reference_doctype=self.doctype,   # links the mail in the timeline
            reference_name=self.name,
        )

Default queueing hi rakhein. Production mein kabhi now=True na dein — yeh request ke andar bhejta hai, user ko rokta hai, aur v16 par yeh commit nahi karta. Bulk mail (saikron customers) pehle frappe.enqueue se jati hai.

Reusable body Email Template mein hoti hai — aapki app mein templates/emails/order_approved.html file, jo message= ke bajaye template="order_approved", args={"doc": doc} ke taur par pass hoti hai.

docs.title: Email Account setup
docs.text: Desk → Email Account → New: outgoing ke liye SMTP host/port aur login, incoming ke liye IMAP. Bhejne ke liye Enable Outgoing tick karein, receive karne ke liye Enable Incoming; incoming mail documents bana sakti hai — Append To ko kisi DocType par set karein. Agar mail kabhi nahi aati, to is order mein check karein: outgoing enabled → Email Queue status aur error → scheduler enabled (bench doctor) → site_config.json mein mute_emails.

docs.title: Minimal working example — realtime + webhook
docs.text:
Browser ko batayein ke lamba job khatam ho gaya (Lesson 11), aur warehouse system ko batayein ke Sales Order submit ho gaya:

# inside the background job, when it finishes
frappe.publish_realtime(
    "stock_check_done",
    {"sales_order": order.name, "shortages": shortages},
    user=frappe.session.user,
)

// public/js/sales_order.js
frappe.realtime.on("stock_check_done", (data) => {
    frappe.msgprint(__("Stock check finished for {0}", [data.sales_order]));
});

Webhook — Desk → Webhook → New: Document Type Sales Order, Doc Event After Submit, warehouse system ka URL, Method POST, aur Request Structure mein Jinja JSON body:

{"order": "{{ doc.name }}", "customer": "{{ doc.customer }}", "items": {{ doc.items | tojson }}}

Production mein Webhook Secret set karein. Receiver X-Frappe-Webhook-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256) ko verify karta hai taake pata chale ke call waqai aapki site se aayi hai. Incoming webhooks is ka ulta hain: ek whitelisted method jo pehle signature ya token verify karta hai, phir processing ko enqueue karta hai — kabhi bhi webhook ko request ke andar process nahi karta.

docs.title: Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Doc event par alert, users rule badal sakte hain Notification DocType Custom logic ke saath code se email frappe.sendmail() Live UI update (bell, list refresh) frappe.publish_realtime() Doosre system ko pata hona chahiye ke event hua Webhook DocType Hundredon recipients ko bulk mail frappe.enqueue + sendmail Ek shakhs ko one-off email Document share karein + comment — koi code nahi

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• validate mein frappe.sendmail. Mail jaane ke baad bhi save fail ho sakta hai. on_submit / on_update se bhejein.
  • Production mein now=True. Yeh request ko rokta hai aur, v16 par, commit nahi karta. Mail ko queue karein aur scheduler ko bhejne dein.
  • Koi Email Account jis mein outgoing enabled ho. sendmail mail ko queue karta hai, queue kabhi bhejti nahi, aur kisi ko ek hafte tak pata nahi chalta.
  • Busy DocType par bina condition ke Notification. Har Sales Order ke har save par poori team ko email jati hai.
  • Webhook URL ya Notification mein secrets. Keys site_config.json mein ya Password field mein hoti hain (Lesson 15), kabhi URL mein nahi.
  • External call par koi timeout nahi. Hung supplier API aapke worker ko hang kar deta hai. Hamesha timeout=30, try/except, frappe.log_error.
  • Request ke andar webhook process karna. Verify karein, enqueue karein, return karein. Sender retry karta hai agar aap slow hon, aur aap usay do baar process karte hain.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 13 — Testing — code kaam karta hai yeh prove karna, is se pehle ke client ko pata chale ke nahi karta: unit tests, test data, aur UI tests.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Ek test prove karta hai ke koi rule kaam karta hai — aur har baar prove karta rehta hai jab koi baad mein code badalta hai. Frappe tests Python unittest tests hain jo ek real site aur real database ke khilaf chalte hain. Har test ek transaction ke andar chalta hai jo baad mein rollback ho jata hai, is liye tests kabhi data peeche nahi chhodte.

Test files us DocType ke paas hoti hain jisay woh test karte hain, aur file ka naam lazmi test_ se shuru hona chahiye warna runner usay ignore kar deta hai:

my_app/my_module/doctype/gate_pass/
    gate_pass.py
    test_gate_pass.py        # <-- tests live here
    test_records.json        # <-- optional test data
Version DB chahiye? Base class v15+ nahi (pure logic) from frappe.tests.classes import UnitTestCase v15+ haan from frappe.tests.classes import IntegrationTestCase v14 koi bhi from frappe.tests.utils import FrappeTestCase

docs.title: Minimal working example — Gate Pass rule ko test karna
docs.text:
Lesson 05 ne Gate Pass controller mein ek rule daala tha: Delivery/Pickup pass mein kam se kam ek item hona chahiye, aur har row mein qty > 0 hona chahiye. Usay test karein:

# my_app/my_module/doctype/gate_pass/test_gate_pass.py
import frappe
from frappe.tests.classes import IntegrationTestCase


class TestGatePass(IntegrationTestCase):
    def test_delivery_pass_needs_items(self):
        doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Gate Pass",
            "purpose": "Delivery",
            "visitor_name": "Test Visitor",
            "items": [],
        })
        self.assertRaises(frappe.ValidationError, doc.insert)

    def test_zero_qty_is_rejected(self):
        doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Gate Pass",
            "purpose": "Delivery",
            "visitor_name": "Test Visitor",
            "items": [{"item_name": "Red Chilli Powder", "qty": 0}],
        })
        self.assertRaises(frappe.ValidationError, doc.insert)

    def test_valid_pass_saves_and_submits(self):
        doc = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Gate Pass",
            "purpose": "Delivery",
            "visitor_name": "Test Visitor",
            "items": [{"item_name": "Red Chilli Powder", "qty": 5}],
        })
        doc.insert()
        doc.submit()
        self.assertEqual(doc.docstatus, 1)

Behaviour ko test karein, internals ko nahi: validations throw karti hain, totals compute hote hain, submit/cancel kaam karte hain, permissions mana karte hain. Aisa test jo kisi private helper ki return value check karta hai, usi lamhe toot jata hai jab koi refactor kare; aisa test jo check karta hai ke "ghalat pass save nahi ho sakta" bach jata hai.

docs.title: Test data aur permissions
docs.text:
Data test ke andar hi banayein (jaisa upar hai), ya usay DocType ke paas test_records.json mein daalein — runner tests chalne se pehle usay load kar leta hai. Kabhi production data par depend na karein: aisa test jo aapki machine par pass ho aur client ki machine par fail ho, woh bina test ke hone se bhi bura hai.

Permissions ko usi tarah check karein jaise user un se takrayega:

def test_warehouse_user_cannot_submit(self):
    frappe.set_user("warehouse.user@example.com")
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Gate Pass", "GP-0001")
    self.assertRaises(frappe.PermissionError, doc.submit)
    frappe.set_user("Administrator")   # always restore

External HTTP calls ko unittest.mock.patch se mock karein. Aisa test jo real supplier API ko call karta hai, slow hota hai, flaky hota hai, aur real paise kharch karta hai.

docs.title: Tests chalana
docs.text:
bench --site test.local set-config allow_tests true   # once, on the test site
bench --site test.local run-tests --app my_app
bench --site test.local run-tests --doctype "Gate Pass"
bench --site test.local run-tests --doctype "Gate Pass" --test test_zero_qty_is_rejected
bench --site test.local run-tests --app my_app --failfast

Alag test site use karein, kabhi production nahi. bench new-app scaffold ek GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) banata hai jo test site banata hai, app install karta hai, aur har push par tests chalata hai — ek baar wire up karein aur tests khud chalne lagte hain.

docs.title: UI tests
docs.text:
Python tests server logic ko prove karte hain. UI tests prove karte hain ke form us tarah kaam karta hai jaise user usay use karta hai — button nazar aata hai, field mandatory ho jata hai, list load hoti hai. Frappe Cypress use karta hai: cypress/integration mein .js specs likhein aur unhe running test site ke khilaf chalyein:

bench --site test.local run-ui-tests my_app            # opens the Cypress runner
bench --site test.local run-ui-tests my_app --headless  # CI mode

UI tests slow hote hain aur unhe browser chahiye hota hai. Unhe sirf un chand flows ke liye rakhein jo kabhi nahi tootne chahiye (login, Sales Order banana, Quality Inspection submit karna) — baaki sab Python test mein hona chahiye.

docs.title: Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Validation, total, status change Python test, IntegrationTestCase Bina database ke pure logic UnitTestCase (v15+) — fast "Kya yeh role yeh kar sakta hai?" frappe.set_user ke saath Python test Critical user flow end to end Cypress UI test Rule jis mein aap ne abhi bug fix kiya hai Aisa test jo fix ke baghair fail ho — pehle "Kya button theek lag raha hai?" Usay dekhein. Har cheez ko test ki zaroorat nahi

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Test ke andar frappe.db.commit(). Har test rollback hota hai. Ek commit isolation tod deta hai aur data ko agle test mein leak kar deta hai.
  • Production data par depend karna. Test aapke laptop par pass hota hai, CI aur client par fail hota hai. Data test mein banayein.
  • Production site par tests chalana. Tests documents insert, submit, aur cancel karte hain. Disposable test site use karein.
  • Test file ka naam test_ se shuru na hona. Runner usay khamoshi se skip kar deta hai — zero tests chalte hain, zero failures, ghalat confidence.
  • Tests mein real external APIs call karna. Unhe mock karein. Supplier API ka down hona aapki test suite ko fail nahi karna chahiye.
  • User ko restore karna bhool jana. frappe.set_user(...) bina Administrator par restore kiye ghalat user ko baad wale tests mein leak kar deta hai.
  • Sirf happy path test karna. Bug hamesha us case mein hota hai jo aap ne test nahi kiya: zero qty, missing customer, cancelled document.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 14 — Performance — woh report jo 30 seconds leti hai aur woh submit jo timeout ho jata hai: N+1 queries, indexes, aur caching.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text: Slow Frappe code taqreeban hamesha in chaar mein se ek cheez hota hai: bohat zyada queries, ghalat query, koi index nahi, ya woh kaam jo request mein ho raha hai jabke woh background job mein hona chahiye. Fixes chhote aur mechanical hain — lekin sirf tab jab aap pehle measure karein. Aisi report jo 30 seconds leti hai, us ki wajah mil sakti hai; andaze se rewrite karna hi woh tareeqa hai jis se 30-second report 40-second report ban jati hai.

docs.title: Minimal working example — N+1 query
docs.text:
Sab se bara. Loop ke andar ek value padhne ke liye kabhi frappe.get_doc (ya get_value) na karein — yeh har row par ek database query hai.

# ❌ 200 items = 200 queries
for row in self.items:
    group = frappe.db.get_value("Item", row.item_code, "item_group")

# ✅ one query, then a dict lookup
item_codes = [row.item_code for row in self.items]
groups = dict(frappe.get_all("Item",
    filters={"name": ("in", item_codes)},
