    fields=["name", "item_group"], as_list=True))
for row in self.items:
    group = groups.get(row.item_code)

Totals ke liye bhi wohi rule: SQL mein aggregate karein, rows ko Python mein load na karein.

# ❌ loads every Stock Ledger Entry row
total = sum(e.actual_qty for e in frappe.get_all("Stock Ledger Entry",
    filters={"item_code": item_code}, fields=["actual_qty"]))

# ✅ the database sums
total = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT SUM(actual_qty) FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
    WHERE item_code = %s
""", item_code)[0][0] or 0

docs.title: Sahi read chunein
docs.text:
Zaroorat Use karein Kyun Ek document ka ek field frappe.db.get_value Ek sasti query Kabhi kabhi badalne wala master (Company, settings) frappe.get_cached_value / frappe.get_cached_doc Redis se milta hai, koi query nahi Aisi list jo user dekh sakta hai frappe.get_list Permission-aware — roles ka khayal rakhta hai System code ke liye list frappe.get_all Tez hai, lekin koi permission check nahi Sirf naam frappe.get_all(..., pluck="name") Koi dicts nahi bante Count ya sum frappe.db.sql / frappe.qb aggregate DB aggregate karta hai, Python nahi

get_list vs get_all speed jitna hi security ka faisla hai (Lesson 15): get_all aisi rows bhi deta hai jinhe user dekhne ki ijazat nahi rakhta. User-facing cheezon ke liye get_list use karein.

docs.title: Caching — jo kabhi kabhi badalta hai
docs.text:
Item groups, price lists, tax templates: taqreeban har document par padhe jate hain, mahine mein ek baar badalte hain. Unhe generator ke saath Redis mein cache karein — pehli call compute karti hai, baad wali calls cache se padhti hain:

def get_item_group(item_code):
    return frappe.cache().get_value(
        f"item_group:{item_code}",
        generator=lambda: frappe.db.get_value("Item", item_code, "item_group"),
    )

Rules: shared, kabhi kabhi badalne wala data cache karein, aisi key ke saath jo bataye ke woh kya hai. Per-user data ko kabhi shared key ke neeche cache na karein — agle user ko pehle user ka jawab milega. Jab source badle to invalidate karein (DocType ke on_update mein key clear karein), warna cache kal ki sachchai serve karta hai.

docs.title: Indexes
docs.text: Bina index wale field par filter poori table ko scan karta hai. Frequent filters mein use hone wale DocType fields par Search Index tick karein — Stock Ledger Entry par item_code, Sales Order par customer, Quality Inspection par batch_no. Index add karne se pehle slow query ko MariaDB mein EXPLAIN se check karein; ghalat column par index koi faida nahi deta aur writes ko slow kar deta hai.

docs.title: Reports aur denormalizing
docs.text:
Script Report jo 10,000 rows load kare aur Python mein filter kare, do baar slow hoti hai: ek baar fetch karne mein, ek baar filter karne mein. Query mein filter karein (frappe.db.sql ke saath WHERE, ya Query Builder), sirf woh fields fetch karein jo report dikhati hai, aur paginate karein.

Jab koi value har read par kai rows se compute hoti hai — customer ka total outstanding, batch ki baqi qty — to denormalize karein: computed value ko parent document par store karein aur jab children badlein to usay update karein (controller mein, Lesson 05). Reads ek field lookup ban jate hain. Is ki qeemat write complexity hai, is liye sirf un values ko denormalize karein jo badalne se kahin zyada baar padhi jati hain.

docs.title: Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Loop mein padhi jane wali value Ek baar bulk fetch, phir dict lookup Count, sum, ya average SQL aggregate, Python nahi Har document par padha jane wala master get_cached_value / frappe.cache() Slow report SQL mein filter, sirf dikhaye gaye fields fetch karein Chand seconds se zyada ka kaam frappe.enqueue (Lesson 11) Aisi value jo likhne se 100× zyada padhi jati hai Parent par denormalize karein One-off admin query Slow theek hai — usay optimise na karein

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Loop mein get_doc. Frappe apps mein sab se aam performance bug. Bulk fetch karein aur map karein.
  • User-facing reads ke liye get_all. Tez hai — aur aisi rows leak kar deta hai jinhe user nahi dekhna chahiye. Users ke liye get_list, system code ke liye get_all.
  • Request ke andar frappe.db.commit(). Framework commit karta hai. (Sirf lambe background jobs / patches mein, batches mein, allowed hai.)
  • refresh se server call karna aise data ke liye jo kabhi kabhi badalta hai. onload mein ek baar load karein, ya controller se frm.doc.__onload set karein.
  • Filtered field par koi index nahi. Query 100 rows par tez hoti hai aur 100,000 par marr jati hai. Client ke barhne se pehle search_index add karein.
  • Shared key ke neeche per-user data cache karna. Har user ko pehle user ka data nazar aata hai. User se key banayein, ya cache na karein.
  • Measure kiye baghair optimise karna. Pehle slow query dhoondhein (Error Log, bench --site <site> console, EXPLAIN), phir usay fix karein.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 15 — Security — woh cheezein jo kabhi nahi honi chahiye: injection, leaked data, guest endpoints jo likhte hain, aur code mein secrets.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text: Maan lein ke har input hostile hai: form fields, URL parameters, file uploads, webhook payloads, imported rows. Framework aapko safe APIs deta hai — unhe use karein, un ke gird rasta na dhoondhein. Frappe apps mein ziyada tar security bugs koi exotic attack nahi hote; woh developer hota hai jo ignore_permissions=True "kaam chalane ke liye" pass karta hai aur usay wahin chhod deta hai.

docs.title: Minimal working example — search endpoint, ghalat aur sahi
docs.text:
Customer portal ko naam se items search karne hain. Pehla version kaam karta hai — aur kisi ko bhi koi bhi table padhne deta hai:

# ❌ SQL injection + no permission check
@frappe.whitelist()
def search_items(q):
    return frappe.db.sql(
        f"SELECT name, item_name FROM `tabItem` WHERE item_name LIKE '%{q}%'"
    )

# ✅ parameterised, permission-checked, user-facing read
@frappe.whitelist()
def search_items(q):
    frappe.has_permission("Item", "read", throw=True)
    return frappe.get_list("Item",
        filters={"item_name": ("like", f"%{q}%")},
        fields=["name", "item_name"],
        limit_page_length=20)

Ek mein teen fixes: query parameterised hai (frappe.get_list SQL aapke liye banata hai), method data return karne se pehle caller ki permission check karta hai, aur result limited hai. Whitelisting aapke liye permissions check nahi karta — har @frappe.whitelist() method ko khud yeh karna hota hai.

SQL injection, saaf lafzon mein — kabhi user input se SQL na banayein:

Ghalat Sahi frappe.db.sql(f"... where name='{user}'") frappe.db.sql("... where name=%s", user) "... where name='" + name + "'" frappe.qb.from_("User").select("*").where(Field("name") == name)

Placeholders sirf values ke liye kaam karte hain. Input se aane wala table ya column naam placeholder nahi ho sakta — pehle usay fixed allowlist ke khilaf validate karein.

docs.title: XSS — Jinja autoescape nahi karta
docs.text:
Frappe Jinja ko sandbox mein render karta hai, lekin HTML ko escape nahi karta. Print format, email, ya web template mein {{ doc.remarks }} raw HTML render karta hai — us <script> samet jo user ne remarks field mein type kiya ho.

Ghalat Sahi Print format mein {{ doc.remarks }} {{ doc.remarks \| e }} User content par {{ html \| safe }} \|safe sirf us HTML par jo aapke apne code ne banaya ho JS mein $(el).html(frm.doc.notes) $(el).text(frm.doc.notes)

docs.title: Permissions — woh rules jo toote hain
docs.text:
• ignore_permissions=True sirf comment ke saath jo bataye ke kyun — misaal ke taur par, aise method mein system-generated document jis ne pehle se business rule check kar liya ho. Comment ke baghair, agla developer usay har jagah copy karta hai.
  • allow_guest=True sirf waqai public endpoints ke liye (signup, public page data). Guest method ko kabhi private data return nahi karna chahiye aur na hi apni validation ke baghair writes accept karni chahiye. Guest endpoints ko @frappe.rate_limit se rate-limit karein.
  • frappe.get_list permission-aware hai; frappe.get_all nahi hai. User-facing reads get_list use karte hain (Lesson 14).
  • Identity ke liye request parameters par bharosa na karein. frappe.form_dict se aane wale user value ke bajaye frappe.session.user use karein.
  • Field ko JS mein chhupana security nahi hai. Koi bhi usay API ke zariye padh sakta hai. Permlevel use karein (field-level permission, Lesson 09).

docs.title: Secrets aur API keys
docs.text:
Ghalat Sahi Code, fixtures, ya committed JSON mein API key bench set-config <key> <value> — site_config.json git mein nahi hoti Data field mein password Password fieldtype — rest par encrypted; frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password se padhein Client Script / JS mein token Usay server-side rakhein; sirf whitelisted method se expose karein jo permission check kare

Site config ko frappe.get_site_config() / frappe.conf se padhein. Kabhi secrets ko log na karein, kabhi unhe error messages ya test data mein na daalein. Leaked secret ko foran rotate karna hota hai — file delete karne se woh git history se nahi nikalta.

API access: minimal roles ke saath dedicated API user banayein, kabhi Administrator keys use na karein. Calls is se authenticate hoti hain: Authorization: token <api_key>:<api_secret>. Jab koi chhod kar jaye to keys rotate karein; aisi key jo kabhi expire nahi hoti, woh kabhi kaam karna band nahi karti.

docs.title: Files aur audit
docs.text:
Documents se attached uploads is_private wale File docs hote hain. Private files download karne ke liye logged-in user ko attached document par permission chahiye hoti hai. User files ko public/ se serve na karein, private file ka file_url guest page par link na karein, aur uploads ko save karne se pehle server-side validate karein.

Audit ke liye: sensitive DocTypes par Track Changes on karein — har change ek Version ke taur par save rehti hai jisay aap review kar sakte hain. Activity Log dikhata hai ke kis ne kab kya kiya. Jab kuch ghalat ho, to pehla sawal hamesha yeh hota hai ke "kis ne yeh badla, aur kab?" — logs ko is ka jawab dena chahiye.

docs.title: Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Query mein user input Placeholders / frappe.qb / get_list filters Template mein user text \| e escape; user content par kabhi \|safe nahi Aisa system action jo user nahi kar sakta Check ke baad comment ke saath ignore_permissions=True Public page ya form allow_guest, har input validate karein, koi internal data na dikhayein Secret, key, ya token site_config ya Password field — kabhi code ya JS nahi External system jo andar call kar raha hai Dedicated API user, minimal roles, keys rotate karein

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• F-string SQL. Frappe app mein sab se khatarnak line. User input ke saath ek f"..." aur poora database readable ho jata hai.
  • Bina comment ke ignore_permissions=True. Yeh phailta hai. Agla developer usay copy karta hai kyunke "pichli baar kaam kar gaya tha".
  • Aise method par allow_guest=True jo likhta hai. Guest endpoints public hote hain. Internet par koi bhi unhe call kar sakta hai.
  • Integration mein Administrator API keys. Ek leaked key ka matlab poora control hai. Dedicated user, minimal roles, rotated keys.
  • Git mein secrets. Ek baar commit hone wali key history mein hamesha rehti hai. Pehle usay rotate karein, phir remove karein — is order mein.
  • Guest page se linked private files. is_private ka koi matlab nahi agar aap URL baant dein.
  • Security ke taur par "hidden" fields. JS mein chhupana aur hidden fields UX hain. API wohi return karta hai jo DocType allow karta hai — permlevel use karein.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text: 16 — Debugging — jab phir bhi toot jaye: traceback padhna, logs, bench console, aur woh errors jin se har Frappe developer milta hai.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Debugging andaza lagana nahi hai. Yeh hai: usay reproduce karein, jo system ne pehle se bata diya hai usay padhein, wajah ko isolate karein, usay fix karein, prove karein. Frappe aapko bohat kuch batata hai — ek traceback, Error Log ki row, worker log ki line — lekin sirf tab jab aap random code badal kar umeed karne ke bajaye sahi jagah dekhein.

Traceback ko neeche se upar padhein. Aakhri frame woh hai jahan woh fail hua; us ke upar wale frames batate hain ke woh wahan kaise pahuncha. Aakhri line par exception type hi diagnosis hai — DoesNotExistError aur ValidationError alag problems hain jin ke alag fixes hain.

docs.title: Minimal working example — asal traceback par chalna
docs.text:
Ek user Gate Pass submit karta hai aur 500 error milti hai. Error Log dikhati hai:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "apps/frappe/frappe/model/document.py", line 1123, in submit
    self._submit()
  File "apps/my_app/my_app/my_module/doctype/gate_pass/gate_pass.py", line 42, in on_submit
    approver = frappe.get_doc("User", self.approved_by)
frappe.exceptions.DoesNotExistError: User HR-EMP-0042 does not exist

Usay neeche se upar padhein:

  1. Pehle aakhri line — DoesNotExistError: User HR-EMP-0042 does not exist. Code ne aisa User manga jo hai hi nahi.
  2. Aapki file, Frappe ki nahi — gate_pass.py, line 42, on_submit mein. Us ke upar wale framework frames sirf call path hain.
  3. Wajah — approved_by mein user email ke bajaye employee ID hai. Field ghalat DocType se link tha, ya us mein ghalat value bhari gayi thi.
  4. Fix — link ko validate karein (ya get_doc se pehle frappe.db.exists("User", self.approved_by) use karein), aur ghalat data ko fix karein.

docs.title: Evidence kahan rehta hai
docs.text:
Jagah Kya dikhati hai Error Log (Desk) Har unhandled exception, poore traceback ke saath Activity Log (Desk) Kis ne kab kya kiya — "kal tak kaam kar raha tha" ke liye bench --site <site> console Site par live Python shell — koi bhi doc inspect karein, koi bhi function chalyein Bench folder mein logs/ web.log, worker.log, scheduler.log, bench.log bench doctor Kya workers aur scheduler zinda hain? (Lesson 11) bench --site <site> execute <dotted.path> Kisi request ke bahar ek function haath se chalyein 
# reproduce it in the console — faster than clicking through the form
bench --site mysite console
>>> doc = frappe.get_doc("Gate Pass", "GP-0007")
>>> doc.approved_by
'HR-EMP-0042'
>>> frappe.db.exists("User", "HR-EMP-0042")   # None — there it is

Jab logging add karein to theek se log karein. print() aise worker log mein jata hai jisay koi nahi padhta aur Frappe Cloud par ghaib ho jata hai. Error Log use karein:

try:
    sync_supplier_stock()
except Exception:
    frappe.log_error(
        title="Supplier stock sync failed",
        message=frappe.get_traceback(),
    )
    raise

docs.title: Aam errors aur un ki asal wajah
docs.text: Error Asal wajah Fix DoesNotExistError (404) Missing record par get_doc, ya ghalat API path Pehle frappe.db.exists(); /api/method/dotted.path check karein ValidationError (417) Koi frappe.throw chala Input ya rule ko fix karein — message batata hai ke kaunsa PermissionError (403) Missing @frappe.whitelist(), role, ya User Permission Decorator / role / permission add karein (Lesson 09) DuplicateEntryError (409) Unique / naming clash Pehle exists check karein; autoname / naming series fix karein LinkValidationError Link aise record ki taraf hai jo hai hi nahi Target banayein ya validate karein LinkExistsError Linked documents ki wajah se delete blocked hai Links dikhayein; pehle dependents ko cancel/delete karein TimestampMismatchError Document load hone ke baad se badal gaya hai Reload karein — doc.reload() / frm.reload_doc() MandatoryError Required field khaali hai Insert/save se pehle usay set karein ImportError: __import__ not found Server Script mein import frappe.utils.* use karein (Lesson 05) CSRFTokenError Raw fetch call / stale session frappe.call() use karein AttributeError: module has no attribute hooks.py mein ghalat dotted path Function ka naam aur path bilkul match karein Change nazar nahi aati Cache / assets / migrate clear-cache, bench build --app <app>, migrate Job kabhi nahi chalta Worker ya scheduler band hai bench doctor, enable-scheduler

docs.title: Madad mangna — kya paste karein
docs.text:
Jab aap kisi se (ya AI se) madad mangein, to yeh chaar cheezein paste karein — bas yahi chahiye, aur in ke baghair koi madad nahi kar sakta:

  1. Poora traceback text ke taur par — screenshot nahi, "error dikh raha hai" nahi. Usay Error Log se copy karein.
  2. Aap kya kar rahe the — "Gate Pass GP-0007 submit kar raha tha", ek line.
  3. Aap ne pehle se kya try kiya — "approved_by check kiya, woh user nahi, employee ID hai".
  4. Versions — bench version output: Frappe, ERPNext, aapki app.

Bina traceback ke "mera code kaam nahi kar raha" par aap ko andaze milte hain. Versions ke saath traceback par jawab milta hai.

docs.title: Kab use karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use karein Kuch toot gaya Pehle reproduce karein — phir traceback padhein "Kal tak kaam kar raha tha" Activity Log + git log — kya badla? Koi value ghalat lagti hai bench console — live document inspect karein Koi job fail hui Error Log + Scheduler Log (Lesson 11) User error report karta hai Exact steps + Error Log row mangein Aap ke paas theory hai Code edit karne se pehle console mein test karein

docs.title: Aam ghaltiyan
docs.text:
• Reproduce karne ke bajaye andaza lagana. Error ko on demand laane se pehle code badalna. Pehle reproduce karein, hamesha.
  • Traceback ko upar se neeche padhna. Upar framework internals hain. Jawab neeche hai, aapki file mein.
  • Production mein print() debugging. Yeh kahin useful nahi jata. Traceback ke saath frappe.log_error use karein.
  • Bug ko nahi, data ko fix karna. Ghalat Gate Pass delete karne se error ek hafte ke liye chhup jata hai. Us link field ko fix karein jis ne usay andar aane diya.
  • "Fix" karne ke liye submitted document edit karna. Cancel aur amend karein (Lesson: guides/common-mistakes.md) — edit kiya hua submitted document aur us ka ledger hamesha ke liye disagree karte hain.
  • Traceback ka screenshot paste karna. Text ko search aur copy kiya ja sakta hai. Screenshot ko nahi.
  • Ek saath teen cheezein badalna. Aap ko pata nahi chalega ke kis ne fix kiya — ya kis ne agla masla paida kiya.

docs.title: Agla
docs.text:
Aap ne Level 3 mukammal kar liya hai. Aap kaam schedule kar sakte hain aur usay background mein chala sakte hain, logon aur doosre systems ko notify kar sakte hain, jo banaya hai usay test kar sakte hain, usay tez bana sakte hain, secure rakh sakte hain, aur jab toot jaye to pata laga sakte hain ke kyun toota.

Level 4 v16 ke no-code side se shuru hota hai — Studio aur Flow: 17 — Studio & Flow.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Do v16.60 features jo badal dete hain ke cheezein kaun banata hai:

  • Studio ek visual app builder hai, jo Framework mein merge ho gaya hai. Aap blocks se pages assemble karte hain, unhein Frappe data se bind karte hain, aur publish kar dete hain — bina code ke. App database mein Studio App aur Studio Page records ke tor par rehti hai, aur git aur deployment ke liye ek standard Frappe app mein export ki ja sakti hai.
  • Flow Desk ke andar ek AI assistant hai (beta, v16.60+). Aap saadi zabaan mein poochte hain aur woh aapki site par kaam karta hai — live data ke baare mein sawalon ke jawab deta hai, records banata hai, documents ka draft likhta hai. Woh us shakhs ki permissions ke saath kaam karta hai jo pooch raha hai, is liye woh us se zyada kabhi nahi dekh ya badal sakta jitna woh khud kar sakta hai. Yeh aapki apni AI provider keys istemal karta hai.

ERPNext path ke Lesson 13 mein dono ko feature level par introduce kiya gaya tha. Yeh lesson hands-on version hai: ek mini-app banayein, ek sawal poochein.

docs.title: Minimal working example — Studio mein ek Gate Pass mini-app
docs.text:
Data source ke tor par Lesson 03 wala Gate Pass DocType dobara istemal karein. Desk → search Studio → New Studio App:

Field Value App Name gate-pass-app Title Gate Pass Route gate-pass Home Page passes

Page 1 — list. New Studio Page, route passes. DocType Gate Pass par type Document List ka ek data resource add karein, phir page par ek table block drag karein aur uski rows ko us resource se bind karein (columns: name, visitor, company, date). Yeh woh page hai jo guard phone par kholta hai.

Page 2 — form. New Studio Page, route new-pass. DocType Gate Pass par type Document ka ek data resource add karein (new document), phir uske fields se bound form blocks drag karein: visitor name, company, purpose, items. Ek submit button add karein jo document save karta hai.

Dono pages ko Studio toolbar se preview karein, layout theek karein, phir Publish karein. App aapki site par /gate-pass par live hai. Ise code ke tor par ship karne ke liye (git, doosri sites): developer mode on karein, app ko Studio mein kholein, Export App par click karein, Enable App Export on karein, apni Frappe app chunein, aur Update par click karein — Studio ise apps/<your_app>/studio/<app_name>/ mein likh deta hai.

docs.title: Minimal working example — Flow se ek sawal
docs.text:
Pehle setup (sirf System Manager): apni site par /flow kholein, ek provider chunein (Anthropic, OpenAI, ya Ollama jaisa koi custom OpenAI-compatible server), uski API key paste karein, Connect par click karein, aur woh model chunein jis se naye chats shuru hon. Users ko Flow User role dein.

Phir, Desk mein kahin bhi, Ctrl+I (Mac par Cmd+I) dabayein aur poochein:

"Which customers have overdue Sales Invoices, and how much is each one owed?"

Flow live data parh kar numbers ke saath jawab deta hai — aur sirf woh customers jo signed-in user ko dekhne ki ijazat hai. Use action lene ko kahein, aur woh offer karega: "Create a ToDo for the sales manager listing the three oldest overdue invoices." Approve karne se pehle parh lein ke woh kya karne wala hai — Flow data ko ghalat samajh sakta hai, aur ek approved action ek asal action hota hai (beta).

docs.title: Kab istemal karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use Ek chhoti app jiske liye developer justify nahi hota Studio — visitor register, sample tracking, gate pass Ek analyst ko ek din mein form + list chahiye Studio Live data ke baare mein sawal ("kaun se orders late hain?") Flow Kisi document ka draft ya kisi record ka pehla version Flow, phir verify karein Ek poora module (Manufacturing, HR, Accounting) Module — Studio modules ke aas-paas ke gap ke liye hai, unka replacement nahi Ek rule jo hamesha hold karna chahiye Controller code (Lesson 05), kabhi Flow nahi Live data par production change Ek insaan, backup ke saath — Flow draft banata hai, log faisla karte hain

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Studio mein woh banana jo module mein hona chahiye. Agar app asal mein Manufacturing ya HR hai, to module istemal karein.
  • Flow ke jawab par bina check kiye bharosa karna. Us par amal karne se pehle numbers ko report se verify karein.
  • AI keys ka koi owner nahi. Flow aapki apni provider keys istemal karta hai — pilot se pehle faisla karein ke woh kis ke account aur budget ki hain, bill aane ke baad nahi.
  • Permission check skip karna. Flow permissions ka ehtaram karta hai, lekin pehle underlying roles theek hone chahiye — ek over-permissioned user AI ko bhi over-informed bana deta hai.
  • Ek Studio app jo kisi ko milti hi nahi. Ise publish karein, phir ise wahan rakhein jahan log dekhte hain: Desktop par, ya us module se ek link jahan se iska talluq hai.
  • App ko kabhi export na karna. Sirf database mein rehne wali app git par ya doosri site par nahi ja sakti. Jab woh kaam karne lage to ise export karein.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 18 — Insights — live data par dashboards, Desk mein banaye gaye: data source, query, chart, dashboard.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Insights live ERP data ko dashboards mein badal deta hai — bina exports ke, bina stale spreadsheets ke. v16.60 se dashboards Desk mein embed hote hain, jahan managers pehle se kaam karte hain. Chaar hisse, tarteeb se:

Piece What it is Data Source Data kahan rehta hai: ek DocType table, ya ek external database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, BigQuery) Query Data ke khilaf ek sawal — visually banaya gaya (Source, Join, Filter, Group & Summarise) ya SQL mein Chart Ek query ki ek visualisation: Number, Bar, Line, Row, Table, Pie Dashboard Grid par arrange kiye gaye charts, filters ke saath — woh page jo manager kholta hai Workbook Woh folder jisme queries, charts aur dashboards ka ek set hota hai, apni permissions ke saath

docs.title: Minimal working example — Desk mein ek sales dashboard
docs.text:
Desk mein Insights kholein. Neeche sab kuch ek hi Workbook ke andar hota hai.

1. Workbook. + New Workbook par click karein, iska naam Sales Overview rakhein.

2. Query. Ek naya workbook ek query se shuru hota hai — source table Sales Invoice chunein. Phir tarteeb se operations add karein:

Source:  Sales Invoice
Filter:  docstatus = 1  AND  posting_date is this month
Group:   by customer, Sum of grand_total

Query ko Monthly Sales by Customer ke naam se save karein. Ek query reusable hoti hai — neeche har chart usi se parhta hai, is liye logic ek hi jagah rehti hai.

3. Charts. + New Chart par do dafa click karein:

  • Number chart "Revenue this month": query se grand_total ka Sum — upar wala ek number.
  • Bar chart "Revenue by customer": ek axis par customer, doosre par grand_total.

4. Dashboard. + New Dashboard par click karein, iska naam Sales Overview rakhein. Left panel se dono charts ko grid par drag karein — Number pehli row par, Bar uske neeche. Filter par click karein, company par ek filter add karein, taake do companies wala manager ek waqt mein ek ko dekhe.

Dashboard ko kal kholein to numbers current honge — Insights queries live data ke khilaf chalti hain, kisi copy ke khilaf nahi. Dashboard ko wahan rakhein jahan se woh khola jaye: Desktop se ya Selling workspace se link karein.

docs.title: Kab istemal karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use "Is mahine hum kaisa kar rahe hain?" Desk mein Insights dashboard Ek sawal, kayi views Ek query, kayi charts Ek number jo owner roz check karta hai Pehli row par Number chart Ek user ke liye ek one-off sawal Report Builder ya ek saved list filter — dashboard nahi Ek printed document (invoice, gate pass) Print Format (Lesson 08), Insights nahi Data jo month end par freeze hona chahiye File mein export ki gayi report — live dashboard badalta rehta hai

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Dashboards jinhein koi kholta hi nahi. Teen clicks ki gehrai mein daba hua dashboard sirf decoration hai. Woh ek number jo matter karta hai, wahan rakhein jahan log dekhte hain.
  • Har chart ke liye ek query. Query ek dafa banayein, use kayi tareeqon se chart karein. Usi logic ki das copies alag-alag ho jati hain.
  • Multi-company dashboard par koi filter nahi. Har chart saari companies ko mila kar dikhata hai. Company filter add karein.
  • Har sawal ke liye ek chart. Paanch charts jo ek sawal ka jawab dete hain, jawab ko chhupa dete hain. Ek chart, ek sawal.
  • Workbook ko sab ke saath share karna. Workbooks ki apni permissions hoti hain — un roles ke saath share karein jo data dekh sakte hain, poori site ke saath nahi.
  • Query check kiye baghair chart par bharosa karna. Ek ghalat filter ek confident lagne wala ghalat number bana deta hai. Pehle query parhein.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 19 — Website & Portal — Frappe ka public side: web pages, Web Forms, aur customer portal.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text:
Frappe ke do chehre hain: Desk (internal app, logged-in users, roles) aur Website (public pages jinhein koi bhi khol sakta hai). Portal beech ka rasta hai — logged-in customers jo sirf apne documents dekhte hain. Teen building blocks:

Block For Web Page Ek static public page (About, Terms, ek landing page) Web Form Ek public form jo ek document banata hai — submit karne wale ko Desk access ki zaroorat nahi Portal Logged-in customers jo apne orders, invoices, tickets dekhte hain

Website Settings (ek Single DocType) mein site-wide chrome hota hai: home page, brand, top navigation, footer. Aapki app ke www/ folder mein pages seedha routes par map hote hain — www/about.html, /about hai — aur ek optional same-named .py file hoti hai jiska get_context() data deta hai.

docs.title: Minimal working example — ek "Request a Quote" Web Form
docs.text:
Desk → search Web Form → New:

Field Value Title Request a Quote DocType CRM Lead Route request-quote

Get Fields par click karein taake fields CRM Lead se pull hon, name, company, email, phone aur requirements rakhein, email aur requirements mandatory bana dein, phir Publish karein. See on Website par click karein — form /request-quote par live hai. Har submission source "Web Form" ke saath ek CRM Lead banati hai (CRM app ka apna form builder bhi hai, Settings → Forms ke neeche, Lead/Deal capture ke liye).

Options jo jaanna zaroori hain: Login Required off ka matlab hai guests submit kar sakte hain — public form ke liye off rakhein, internal cheez ke liye on karein. Allow Multiple ek shakhs ko ek se zyada dafa submit karne deta hai. Allow Edit unhein apni submission baad mein edit karne deta hai. Bina rate limiting ke guest-facing form spam ka target hota hai — use simple rakhein, aur pehle submissions roz check karein.

docs.title: Minimal working example — ek customer portal page
docs.text:
ERPNext mein Sales Orders, Invoices aur tickets ke portal views pehle se mojood hain. Apna page add karne ke liye, use apni app ke www/ folder mein rakhein — my_app/www/my-orders.html, /my-orders hai — ek controller my_app/www/my-orders.py ke saath:

# my_app/www/my-orders.py
import frappe


def get_context(context):
    if frappe.session.user == "Guest":
        frappe.throw(_("Please log in first"), frappe.PermissionError)
    # Contact has no direct customer field — the link lives in its
    # Dynamic Link child table (links), so resolve it in two steps.
    contact = frappe.db.get_value("Contact",
        {"user": frappe.session.user}, "name")
    customer = frappe.db.get_value("Dynamic Link",
        {"parenttype": "Contact", "parent": contact,
         "link_doctype": "Customer"}, "link_name") if contact else None
    if not customer:
        frappe.throw(_("No customer linked to your account"),
                     frappe.PermissionError)
    context.orders = frappe.get_list("Sales Order",
        filters={"customer": customer, "docstatus": 1},
        fields=["name", "transaction_date", "grand_total", "status"],
        order_by="transaction_date desc")
    return context

Context function hi access control hai: Guest ko bounce karein, logged-in user ke Contact se Customer resolve karein, aur query ko us customer tak scope karein. Page ko hooks.py mein portal_menu_items se portal menu mein add karein, role se gated.

docs.title: Kab istemal karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use Ek static public page (About, Terms) Web Page DocType, ya www/ HTML External users se data entry Web Form Customers apne documents dekhte hain Portal (built-in views, ya ek www/ page) Sidebar aur toolbar wala custom app www/ mein custom portal page Blog aur shop wala poora public website Frappe Website + Webshop — ya ek dedicated CMS, agar site hi product hai Internal kaam Desk — Desk screens ko kabhi public web par expose na karein

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Permissions test kiye baghair portal access. Ek asal portal user ke tor par log in karein aur check karein ke woh sirf apne documents dekhta hai — ek portal login jo doosre customer ki invoices dekh sakta hai, woh data leak hai.
  • Bina checks ke Guest Web Form. Public forms par spam aata hai. Fields minimal rakhein, email required karein, aur submissions roz review karein.
  • Web Form fieldnames jo DocType se match nahi karte. Form fieldname se likhta hai — ek renamed field value ko khamoshi se drop kar deta hai.
  • Public page par internal logic rakhna. Ek www/ page visitor ki permissions ke saath chalta hai. Kabhi woh data na dikhayein jo visitor nahi dekh sakta, aur URL se aane wale kisi parameter par kabhi bharosa na karein.
  • Website Settings bhool jana. Bina home page, brand aur navigation ke site adhoori lagti hai, forms kitne hi achhe kyun na hon.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 20 — Upgrades — ek live site ko v14 se v15 se v16 par le jana bina tode: lesson-length version, poora guide deep reference ke tor par.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text: Ek upgrade ek live site ko ek major version se agle par le jata hai — v14 → v15 → v16. Yeh ek project hai, ek command nahi: code badalta hai, schema badalta hai, aur har custom app, Server Script, Workflow aur print format woh cheez hai jo toot sakti hai. Yeh lesson short version hai — rules, tarteeb, aur kya test karna hai. Poori tables, commands aur checklists deep reference mein hain: Upgrade guide — v14 → v15 → v16.

docs.title: Rules
docs.text:
1. Ek waqt mein ek major version. v14 → v15, verify karein, phir v15 → v16. v15 ko kabhi skip na karein — v16 patches assume karte hain ke v15 schema pehle se mojood hai.
  2. Staging pehle, hamesha. Poora upgrade production data ki copy par chalta hai.
  3. Ek backup jo kabhi restore nahi hua, woh backup nahi hai. Restore ko pehle staging par test karein.
  4. Har custom app ko target version ke liye ek branch chahiye — warna use pehle remove kar dein.

docs.title: Minimal working example — upgrade, end to end
docs.text:
# 1. Know what you are upgrading from
grep __version__ apps/frappe/frappe/__init__.py apps/erpnext/erpnext/__init__.py
bench version

# 2. Backup — and prove it restores on staging
bench --site <site> backup --with-files --compress
bench --site staging restore <backup.sql> \
  --with-public-files <public.tar> --with-private-files <private.tar>

# 3. Runtime floor for the target (v16: Python 3.14+, Node 24+, MariaDB 10.6+)
# 4. Switch branches together, in dependency order, then migrate
cd ~/frappe-bench
bench switch-to-branch version-16 frappe erpnext hrms
bench --site <site> migrate

Frappe Cloud par koi bench commands nahi hain — version site dashboard mein switch hoti hai — lekin rules wahi hain.

docs.title: Breaking changes — jo sab se zyada takleef dete hain
docs.text:
Change Action has_permission hooks Explicit True return karna lazmi hai — None ab access deny karta hai (v16) DB commit inside document hooks Allowed nahi — framework commit karta hai frappe.sendmail(now=True) Ab commit nahi karta (v16) PDF Chrome renderer — wkhtmltopdf deprecated, v17 mein removed /app URL /desk — bookmarks aur hardcoded links theek karein Legacy ERPNext CRM v17 mein removal ke liye scheduled — abhi Frappe CRM par move karein Server Scripts v15+ par by default disabled — bench set-config -g server_script_enabled 1 se dobara enable karein

Poori v14→v15 aur v15→v16 tables, upgrade scan (/frappe-upgrade-check in frappe_core_skills), patch handling (never_skip_patches, bench migrate --skip-failing), aur mukammal checklists upgrade guide mein hain.

docs.title: Upgrade ke baad kya test karein
docs.text: Staging par, haath se, umeed par nahi: Desk load hota hai aur /desk kaam karta hai; har DocType ke liye jise upgrade ne chhua — create, save, submit, cancel, print, ek list-view filter; app tests chalayein (bench --site <test_site> run-tests --app <app>); har whitelisted method, Workflow aur scheduled job dobara check karein; client ki asal invoice Chrome renderer par kholein; Email Queue draining check karein aur ek integration end to end. Sirf jab staging pass ho jaye, tab production ko date milti hai — aur rollback plan pehle se agree hota hai: agar migrate fail ho jaye aur do ghante mein fix na ho sake, to pre-upgrade backup ko purane code par restore karein.

docs.title: Kab istemal karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use Ek version support se bahar hai, ya kisi feature ko naya version chahiye Upgrade plan karein — staging pehle "Bas Friday ko bench update chala do" Staging ke baghair production par kabhi nahi Ek patch release (v16.60 → v16.61) Staging par bench update, quick smoke test, phir live Ek custom app jiska target ke liye koi branch nahi Pehle use remove karein, ya port karein — uske aas-paas migrate na karein Client pooche "kya hum v15 skip kar sakte hain?" Nahi. Ek waqt mein ek major.

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Seedha production par upgrade karna. Staging copy is liye mojood hai taake failure wahin ho.
  • Ek backup jo kabhi restore nahi hua. Restore test hi backup hai.
  • Ek failed patch skip karna. Ek skipped patch ek kamyabi nahi, ek debt entry hai — data fix karein, migrate dobara chalayein.
  • Patch ko done dikhane ke liye database ko haath se edit karna. Agla migrate us jhoot par bharosa karta hai.
  • Apps bhool jana. HRMS, Frappe CRM, Helpdesk aur Payments alag apps hain — har ek ko apni version branch chahiye.
  • Koi rollback plan nahi. Agar aap staging par ek ghante se kam mein restore nahi kar sakte, to aap production ke liye tayyar nahi hain.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: 21 — Ops — ek production site ko zinda rakhna: backups, monitoring, multi-site benches, aur Frappe Cloud vs self-hosted.

docs.title: Yeh kya hai
docs.text: Ops ek production site ko zinda rakhna hai: backed up, monitored, aur recoverable. Achhe ops ko koi notice nahi karta — us din tak jab disk bhar jaye, scheduler ruk jaye, ya koi site wapas na aaye. Yeh lesson weekly routine aur woh faisle hain (multi-site, Cloud vs self-hosted) jo bure din ko survivable banate hain.

docs.title: Minimal working example — weekly ops routine
docs.text:
Yeh har hafte, har production site par chalayein. Tees minute, wahi tarteeb:

# 1. Backup — database + files, compressed
bench --site mysite.local backup --with-files --compress

# 2. Prove the backup restores (on a spare site, monthly at least)
bench --site spare.local restore <backup.sql> \
  --with-public-files <public.tar> --with-private-files <private.tar>

# 3. Are the workers and scheduler alive?
bench doctor

# 4. Disk space — a full disk stops the database
df -h

Phir Desk mein: Error Log — har nayi error parhein, sirf unhein count na karein (ek error jo 200 dafa repeat ho, woh ek bug hai, use fix karein); Email Queue — draining, stuck nahi; Background Jobs — scheduler ne kal raat ke jobs chalaye. v16 mein, offsite backups ek alag app hain (frappe/offsite_backups) — use install karein, yeh assume na karein ke backups khud-ba-khud server se bahar chale jate hain. Backup files ko server se bahar rakhein: database wali disk par mojood backup ek copy hai, backup nahi.

docs.title: Multi-site benches
docs.text:
Ek bench kayi sites host kar sakta hai — woh apps share karte hain, har ek ka apna database aur files hain:

bench new-site client2.local
bench --site client2.local install-app erpnext
bench --site client2.local install-app my_app

Ise istemal karein: ek client group ke liye ek bench, production ke saath ek staging site, sample data wali ek training site. Sites ke beech kabhi database share na karein, aur production site par kabhi test na karein — ek test site muft hoti hai, production par ek test ek business day ki qeemat rakhta hai.

docs.title: Frappe Cloud vs self-hosted
docs.text:
Frappe Cloud Self-hosted Who runs the server Frappe — updates, backups, monitoring included Aap — OS, bench, backups, monitoring Bench commands No shell — site dashboard mein version aur settings Full shell: bench, console, custom scripts Control Limited (no custom bench commands, no server access) Full — koi bhi app, koi bhi integration, koi bhi schedule Scaling Plan chunein, Frappe use scale karta hai Aap server ko size aur scale karte hain Cost shape Per site, per month Server + aapka time

Cloud tab chunein jab client bina IT person ke ERP chahta hai, aur standard apps kaafi hon. Self-hosted tab chunein jab aapko shell access, custom bench work, private integrations, ya aisa data chahiye jo client ke apne server par rehna lazmi ho. Kisi bhi surat mein, upar wali ops routine phir bhi apply hoti hai — Cloud backup automate karta hai, yeh check karne ki zaroorat khatam nahi karta ke backup mojood hai aur restore hota hai.

docs.title: Kab istemal karein — aur kab nahi
docs.text: Situation Use Ek site live hai Weekly routine, har hafte, bina exception Usi bench par doosra client Doosri site, doosra bench nahi Ek test ya training environment Usi bench par ek alag site "Backup mojood hai" Restore test — ek backup jo kabhi restore nahi hua, woh backup nahi hai Log mein ek error Use parhein aur wajah fix karein — log clear na karein Ek client jiske paas koi IT staff nahi Frappe Cloud, aur aap routine check karte rahein

docs.title: Common mistakes
docs.text:
• Koi restore test nahi. Backup file mojood hai, restore fail hota hai. Pata sab se bure din chalta hai.
  • Usi disk par backups. Disk mar jaye to backup bhi uske saath mar jata hai.
  • Scheduler khamoshi se ruk gaya. Koi emails nahi, koi notifications nahi, koi auto-reposts nahi — aur ek hafte tak kisi ko pata nahi chalta. bench doctor hi woh check hai.
  • Production par testing. Live site par ek test import ek live import hai. Test site istemal karein.
  • Error Log ko ignore karna. Errors barhte jate hain. Ek unread error ek bug report hai jo kisi ne file nahi ki.
  • Ek bench, ek site, hamesha. Usi bench par doosri site muft hai — staging, training, aur agla client sab wahin rehte hain.

docs.title: Next
docs.text:
Aapne Framework path mukammal kar liya hai — saare 21 topics, apne pehle bench se lekar ek production site tak jise aap zinda rakh sakte hain.

  • Map review karein: Learn: Frappe Framework — Noob to Pro
  • Ise asal modules par istemal karein: Learn: ERPNext Modules — saare 14 modules, Accounting se lekar cross-module flows tak
  • Is se asal kaam karein: Guides — upgrade, go-live, aur woh common mistakes jin se bachna hai
  • Current rahein: Research: 2024–2026 mein kya badla aur apps catalog — hub ecosystem ke saath barhta hai

Path mukammal hai. Seekhna nahi — agli production site woh jagah hai jahan yeh lessons apni qeemat sabit karte hain.

docs.title: Frappe / ERPNext Apps Catalog
docs.text:
Global research se mile har waqai useful Frappe/ERPNext app, 26 November 2026 tak. Har app chhoti hai: yeh kya karta hai, kyun faida deta hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise use kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein; woh version kabhi promise na karein jo test nahi kiya — "not stated" wali entries propose karne se pehle README check karna zaroori hai.

Pehle se new-apps.md mein hain (yahan repeat nahi kiye): frappex-client, Vendalto, RedLine, Itemflow Community, Frappe Flow, Frappe Studio, Frappe Assistant Core, Raven v3, Orchestra AI, ChangAI, Zikpro AI Invoice OCR, Invoice OCR (free, Tesseract), Frappe Email Flow, DocStudio, VunaPOS, Lumen Restaurants, Auri PMS, Jarvis, mForm, Sales AI, Zikpro UK VAT, Tabadul, Compendium, ERPNext Sri Lankan Localisation, OHADA ERPNext Localisation.

docs.text:

  • Productivity — 8 apps: LMS, Insights, Drive, Gameplan, Wiki, email flows, Builder, Cloud 2.0

docs.title: Gaps — jin ka pata hona chahiye
docs.text:
• Pakistan payments (Easypaisa / JazzCash): koi free public Frappe app maujood nahi hai. ECOSIRE ~$999 se build-to-order integration deta hai (https://ecosire.com/frappe-erpnext-payment-integration/). Local clients ke liye yeh sab se bara gap hai — Easypaisa/JazzCash ke liye ek Payment Core integration NexTash ke liye ek asli product opportunity hogi.
  • Official apps se aagay HR patla hai: koi verified third-party recruitment/payroll app nahi mili; sirf Discipline HR aur biometric sync tool hai.
  • Official apps se aagay CRM patla hai: koi verified standalone third-party Frappe CRM app nahi mili — market Frappe CRM par hi rely karti hai.
  • Not verified / propose karne se pehle verify karein: WooCommerce Fusion, Medusa, South African Localisation, Italian e-invoicing, multi-country Peppol, Paymob/SumUp/Paystack — koi verified GitHub URL nahi mila. Print Designer v16 aur Insights v16 compatibility unconfirmed hai. KSA ZATCA repo URL case mismatch (entry dekhein). Frappe Learning/Builder ke exact bench commands — repo README mein verify karein.

docs.title: Frappe aur ERPNext — Pichle 2 Saalon Mein Kya Badla (Nov 2024 – Nov 2026)
docs.text:
Pichle do saalon ki bari tabdeeliyan sirf — Framework/ERPNext v15 aur v16 ka daur, Studio, Flow, Insights, CRM/Helpdesk/Raven aur bari features. Har item chhota hai: kya aaya, kab, aur NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line. Sab kuch official sources (Frappe Blog, Frappe Forum, GitHub releases, Frappe docs, Frappe Times) se verify kiya gaya hai, har item ke saath source link hai.

Background (ek line mein): Nov 2024 se pehle — v13 (Apr 2021) modern Desk UI le kar aaya, v14 (Aug 2022) ne monolith ko alag apps mein baant diya (HR, Healthcare, Education…), v15 (Oct 2023) Espresso design system aur no-code Form/Workflow Builders le kar aaya, aur Frappe Cloud 2020 se sites host kar raha hai. Detail neeche se shuru hoti hai, November 2024 se.

docs.title: Support status (26 November 2026 tak)
docs.text: • v14 — end of life 31 Jan 2026. v15 — end 2027 tak supported. v16 — end 2029 tak supported. (Secondary summaries jo https://frappe.io/support-versions ka hawala deti hain — client ko quote karne se pehle wahan verify kar lein.)

docs.title: v15 ka daur — woh version jo window khulne par chal raha tha
docs.text:
• v15 (Oct 2023, Nov 2024 mein abhi bhi current): Espresso UI, no-code Form Builder aur Workflow Builder, Sales Orders ke against Stock Reservation, Serial & Batch Bundle, submission ke baad invoices edit karna, 2.5x tez financial reports. Abhi bhi har mahine patch hota hai — latest v15.127.0, 25 Nov 2026. Source: https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-and-erpnext-v15-release/111702
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: v15 un clients ke liye safe upgrade target hai jo v16 ke naye UI se darte hain — v14→v15 ka move Form Builder demos ("meeting mein hi DocType bana kar dikhayein") aur Stock Reservation ke saath bechein, un manufacturing/trading clients ko jo v14 ki stock complaints se pareshan hain.

docs.title: November 2024 — Insights v3
docs.text:
• Frappe Insights v3 released (Nov 2024): mukammal makeover — TypeScript frontend, ibis-framework backend, 20+ connectors, basic data warehousing. Source: https://frappe.io/times/october-2024 (announced), https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-insights-tools-guide/140202/4 (November mein released)
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har go-live ke baad phase-2 sale ke tor par Insights dashboard package bechein — live data par sales, stock aur finance dashboards, managers ke liye self-service, Excel exports ki zaroorat khatam.

docs.title: January 2025 — Raven v2
docs.text:
• Raven v2 (10 Jan 2025): workspaces (ek site par kai groups), AI bots, ERPNext integrations — chat ke andar document previews, alerts aur actions. Source: https://frappe.io/product/raven/at-frappe
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un clients ko Raven offer karein jo internal coordination ke liye WhatsApp groups mein doobay hue hain — channels ke saath ERP ke andar document alerts (invoice approvals, stock alerts).

docs.title: April 2025 — Studio open-source hua
docs.text:
• Frappe Studio open-sourced (3 Apr 2025, Frappe Build, Bengaluru): drag-and-drop app builder, visual layouts, data sources, tez CRUD tools. Repo: https://github.com/frappe/studio. Source: https://frappe.io/blog/product-updates/product-updates-for-april-2025
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Studio sab se tez nayi service line hai — client ki custom app visually chand dinon mein banayein (sample-tracking, gate-pass, visitor register) aur fixed-price par bill karein. NexTash ke ek analyst ko is par train karein taake chhoti apps developer ka waqt lena band kar dein.

docs.title: September 2025 — Frappeverse India 2025
docs.text:
• Frappeverse India 2025 (11–12 Sep 2025, Nehru Centre, Mumbai). Source: https://events.frappe.io
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har Frappeverse ko lead-generation aur client-touch point ke tor par use karein — us ke announcements ko ek chhoti client newsletter ("ERPNext mein kya naya hai") mein badal kar installed base se rabta banaye rakhein.

docs.title: November 2025 — v16 beta
docs.text:
• Framework/ERPNext v16 beta (15 Nov 2025): do saalon mein pehli bari release; final 6 Dec 2025 ko Frappeverse Egypt mein planned thi. Source: https://discuss.frappe.io/t/erpnext-hrms-frappe-framework-v16-release-dates/156349
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: beta window ko use kar ke apni custom apps aur top clients ki sites staging par test karein — breakage pehle pakadna ek billable "v16 readiness check" service hai.

docs.title: January 2026 — v16 final
docs.text:
• Framework/ERPNext/Frappe HR v16 (12 Jan 2026): naya Desktop UI (desktop icons, persistent sidebar), ~2x tak tez ("Caffeine"), List View mein 50 columns tak, scrollable child tables, Chrome-based PDF converter (wkhtmltopdf ki jagah), role-based field masking, UUID document naming. ERPNext: configurable Financial Report Templates (IFRS samet), consolidated Trial Balance, forecast → MPS → MRP planning chain, batch-level stock reservations, inward subcontracting. Sources: https://frappe.io/blog/engineering/announcing-version-16, https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-erpnext-and-frappe-hr-version-16-release/159053
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: v16 upgrade pitches ke liye Desktop UI aur 50-column List View ko demo hook banayein — clients paanch minute mein farq dekh lete hain. Forecast → MPS → MRP chain un textile, food aur spare-parts manufacturers ko pitch karein jo abhi bhi Excel mein planning karte hain. Runtime floor barh gaya hai, is liye yeh ek-click update nahi, ek planned infrastructure upgrade hai (pehle staging) — isay ek project ke tor par bechein.

docs.title: January 2026 — Raven official ban gaya
docs.text:
• Raven ek official Frappe app ban gaya (Jan 2026) — jis team ne isay banaya tha woh Frappe mein shamil ho gayi. Source: https://frappe.io/product/raven/at-frappe
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: ab jab Raven official hai, to implementations par isay team-chat layer ke tor par bharose se propose karein — clients ki taraf se "community app" wala aitraaz khatam.

docs.title: July 2026 — Raven v3
docs.text:
• Raven v3 (13 Jul 2026, Frappe ki timeline ke mutabiq): tez app, mobile par proper PWA, redesign, Espresso rebuild, SQLite full-text search, notifications page, reminders, scheduled messages, read receipts. Note: ek Frappeverse recap kehta hai beta 21 Aug / full release 1 Sep 2026 — dates mein farq hai, end par notes dekhein. Source: https://frappe.io/product/raven/at-frappe
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: v3 ki PWA aur search Raven ko factory-floor teams ke liye workable banati hai — un clients ki implementation ke hisse ke tor par propose karein jin ka staff desk par nahi, phone par kaam karta hai.

docs.title: August 2026 — Frappeverse Mumbai 2026
docs.text:
• Frappeverse Mumbai 2026 (21–22 Aug 2026, 1,500+ log): announcements — Frappe Suite, Frappe Cloud V2 preview, Raven V3, ERPNext v16 keynote. Sources: https://events.frappe.io/events/frappeverse-mumbai-2026, https://frappe.io/times/july-2026
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har Frappeverse ki tarah — leads aur announcements se client newsletter. Cloud V2 preview hosting-migration wali baat-cheet ka talking point hai.

docs.title: October 2026 — v16.50, polished v16
docs.text:
• Framework/ERPNext/HR v16.50 (7 Oct 2026): navigation fix (saaf desktop, per-module dock, curated sidebar), naya print format designer (canvas + live preview), consolidated DocType Settings, revamped global search, step-based Data Import wizard, tez Kanban, List View layouts, child tables mein bulk editing. Koi breaking changes nahi — teenon apps sirf update karein. Source: https://frappe.io/blog/product-updates/announcing-framework-erpnext-and-hrms-v1650
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har nayi rollout ke liye v16.50 (early v16 nahi) recommend karein — navigation fix se clients ka main aitraaz khatam ho jata hai. Data Import wizard se go-live chhota karein (customers/suppliers addresses samet ek file mein import karein) aur naye print designer se demo mein hi client ka invoice format bana kar dikhayein.

docs.title: November 2026 — Insights v3.50 ne v2 hata diya
docs.text:
• Frappe Insights v3.50 (17 Nov 2026): Insights v2 ko mukammal tor par hata deta hai — v2 dashboards ko pehle v3.13–v3.15.1 mein "Migrate from v2" page se migrate karna hoga (v3.15.1 released 20 Oct 2026). Source: https://docs.frappe.io/insights/articles/migrate-from-v2-to-v3
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: kisi bhi v3.50 upgrade se pehle, v2-to-v3 dashboard migration ko ek scoped task ke tor par bechein — v2 dashboards wale clients isay skip nahi kar sakte.

docs.title: November 2026 — v16.60: AI core mein aa gayi
docs.text:
• Framework/ERPNext/HR v16.60 (17 Nov 2026): Studio Framework mein merge ho gaya (bina code ke apps banayein, AI agents ke saath kaam karta hai), Frappe Flow alpha (Desk mein Frappe ka AI harness — LLMs data analyse karte hain / forms bharte hain, permission-aware, apni AI keys), Insights dashboards Desk mein embedded, behtar mobile UX, naya child-table importer, behtar report printing. Monthly releases shuru (16.70 Dec 2026 mein). ERPNext: Tally-style Day Book, 10 naye print formats, Overview dashboards ke saath redesigned Customer/Supplier forms, Projects revamp phase 1. Sources: https://frappe.io/blog/product-updates/announcing-framework-erpnext-and-frappe-hr-v1660, https://discuss.frappe.io/t/announcing-v16-60-for-frappe-framework-erpnext-and-frappe-hr/165819
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Studio se bani mini-apps ko nayi service line ke tor par offer karein aur Flow ko ek friendly client ke saath test site par pilot ke tor par ("apne data par apne ERP se poochhein"). Monthly cadence ek recurring "upgrade + what's new" retainer ko support karti hai — har 16.6x release apply karein aur client ko ek page ki summary bhejein.

docs.title: November 2026 — CRM aur Helpdesk v16.x mein renumber hue
docs.text:
• Frappe CRM aur Helpdesk ne versioning badli (Nov 2026): continuous v1.x se Framework scheme par — v15.x Frappe v15 ko target karta hai, v16.x v16 ko (CRM v16.0.2, 5 Nov 2026; Helpdesk v16.2.1). Frappeverse 2026 par CRM: ~2.5K paid sites, ~3.5K GitHub stars; lead capture ke liye naye web Forms, Lead/Deal enrichment, Sales Hierarchy, drag-and-drop Workflow Automations. Sources: https://github.com/frappe/crm/releases, https://www.ithub.directory/crm-customer-platforms/frappe-crm (renumbering ke liye secondary)
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har naye sales project par Frappe CRM implement karein (ERPNext ka legacy CRM module nahi, jo v17 mein remove hone wala hai), aur Helpdesk un clients ke liye jin ki support shared inbox par chalti hai — unlimited agents, koi per-seat fee nahi.

docs.title: November 2026 — Frappe Cloud 2.0 public beta
docs.text:
• Frappe Cloud 2.0 public beta (24 Nov 2026): foundation se rebuild — full root/SSH wali Virtual Machines, one-click apps, Object Storage, LLMs, firewalls aur VPN. Architecture: Pilot (sites manage karta hai, aaj Bench replacement ke tor par usable), Atlas (infrastructure), Central (customer-facing cloud). Target: Jan 2027. Bench officially archived. Source: https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-cloud-2-0-is-in-public-beta/165969
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: hosting-migration wale clients ko Cloud 2.0 VMs par le jayein jab yeh live ho — shared multi-tenancy ki bajaye isolated VMs downtime ki complaints ka seedha jawab hai. "Bench to Cloud 2.0" migration ko ek service ke tor par offer karein; Pilot un clients ke liye ek pitch hai jo aaj VPS par self-host kar rahe hain.

docs.title: November 2026 — monthly train: v16.61.0 aur dost
docs.text:
• Framework v16.61.0 (24 Nov 2026): custom form button styles, maintenance mode mein by default reads ki ijazat, Letter Head Preview, Studio "Show on Desktop", Flow public agents, AI assistant images dekhta hai, Print Format role restrictions, bulk Add/Remove Roles, GitPython 3.2.1 security update. Source: https://github.com/frappe/frappe/releases/tag/v16.61.0
  • ERPNext v16.61.0 & v15.127.0, CRM v16.4.0, Helpdesk v16.2.2 (25 Nov 2026): 278 bug fixes, Stock valuation breakdown page aur auto-repost setting, draft Job Cards par Manufacturing "Return Components", POS/company defaults/Payment Entry mein permission hardening; CRM ko apne dashboard page par ek Insights dashboard mila. Sources: https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/releases/tag/v16.61.0, https://github.com/frappe/crm/releases/tag/v16.4.0, https://github.com/frappe/helpdesk/releases/tag/v16.2.2
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: clients ko AMC ke under monthly train par rakhein — har mahine ka patch (jaise v16.61.0 ki permission hardening) client se rabta karne, kya badla woh batane, aur retainer bill karne ki wajah hai. Mukammal details: 2026-11-25, 2026-11-26.

docs.title: November 2026 — Builder ko AI mil gayi ("Bob")
docs.text:
• Frappe Builder (Nov 2026): editor mein AI assistant "Bob" (slash commands, editor plugins, Frappe Cloud par AI credits); licence v1.31.0 se MIT ho gayi (pehle AGPL-3.0); latest v1.37.5, 6 Nov 2026. Source: secondary directories (iThub/exploreai) — quote karne se pehle https://github.com/frappe/builder/releases par verify karein.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Builder se client ki marketing pages aur customer portals banayein, bina alag website project ke — kisi bhi implementation par fixed-price add-on (frappe.io khud is se bana hai).

docs.title: Dates aur figures jo double-check karne hain
docs.text:
1. Raven v3 date: frappe.io timeline kehti hai 13 Jul 2026; Frappeverse recap kehta hai beta 21 Aug / full release 1 Sep 2026.
  2. CRM/Helpdesk renumbering: v16.0.2 (5 Nov 2026) aur v15.x/v16.x scheme ek secondary directory (iThub) se hai, Frappe ki announcement se nahi — https://github.com/frappe/crm/releases par verify karein.
  3. v16.60 "2,500+ bugs fixed": secondary summaries mein aata hai; Frappe ka v16.60 blog line-by-line check nahi kiya gaya.
  4. Support dates (v14 EOL 31 Jan 2026; v15 end 2027 tak; v16 end 2029 tak): sirf secondary summaries se verify hue jo https://frappe.io/support-versions ka hawala deti hain.
  5. Insights v3 ki exact tag date (Nov 2024) aur Builder v1.37.5 / "Bob" details: secondary sources se hain; https://github.com/frappe/insights/releases aur https://github.com/frappe/builder/releases par verify karein.

docs.title: AI Tools — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text: Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 8 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida-mand hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

docs.title: ERPSmith — AI dev copilot for ERPNext (MCP)
docs.text:
• What/why: Claude (ya kisi bhi MCP client) ko aapki site par customizations banane aur debug karne deta hai, har change user ki approval se hota hai — haath se likha hua boilerplate kam ho jata hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: client projects par DocType aur script ka kaam Claude se karwayein, approval gate hamara review step ban jaye; "AI-assisted customization" ko ek tez fixed-price service ke tor par offer karein.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/abhinavprakash1992/erpsmith — bench get-app https://github.com/abhinavprakash1992/erpsmith (Frappe v15/v16, free MIT)

docs.title: Ask ALYF — in-Desk AI assistant
docs.text:
• What/why: users Desk ke andar hi sawal pooch kar documents mein madad le sakte hain, har "kahan hai…" wale sawal par support ticket banane ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: pehli dafa ERP use karne wale clients ke handover package mein shamil karein — is se hamare post-go-live support tickets kam ho jayenge.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/alyf-de/ask_alyf — bench get-app https://github.com/alyf-de/ask_alyf

docs.title: ERPNext Copilot — plain-English queries, actions, charts, scheduled reports
docs.text:
• What/why: managers sada English mein data pooch sakte hain, charts aur scheduled reports le sakte hain — na SQL, na har report ke liye developer.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un owners aur finance heads ko bechein jo har hafte "bas ek aur report" mangte hain; go-live ke foran baad phase-2 add-on, jab report ki requests peak par hoti hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/byt3crafter/erpnext-copilot — bench get-app https://github.com/byt3crafter/erpnext-copilot

docs.title: NextAssist — multi-provider AI chat assistant
docs.text:
• What/why: AI chat assistant jo OpenAI, Claude ya Gemini par chalta hai (client pehle se jis ki payment karta ho), sandboxed code runner ke saath.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un clients ko propose karein jo pehle se ChatGPT/Claude ki payment karte hain aur poochte hain "kya AI hamara ERP data use kar sakta hai?" — koi naya vendor bechne ki zaroorat nahi.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/navdeepghai/nextassist — bench get-app https://github.com/navdeepghai/nextassist

docs.title: Frappe Crema — LLM toolkit for Frappe (OCR + NL list views + scheduled AI tasks)
docs.text:
• What/why: ek hi toolkit — OCR/document extraction se records banana, natural-language list views aur edits, aur scheduled AI tasks.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: client sites par isay hamara standard AI toolkit banayein — supplier bills OCR se andar, sada zuban mein list edits, raat ko draft reports — har client ke liye alag AI app seekhne ki bajaye ek hi toolkit seekhna hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/amsys/crema — bench get-app https://github.com/amsys/crema

docs.title: HUF AI — open-source AI infrastructure for any Frappe app
docs.text:
• What/why: bespoke AI features banane ke liye reusable multi-agent / AI-workflow layer, one-off scripts ki bajaye.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: HUF par custom AI workflows banayein (support emails ki auto-triage, routine POs ki approval) one-off scripts ki bajaye — kaam repeatable ho jata hai aur productised service ke tor par bill ho sakta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/tridz-dev/huf — bench get-app https://github.com/tridz-dev/huf

docs.title: Frappe MCP — turn Frappe apps into MCP servers (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: kisi bhi Frappe app ko AI agents (Claude waghera) ke samne controlled tareeqe se expose karne ka official building block.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: client ki custom app ko Claude/ChatGPT ke samne expose karne ka standard tareeqa — official Frappe code hai, is liye propose karne ke liye safe choice hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/mcp — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/mcp

docs.title: MCP ERPNext — MCP server with 97 tools (Casys-AI)
docs.text:
• What/why: agents ko ERPNext se connect karne ke liye sab se bara ready-made tool surface (97 tools, 11 categories), npx se zero-config.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: pehli meeting mein clients ko quick AI-agent demos ke liye use karein ("apne live stock ke bare mein Claude se poochein"); production ke liye unhein official Frappe MCP route par le jayein.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Casys-AI/mcp-erpnext — not a bench app; MCP server via npx.

docs.title: CRM & Support — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text:
Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 4 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida-mand hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

Baselines: Frappe CRM (official) — https://github.com/frappe/crm, bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/crm — leads/deals, Kanban pipeline, ERPNext invoicing link. Frappe Helpdesk (official) — https://github.com/frappe/helpdesk, bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/helpdesk (v14/v15/v16) — email tickets, SLAs, assignment rules, customer portal, knowledge base. How we can use them: CRM ko ERPNext ke legacy CRM module ki bajaye default sales app banayein, aur Helpdesk ko kisi bhi client ka default desk banayein jis ki support shared inbox par chalti hai (unlimited agents, no per-seat fee).

docs.title: WATI Integration — WhatsApp Business API via WATI, for CRM follow-ups
docs.text:
• What/why: ERPNext events (new/save/submit/change) par templates ke saath WhatsApp messages bhejta hai — woh channel jo Pakistan/India/Gulf ke clients asal mein parhte hain.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un sales teams ko offer karein jo leads ko WhatsApp par manually chase karti hain — lead/order events par follow-ups automatically chale jate hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/bhavesh95863/wati_integration — bench get-app https://github.com/bhavesh95863/wati_integration (verify in repo README; also on Frappe Cloud Marketplace)

docs.title: IndiaMART Integration — IndiaMART enquiries → ERPNext Leads
docs.text:
• What/why: IndiaMART enquiries ko automatically ERPNext mein Leads ke tor par le aata hai — spreadsheets se dobara type karne ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Indian manufacturers/traders (aur IndiaMART par list karne wale Pakistani exporters) ko offer karein — enquiries khud CRM pipeline mein aa jati hain.
  • GitHub: no public repo verified — Marketplace only (search "Indiamart ERPNext Integration" on https://cloud.frappe.io/marketplace)

docs.title: Mautic Integration — marketing automation (Dokos)
docs.text:
• What/why: contacts/leads Mautic ke saath sync hote hain campaigns, lead scoring aur nurture emails ke liye — ERPNext ke basic email tools ki bajaye asal marketing automation.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un B2B clients ko offer karein jin ki asal sales pipeline hai aur jo campaigns spreadsheet ya kisi alag tool se chalate hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/dokos-io/mautic — bench get-app https://github.com/dokos-io/mautic

docs.title: GitHub Helpdesk Integration — GitHub issues/PRs ↔ Frappe Helpdesk
docs.text:
• What/why: GitHub issues, PRs, comments aur commits ko Helpdesk tickets ke saath link karta hai — helpdesk aur repo ke darmiyan copy-paste nahi.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: NexTash ke apne support flow ke liye use karein aur un software-company clients ko offer karein jo Helpdesk chalate hain.
  • GitHub: no public repo verified — Marketplace only (https://cloud.frappe.io/marketplace)

docs.title: Developer tools — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text: Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 8 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida deta hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

docs.title: Print Designer — drag-and-drop print format designer (frappe v14/v15 only)
docs.text:
• What/why: visual print format builder — invoices aur reports ke liye HTML/Jinja coding ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: v14/v15 clients par invoice/quotation formats jaldi design karne ke liye use karein. v16 ke liye built-in print format designer (v16.50+) use karein — Print Designer ki v16 compatibility unconfirmed hai, pehle staging par verify karein.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/print_designer — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/print_designer

docs.title: Bench Companion — VS Code extension for bench
docs.text:
• What/why: VS Code se bench sites aur development manage karta hai — team ke liye kam terminal work.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har NexTash developer ke liye install karein — ye standardise karta hai ke team bench sites ke saath kaise kaam karti hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/vineetjacob/bench-companion — VS Code extension, not a bench app.

docs.title: Frappe VS Code — Frappe extension for VS Code (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: Frappe development ke liye official VS Code tooling.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: team ka editor setup isi par standardise karein — har developer ek hi tareeqe se kaam kare.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/vscode — VS Code extension, not a bench app.

docs.title: Frappe S3 Attachment — store attachments on S3
docs.text:
• What/why: attachments ko S3 par move kar deta hai, local disk bachata hai aur backups clean rakhta hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un clients ke liye use karein jinke attachments heavy hain (photos, PDFs) — ye unke servers ko lean rakhta hai aur hamari hosting setup ka standard hissa hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/s3-attachment — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/s3-attachment

docs.title: ERPNext Excel — Excel as a low-code layer
docs.text:
• What/why: users ko data Excel mein manage aur analyse karne deta hai, jabke ERPNext source of truth rehta hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un finance teams ko offer karein jo Excel mein rehti hain — woh apna workflow rakhte hain, hum data ERPNext mein rakhte hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frankmoney/erpnext_excel — bench get-app https://github.com/frankmoney/erpnext_excel

docs.title: ERPNext Import Tool — import via Excel + S3 (paid)
docs.text:
• What/why: bulk data migration ke liye guided import tool — un teams ke liye jo built-in Data Import se struggle karti hain.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un migrations par use karein jahan client ka data messy spreadsheets mein hai — ye ek hi go-live mein apni cost nikal leta hai.
  • GitHub: no public repo verified — Marketplace only (search "ERPNext Import Tool" on https://cloud.frappe.io/marketplace)

docs.title: Frappe Manager — local Docker-based Frappe development
docs.text:
• What/why: full bench install ke baghair Docker-based local development — naye developers ki onboarding tez hoti hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: naye NexTash developers ko fast onboard karne ke liye use karein — bench setup ke ek din ke bajaye minutes mein working local site.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/rtcamp/Frappe-Manager — not a bench app; local development tool.

docs.title: ERPNext Admin Tools — bulk delete + cache controls for admins
docs.text:
• What/why: support work ke liye admin utilities (bulk delete, cache clearing).
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: client support calls par internally use karein — custom scripts ke baghair bulk cleanup.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/brianlam38/erpnext-admin-tools — bench get-app https://github.com/brianlam38/erpnext-admin-tools

docs.title: Ecommerce Integrations — Shopify / Amazon / Unicommerce (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: official connectors — Shopify ke orders Sales Orders ban kar aa jate hain, stock Shopify se sync hota hai, items drafts ke tor par upload hote hain; ERPNext hi source of truth rehta hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: kisi bhi client ke liye standard jawab hai jiski Shopify store hai; un e-commerce sellers ko offer karein jo aaj Shopify aur ERPNext ko haath se mila rahe hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/ecommerce_integrations — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/ecommerce_integrations

docs.title: CAZ WooSync — real-time two-way WooCommerce ↔ ERPNext sync
docs.text:
• What/why: products, orders, customers, inventory, prices, invoices, refunds, coupons ka two-way sync — real-time webhooks, polling fallback ke saath, multi-store, queue dashboard. Ye khaali jagah bharta hai (v15/v16 ke liye koi maintained Frappe WooCommerce connector nahi hai).
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har us client ko offer karein jo WooCommerce store chala raha hai; sync-health dashboard se hum isay theek se support kar sakte hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/codeatozcom/CAZ_WOOSYNC — bench get-app https://github.com/codeatozcom/CAZ_WOOSYNC (v14–v16, free MIT)

docs.title: WooCommerce Connector — WooCommerce sync (Libracore)
docs.text:
• What/why: lamba arsa chalne wala alternative WooCommerce connector — client ko commit karne se pehle CAZ WooSync se compare karna chahiye.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: staging store par dono connectors test karein aur woh chunein jo client ke order volume aur product count ke hisab se fit baithta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/libracore/WooCommerceConnector — bench get-app https://github.com/libracore/WooCommerceConnector

docs.title: HR — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text:
Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 2 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida-mand hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

Baseline: Frappe HR / HRMS (official) — https://github.com/frappe/hrms, bench get-app hrms — employee lifecycle, leave, attendance, expense claims, performance, payroll, recruitment; free GPL-3.0, v14–v16. Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: HRMS ko un clients ko standalone add-on ke tor par bechein jo ERPNext bina HR ke chala rahe hain; /hrms par ESS PWA shift workers wali factories ke liye mobile attendance pitch hai.

docs.title: Discipline HR — attendance discipline & automated payroll penalties
docs.text:
• What/why: late attendance par grace periods aur automatic payroll deductions — woh rules jo har HR client mangta hai lekin HRMS mein nahi hain.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: shift workers wali factories ko offer karein jahan late-coming roz ka HR headache hai — ye woh manual spreadsheet replace kar deta hai jo HR head aaj maintain karta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/cre8tivMaxx/discipline_hr — bench get-app https://github.com/cre8tivMaxx/discipline_hr

docs.title: Biometric Attendance Sync Tool — ZKTeco fingerprint devices → ERPNext (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: biometric devices ko poll karta hai aur punches ko Employee Checkin records mein sync karta hai — manual CSV imports ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har HRMS proposal mein shamil karein un factories/offices ke liye jin ke paas pehle se ZKTeco machines hain — punches auto-attendance mein flow karte hain, ek quick win jo HR sale ko asaan bana deta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/biometric-attendance-sync-tool — not a bench app; clone and run the Python sync scripts: git clone https://github.com/frappe/biometric-attendance-sync-tool.git
