docs.text: Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 11 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida deta hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

docs.title: Frappe WhatsApp Suite — WhatsApp Business API + chat UI + chatbot (3 apps)
docs.text:
• What/why: teen free apps jo mil kar kaam karti hain — WhatsApp Business Cloud API (direct Meta se, koi middleman nahi), Desk ke andar chat UI, aur keyword triggers aur AI fallback wala chatbot.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: isay apni standard WhatsApp offer bana lein — order updates, invoice alerts aur support chats ERPNext ke andar se, koi paid middleman nahi. Trading/distribution clients ko Desk ke andar wali chat UI demo karein; ye woh shared phone replace kar deta hai jo unki sales team aapas mein ghumati hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/shridarpatil/frappe_whatsapp · https://github.com/shridarpatil/whatsapp_chat · https://github.com/shridarpatil/frappe_whatsapp_chatbot — bench get-app each repo (all three on Frappe Cloud Marketplace)

docs.title: WABA Integration — WhatsApp Business Cloud API (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: official Frappe WhatsApp tareeqa — conservative choice jab client Frappe-maintained code chahta hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: jab client official code par zor de to ye propose karein; jab unhein chat UI aur chatbot bhi chahiye to upar wali community suite use karein.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/waba_integration — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/waba_integration

docs.title: Payment Core — provider-neutral payment layer (Aerele)
docs.text:
• What/why: payment integrations ke liye shared foundation — references, transaction lifecycle, settlement, payment pages, idempotency — taake checkout/webhook code har gateway ke liye dobara na likhna pare.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har payment integration jo hum banayein, uski foundation ke tor par isay adopt karein — payment ka kaam har client ke liye custom hone ke bajaye repeatable ban jayega.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/aerele/payment-core — bench get-app https://github.com/aerele/payment-core --branch develop (Frappe/ERPNext v16, free MIT)

docs.title: Stripe Payment — Stripe gateway on Payment Core (Aerele)
docs.text:
• What/why: hosted checkout, 3D Secure, subscriptions, signed webhooks — Frappe/ERPNext ke liye modern Stripe tareeqa.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un clients ko offer karein jo Stripe ke through international payments/subscriptions lete hain. Note: Stripe Pakistan mein locally available nahi hai, is liye ye exporters aur Gulf/UK/US-facing businesses ke liye fit hai, local PKR collection ke liye nahi.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/aerele/stripe-payment — bench get-app https://github.com/aerele/stripe-payment --branch develop (requires Payment Core, free MIT)

docs.title: Razorpay Integration — Razorpay payments (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: Indian clients ke liye standard gateway — UPI/cards Razorpay ke through, ERPNext Payment Requests se wired.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Indian clients ko offer karein (ya Pakistani exporters jo India mein bechte hain) jo online payments lete hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/razorpay_integration — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/razorpay_integration

docs.title: Multi Payment Gateway — payment-choice page for the Webshop
docs.text:
• What/why: Webshop checkout par har enabled gateway (Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Braintree, Paytm, GoCardless, Cashfree, PayU, COD, bank transfer) list karta hai, ek par majboor karne ke bajaye.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har Webshop build mein add karein jahan client ek se zyada payment option dena chahta hai — chhota add-on jo checkout ki asli rukawat khatam kar deta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Kalvyai-erpnext/ki_erp_multi_payment — bench get-app https://github.com/Kalvyai-erpnext/ki_erp_multi_payment --branch version-16 (ERPNext 16 only, free MIT)

docs.title: ERPNext Shipping — Packlink / LetMeShip / SendCloud shipping
docs.text:
• What/why: delivery notes ko labels aur rates ke saath booked shipments mein badal deta hai, alag shipping portal ke bajaye.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un e-commerce/retail clients ko offer karein jo aaj shipments alag portal mein book karte hain — ye selling aur dispatch ke darmiyan ka loop band kar deta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/erpnext-shipping — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/erpnext-shipping

docs.title: Twilio Integration — SMS/voice/WhatsApp via Twilio (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: OTPs, order alerts aur reminders ke liye established SMS tareeqa, jab WhatsApp akela kaafi na ho.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: OTPs aur delivery confirmations ke liye use karein jahan SMS abhi bhi chahiye; Twilio har message par charge karta hai, is liye isay client ke running costs mein shamil karke price karein.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/twilio-integration — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/twilio-integration

docs.title: MSG91 Integration — MSG91 SMS gateway
docs.text:
• What/why: MSG91 ke liye direct gateway app, jo India mein widely used SMS provider hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un Indian clients ko offer karein jo pehle se MSG91 par hain — unke existing provider aur rates par SMS alerts.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/dhwani-ris/frappe_msg91_integration — bench get-app https://github.com/dhwani-ris/frappe_msg91_integration

docs.title: Frappe Microsoft 365 — Outlook / Teams / OneDrive sync
docs.text:
• What/why: two-way Outlook calendar sync, Frappe Events se Teams meetings, transcripts/recordings, OAuth par Outlook mail, Microsoft sign-in.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un corporate clients ko offer karein jo Outlook/Teams mein rehte hain — calendar aur mail sync "ERP alag island hai" wali objection khatam kar deta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Bizmap-Technologies-Pvt-Ltd/frappe_microsoft365 — bench get-app https://github.com/Bizmap-Technologies-Pvt-Ltd/frappe_microsoft365 (Frappe v15/v16)

docs.title: ALYF Banking — bank integration & reconciliation (EBICS)
docs.text:
• What/why: EBICS ke through bank feeds aur modern Bank Reconciliation tool — manual statement imports se behtar hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: sirf iski status verify karne ke baad — Awesome Frappe is repo ko "Archived" flag karta hai, is liye pehle staging par test karein aur client ko promise na karein jab tak working confirm na ho jaye.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/alyf-de/banking — bench get-app https://github.com/alyf-de/banking

docs.title: Invoicing & OCR — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text: Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 2 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida-mand hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

docs.title: ERPNext OCR — Tesseract OCR inside Frappe (Monogramm)
docs.text:

  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: custom builds ke andar free OCR layer ke tor par use karein (scanned delivery notes, CNIC copies) price-sensitive Pakistani clients ke liye.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Monogramm/erpnext_ocr — bench get-app https://github.com/Monogramm/erpnext_ocr

docs.title: ERP OCR Integration — AI invoice import via Drive / email / upload
docs.text:

  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: supplier bills mein doobi hui accounts teams ko paid AP-automation add-on ke tor par bechein; accountant control mein rehta hai kyun ke kuch bhi automatically post nahi hota.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/wphamman/erpocr_integration — no bench get-app stated in source; see the repo README / OCR Quick Start Guide.

docs.title: Bahrain VAT — VAT integration for Bahrain

docs.title: Manufacturing — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text:
Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 4 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida-mand hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

Note: ERPNext core mein pehle se multi-level BOMs, work orders, job cards, Production Plan/MRP, subcontracting aur quality inspection hain — ye apps industry ya planning depth add karte hain.

docs.title: Apparelo — garment manufacturing workflow
docs.text:
• What/why: cutting/stitching/packing stage workflows jo generic work orders model nahi karte — garment clients ke liye industry layer.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: garment/textile exporters (Lahore, Faisalabad) ko stage workflows custom-build karne ki bajaye ye pitch karein — ye generic manufacturing sale ko industry-specific sale mein badal deta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/aerele/apparelo — bench get-app https://github.com/aerele/apparelo

docs.title: AuMMS — gold manufacturing management
docs.text:
• What/why: gold/jewellery manufacturing (purity, wastage, making charges) — Pakistan/India/Gulf mein ERPNext ka ek asal niche.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: Pakistan aur Gulf ke gold/jewellery manufacturers ko offer karein — ek aisa niche jahan kam ERP vendors compete karte hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/efeone/aumms — bench get-app https://github.com/efeone/aumms

docs.title: ERPNext Frepple Integration — advanced production planning / APS
docs.text:
• What/why: ERPNext ko Frepple ke saath pair karta hai, jo open-source advanced planning & scheduling engine hai, built-in MRP se aage constraint-based planning ke liye.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: bari factories ko phase-2 sale ke tor par offer karein jo ERPNext ke apne Production Plan se aage nikal gayi hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/msf4-0/ERPNext-Frepple-Integration — bench get-app https://github.com/msf4-0/ERPNext-Frepple-Integration

docs.title: Agriculture — agriculture domain for ERPNext (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: agri-business clients ke liye crop/livestock management domain, usi ERP ke andar.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: sugar mills, dairy farms aur seed companies ko offer karein — ek bara Pakistani segment jise zyada tar ERP vendors ignore karte hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/agriculture — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/agriculture

docs.title: POS & Retail — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text: Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 5 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida-mand hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

docs.title: POSNext — modern offline POS for ERPNext (Vue 3)
docs.text:
• What/why: tez billing, multiple payments, discounts, offline mode, touchscreen UI, split payments, coupons/gift cards, shift cash reconciliation — sab se credible built-in POS replacement.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: retail aur pharmacy clients ke liye isay hamara default POS offer banayein — offline mode un jagah par khud bik jata hai jahan internet unreliable hai, aur shift reconciliation se manual till counting khatam ho jati hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/BrainWise-DEV/POSNext — bench get-app https://github.com/BrainWise-DEV/POSNext (ERPNext v15+, free AGPL-3.0)

docs.title: POS Prime — modern POS, zero ERPNext modifications (v14/v15/v16)
docs.text:
• What/why: modern Vue 3 POS jo sirf standard DocTypes use karta hai — na custom fields, na DocTypes, install/uninstall saaf tareeqe se hota hai, is liye upgrades saaf rehte hain.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: risk-averse clients aur abhi bhi v14 par chalne wale clients ko propose karein — "zero core changes" woh line hai jo upgrade breakage se pareshan owners se haan karwa leti hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/ravindu2012/pos-prime — bench get-app https://github.com/ravindu2012/pos-prime (v14/v15/v16, free)

docs.title: POS Awesome — open-source POS (Vue.js + Vuetify)
docs.text:
• What/why: established community POS — widely deployed, is liye client teams isay pehle se janti hain.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: jab kisi client ya unke staff ko POS Awesome pehle se kisi site se pata ho to isay use karein — koi retraining nahi. v15 sites ke liye V15 fork use karein.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/yrestom/POS-Awesome — bench get-app https://github.com/yrestom/POS-Awesome · V15 fork: https://github.com/defendicon/POS-Awesome-V15

docs.title: TailPOS — offline-first POS
docs.text:
• What/why: un shops ke liye simple offline-first POS jahan internet unreliable hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: chhoti shops ke liye fallback ke tor par rakhein jahan POSNext zyada heavy lagay — lekin pehle verify karein: last activity Oct 2022 note hui thi, ho sakta hai unmaintained ho. Sirf staging test ke baad propose karein.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/bailabs/tailpos — bench get-app https://github.com/bailabs/tailpos

docs.title: X POS — offline-first POS, web / PWA / Electron
docs.text:
• What/why: tez, keyboard-driven, mukammal offline POS, desktop (Electron) app ke tor par bhi deploy ho sakta hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: retail/restaurant counters ko offer karein jo browser tab ki bajaye asli desktop till app chahte hain.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/kodlyft/xpos — bench get-app https://github.com/kodlyft/xpos.git

docs.title: Productivity — Frappe / ERPNext Apps
docs.text: Apps Catalog ka hissa — is category mein 8 apps hain. Har app mukhtasar hai: ye kya karta hai, kyun faida deta hai, NexTash ke kaam ke liye ek Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain line, aur GitHub link + install command. Pehle staging par test karein.

docs.title: Frappe Learning — LMS / academy inside Frappe (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: ERP ke andar courses, lessons aur quizzes — staff aur clients ki training ke liye.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: client training academy isi par banayein — naye users ke liye onboarding courses, progress tracked ke saath. NexTash ki apni onboarding ke liye bhi use karein.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/learning — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/learning (verify exact bench command in the repo README)

docs.title: Frappe Insights — BI dashboards (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: Frappe/ERPNext ke liye official BI tool — live data par dashboards, managers ke liye self-service.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: har go-live ke baad Insights dashboard package ko phase-2 sale ke tor par bechein — sales, stock aur finance dashboards, Excel exports ki zaroorat nahi. Note: v3.50 (Nov 2026) removed v2 — migrate v2 dashboards before upgrading.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/insights — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/insights (free MIT)

docs.title: Frappe Drive — file management + Google Docs clone (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: Frappe ke andar file storage aur collaborative docs — same system mein Google Drive/Docs ka replacement.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un clients ko offer karein jo sirf shared files ke liye Google Workspace/SharePoint ke paise de rahe hain — ye documents ko ERP ke andar rakhta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/drive — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/drive

docs.title: Frappe Gameplan — project management inside Frappe (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: Frappe ke andar project planning aur tracking — un clients ke liye jo projects alag tool mein chalate hain.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: service/project clients ko unke alag project tool ki jagah offer karein — do systems ke bajaye ek system.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/gameplan — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/gameplan

docs.title: Frappe Wiki — wiki / knowledge base (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: Frappe ke andar ek wiki — documentation aur SOPs wahin jahan team pehle se kaam karti hai.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: implementation ke doran client ki SOP library isi par banayein — ye handover ka hissa ban jati hai aur support calls kam kar deti hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/wiki — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/wiki

docs.title: Frappe Email Flow — visual email automation builder
docs.text:
• What/why: email flows ka visual builder — welcome sequences, reminders, follow-ups — server scripts likhe baghair.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: un sales/service clients ko offer karein jo har roz wahi emails haath se bhejte hain — ye repetitive follow-ups automate kar deta hai.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Alex-Yablonsky/frappe-email-flow — bench get-app https://github.com/Alex-Yablonsky/frappe-email-flow

docs.title: Frappe Builder — no-code website & page builder (official Frappe)
docs.text:
• What/why: marketing pages aur customer portals visually banayein — frappe.io khud isi se bana hai; editor mein AI assistant "Bob" (Nov 2026); v1.31.0 se MIT licence.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: client marketing pages aur portals ko kisi bhi implementation ke saath fixed-price add-on ke tor par deliver karein — alag website project ki zaroorat nahi.
  • GitHub: https://github.com/frappe/builder — bench get-app https://github.com/frappe/builder

docs.title: Frappe Cloud 2.0 — hosting rebuild (Pilot / Atlas / Central)
docs.text:
• What/why: naya Frappe Cloud — root/SSH wale VMs, one-click apps, Object Storage, LLMs; public beta 24 Nov 2026, target Jan 2027; Bench archived.
  • Hum isay kaise istemal kar sakte hain: hosting-migration clients ko Cloud 2.0 VMs par move karein jab ye live ho — isolated VMs downtime complaints ka jawab hain. "Bench to Cloud 2.0" migration ko ek service ke tor par offer karein.
  • GitHub: no repo — Frappe Cloud product, https://discuss.frappe.io/t/frappe-cloud-2-0-is-in-public-beta/165969
